    Hyperdimensional Probe: Decoding LLM Representations via Vector Symbolic Architectures

    超高维探针：通过向量符号架构解码 LLM 表示

    Marco Bronzini, Carlo Nicolini, Bruno Lepri, Jacopo Staiano, Andrea Passerini

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The Hyperdimensional Probe directly develops a method for extracting and analyzing semantic features in LLM representations and relating input-focused probes to output behavior, supported by experiments across models and tasks. Its use of symbolic vector algebra does not itself study compositional generalization, reasoning mechanisms, or systems.

    Hyperdimensional Probe 直接开发了一种提取和分析 LLM 表示中语义特征的方法，并将面向输入的探针与输出行为联系起来；其效果由跨模型和任务的实验支持。该方法使用符号向量代数，但这本身并未研究组合泛化、推理机制或系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Despite their capabilities, Large Language Models (LLMs) remain opaque with limited understanding of their internal representations. Current interpretability methods either focus on input-oriented feature extraction, such as supervised probes and Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), or on output distribution inspection, such as logit-oriented approaches. A full understanding of LLM vector spaces, however, requires integrating both perspectives, something existing approaches struggle with due to constraints on latent feature definitions. We introduce the Hyperdimensional Probe, a hybrid supervised probe that combines symbolic representations with neural probing. Leveraging Vector Symbolic Architectures (VSAs) and hypervector algebra, it unifies prior methods: the top-down interpretability of supervised probes, SAE's sparsity-driven proxy space, and output-oriented logit investigation. By combining the supervised learning paradigm of traditional probes with the dictionary-based representation principle of SAEs, our approach enables deeper input-focused feature extraction while supporting output-oriented analysis. Our experiments demonstrate that our approach consistently extracts meaningful semantic information across different LLMs, embedding sizes, and configurations, uncovering concept-oriented insights into LLM inference across two distinct scenarios: input-completion tasks and QA-focused text generation. VSA-based probing overcomes the limitations of logit-based analyses, which are constrained by the model's token vocabulary, while also mitigating the noisier interpretability outcomes often produced by SAEs in settings with a bounded conceptual feature space. By supporting a joint investigation of input-output features, this work advances the semantic understanding of neural representations while unifying the complementary perspectives of prior methods.

    中文

    尽管大型语言模型（LLM）能力强大，但其内部表示仍不透明，我们对这些表示的理解也有限。当前的可解释性方法要么侧重于面向输入的特征提取，例如有监督探针和稀疏自编码器（SAE），要么检查输出分布，例如面向 logit 的方法。然而，要全面理解 LLM 向量空间，需要整合这两种视角；现有方法由于潜在特征定义方面的限制，难以做到这一点。我们提出超高维探针，这是一种结合符号表示与神经探测的混合型有监督探针。该方法利用向量符号架构（VSA）和超向量代数，统一了以往方法：有监督探针自上而下的可解释性、SAE 由稀疏性驱动的代理空间，以及面向输出的 logit 分析。通过结合传统探针的有监督学习范式与 SAE 的基于字典的表示原理，我们的方法能够更深入地提取面向输入的特征，同时支持面向输出的分析。实验表明，我们的方法在不同 LLM、嵌入维度和配置下，都能稳定地提取有意义的语义信息，并在两种不同场景——输入补全任务和以 QA 为重点的文本生成——中揭示关于 LLM 推理的概念层面洞见。基于 VSA 的探测克服了基于 logit 的分析受模型 token 词汇表限制这一问题，同时也缓解了在概念特征空间有界的情形下 SAE 常产生较嘈杂可解释性结果的问题。通过支持对输入和输出特征进行联合考察，这项工作推进了对神经表示的语义理解，并统一了以往方法中互补的视角。

    Memorizing Long-tail Data Can Help Generalization Through Composition

    记忆长尾数据可通过组合帮助泛化

    Mo Zhou, Haoyang Ma, Rong Ge

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes theoretically and empirically how memorization and composition support correct predictions for unseen combinations of rare features, directly advancing compositional generalization. Prediction is involved, but the abstract does not focus on reasoning mechanisms or capabilities.

    本文通过理论和实证分析，研究记忆与组合能力如何支持模型对罕见特征的未见组合做出正确预测，直接推动了组合泛化研究。尽管涉及预测，摘要并未聚焦于推理机制或能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Deep learning has led researchers to rethink the relationship between memorization and generalization. In many settings, memorization does not hurt generalization due to implicit regularization and may help by memorizing long-tailed examples. In this paper, we consider the synergy between memorization and simple composition -- the ability to make correct prediction on a combination of long-tailed features. Theoretically, we show that for a linear setting, memorization together with composition can help the model make correct predictions on rare test examples that require a combination of long-tailed features, even if such combinations were never observed in the training data. Experiments on neural network architecture on simple data show that the theoretical insight extends beyond the linear setting, and we further observe that the composition capability of the model depends on its architecture.

    中文

    深度学习促使研究者重新思考记忆与泛化之间的关系。在许多情形下，由于隐式正则化，记忆并不会损害泛化，还可能通过记忆长尾样本带来帮助。本文考察记忆与简单组合能力之间的协同作用——即针对长尾特征组合做出正确预测的能力。理论上，我们证明，在一个线性设定中，即使某些长尾特征组合从未在训练数据中出现过，记忆与组合能力也能帮助模型对需要这些组合的罕见测试样本做出正确预测。在简单数据上的神经网络架构实验表明，这一理论洞见也适用于线性设定之外；我们还进一步观察到，模型的组合能力取决于其架构。

    Analyzing and Improving Chain-of-Thought Monitorability Through Information Theory

    通过信息论分析并改进思维链的可监控性

    Usman Anwar, Tim Bakker, Dana Kianfar, Cristina Pinneri, Christos Louizos

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes when reasoning traces can be monitored and proposes training objectives to reduce CoT obfuscation and reward hacking, directly advancing reasoning mechanisms and their training. Its monitoring-system connection is meaningful but secondary; it does not study internal representations or compositional generalization.

    本文分析了推理轨迹何时可被监控，并提出训练目标以减少 CoT 混淆和奖励投机，直接推动了推理机制及其训练方法的发展。其与监控系统的联系也有意义，但属于次要贡献；文章没有研究内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitors are LLM-based systems that analyze reasoning traces to detect when outputs may exhibit attributes of interest, such as test-hacking behavior during code generation. In this paper, we use information-theoretic analysis to show that non-zero mutual information between CoT and output is a necessary but not sufficient condition for CoT monitorability. We identify two sources of approximation error that may undermine the performance of CoT monitors in practice: information gap, which measures the extent to which the monitor can extract the information available in CoT, and elicitation error, which measures the extent to which the monitor approximates the optimal monitoring function. Empirically, we show that CoT obfuscation can arise even in the absence of any optimization pressure against CoT. We further demonstrate that the fragility of CoT monitorability can be systematically mitigated through targeted training objectives. To this end, we propose a practical, label-free objective based on mutual information between outputs and CoTs, and benchmark it against an oracle-based method that directly rewards the monitored model for CoTs that maximize monitor accuracy. Across multiple environments, we show that our objective is effective at preventing CoT obfuscation even when training against a monitor, and helps mitigate reward hacking when the task reward is imperfectly specified.

    中文

    思维链（CoT）监控器是基于 LLM 的系统，用于分析推理轨迹，以检测输出是否可能具有某些关注属性，例如代码生成过程中的测试投机行为。本文通过信息论分析表明，CoT 与输出之间存在非零互信息，是 CoT 可监控性的必要条件，但并非充分条件。我们找出两种可能削弱 CoT 监控器实际性能的近似误差来源：信息差距，用于衡量监控器能够提取 CoT 中可用信息的程度；以及诱导误差，用于衡量监控器对最优监控函数的近似程度。实证结果表明，即使不存在针对 CoT 的优化压力，CoT 混淆也可能出现。我们进一步证明，通过有针对性的训练目标，可以系统性地缓解 CoT 可监控性的脆弱性。为此，我们提出一种实用的无标签目标，该目标基于输出与 CoT 之间的互信息；并将其与一种基于预言机的方法进行基准比较，后者直接奖励受监控模型生成能够最大化监控器准确率的 CoT。在多个环境中，我们表明，即使在针对监控器进行训练时，该目标也能有效防止 CoT 混淆；当任务奖励的规格不完善时，它还有助于缓解奖励投机。

    The Stepwise Informativeness Assumption: When Do Entropy Dynamics Track Reasoning Correctness in LLMs?

    逐步信息性假设：熵动态何时能反映 LLM 推理的正确性？

    Mar Gonz\`alez I Catal\`a, Haitz S\'aez de Oc\'ariz Borde, George D. Monta\~nez, Pietro Li\`o

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper characterizes when entropy changes in reasoning traces align with answer correctness, develops a theoretical assumption and failure regimes, and tests the claims across models and benchmarks. Its focus is reasoning correctness and capability development; entropy signals alone do not establish a contribution to internal representation mechanisms.

    本文刻画了推理轨迹中的熵变化何时与答案正确性一致，提出了理论假设和失效情形，并在多种模型与基准上检验相关主张。其重点是推理正确性与能力发展；仅有熵信号并不能证明其对内部表征机制有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent work uses entropy-based signals at multiple representation levels to study reasoning in large language models, but the field remains largely empirical. From a theoretical perspective, reductions in model uncertainty do not necessarily reflect progress toward correctness. In this work, we characterize when such alignment can be expected through the Stepwise Informativeness Assumption (SIA), which requires entropy-reducing reasoning-prefix extensions increase the probability assigned to valid answers in expectation. We show that next-token prediction can transfer answer-relevant information from training data to the model, but does not, by itself, guarantee alignment with correctness. Instead, we propose that this alignment depends on how the training regime couples reasoning traces to correct answers. Furthermore, we hypothesize observable signatures of this phenomenon and characterize its expected failure regimes. We empirically investigate how entropy dynamics relate to correctness across four reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K, ARC, SVAMP, MATH) and diverse open-weight language models spanning base, instruction-tuned, and RL-trained regimes. Our results show that entropy-correctness alignment strengthens with post-training but can weaken when task difficulty exceeds model capabilities.

    中文

    近期研究使用多个表征层级上的熵信号来研究大型语言模型中的推理，但该领域仍主要依赖实证。从理论角度看，模型不确定性的降低并不一定意味着正在趋近正确答案。在这项工作中，我们通过逐步信息性假设（SIA）刻画何时可以预期这种一致性；该假设要求：在期望意义上，能够降低熵的推理前缀扩展会提高模型赋予有效答案的概率。我们表明，下一个词元预测可以将训练数据中与答案相关的信息传递给模型，但其本身并不能保证这种信息与正确性一致。相反，我们认为，这种一致性取决于训练机制如何将推理轨迹与正确答案关联起来。此外，我们提出了该现象可观测特征的假设，并刻画其预期失效情形。我们在四个推理基准（GSM8K、ARC、SVAMP、MATH）以及涵盖基础模型、指令微调模型和 RL 训练模型的多种开放权重语言模型上，实证考察熵动态与正确性的关系。结果表明，熵与正确性的一致性会随着后训练增强，但当任务难度超出模型能力时可能减弱。

    Generalization and Scaling Laws for Mixture-of-Experts Transformers

    混合专家 Transformer 的泛化与缩放定律

    Mansour Zoubeirou a Mayaki

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper derives generalization bounds, approximation results, and scaling laws for MoE Transformers, including the roles of active capacity and routing overhead. This directly advances conditional computation and model scaling; generalization theory and the word “reasoning” in the abstract do not amount to contributions on compositionality or reasoning capabilities.

    该论文为 MoE Transformer 推导了泛化界、近似结果和缩放定律，其中包括激活容量与路由开销的作用。这直接推动了条件计算与模型缩放；摘要中的泛化理论以及“推理”一词，并不构成对组合性或推理能力的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We develop a theory of generalization and scaling for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Transformers that cleanly separates \emph{active} per-input capacity from routing combinatorics. By conditioning on fixed routing patterns and union-bounding across them, we derive a sup-norm covering-number bound whose metric entropy scales with the active parameter budget and incurs a MoE-specific routing overhead. Combined with a standard ERM analysis for squared loss, this yields a generalization bound under a $d$-dimensional manifold data model and $C^\beta$ targets, showing that approximation and estimation trade off as in dense networks once active parameters are accounted for appropriately. We further prove a constructive approximation theorem for MoE architectures, showing that, under the approximation construction, error can decrease either by scaling active capacity or by increasing the number of experts, depending on the dominant bottleneck. From these results we derive neural scaling laws for model size, data size, and compute-optimal tradeoffs. Overall, our results provide a transparent statistical reference point for reasoning about MoE scaling, clarifying which behaviors are certified by worst-case theory and which must arise from data-dependent routing structure or optimization dynamics.

    中文

    我们为混合专家（MoE）Transformer 建立了一套关于泛化与缩放的理论，清晰地区分了每个输入的\emph{激活}容量与路由组合结构。通过对固定路由模式进行条件化，并对这些模式应用并集界，我们推导出一个上确界范数覆盖数界，其度量熵随激活参数预算扩展，并产生 MoE 特有的路由开销。结合针对平方损失的标准 ERM 分析，这给出了在一个 $d$维流形数据模型下、以 $C^\beta$为目标的泛化界，表明只要恰当计入激活参数，近似与估计之间的权衡就与稠密网络中的情况相同。我们进一步证明了 MoE 架构的一个构造性近似定理，表明在该近似构造下，误差可通过扩大激活容量或增加专家数量而降低，具体取决于占主导地位的瓶颈。基于这些结果，我们推导出关于模型规模、数据规模和计算最优权衡的神经缩放定律。总体而言，我们的结果为理解 MoE 缩放提供了一个透明的统计参照点，阐明了哪些行为得到最坏情形理论的保证，哪些则必须源自依赖数据的路由结构或优化动态。

    A Mechanistic Study of Algorithmic Generalization in Diffusion Models on Modular Arithmetic

    模运算扩散模型中算法泛化的机制研究

    Joon Hyeok Kim, Yong-Hyun Park, Mattis Dals{\ae}tra {\O}stby, Jiatao Gu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes diffusion models’ internal representations and computation, identifying periodic operand codes, their composition, and a sampling-stage transition signal. This directly advances mechanistic understanding and algorithmic generalization; iterative sampling is incidental to system design.

    本文分析了扩散模型的内部表征与计算，识别出周期性运算数编码、它们的组合方式，以及一个表征采样阶段转换的信号。这直接推进了对机制与算法泛化的理解；迭代采样只是附带涉及系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Despite their empirical success, how diffusion models generalize remains poorly understood from a mechanistic perspective. In this work, we provide a controlled mechanistic account of algorithmic learning in diffusion models. By utilizing the grokking phenomenon on an image-based modular addition task as a tractable testbed, we dissect the model's internal dynamics across two distinct visual regimes. In a single-image regime, mechanistic dissection reveals that the model implements modular addition by encoding operands as periodic representations and composing them at the self-attention--feedforward interface in a way that recovers the trigonometric addition identities. In a diverse-image regime with high intraclass variability, we find that the iterative sampling process partitions the task into an arithmetic computation phase and a subsequent visual refinement phase, with their transition precisely captured by an internal frequency-entropy signal. Together, our analysis clarifies the mechanics of algorithmic generalization of diffusion models in a controlled setting, while leaving open how broadly these mechanisms transfer beyond modular addition.

    中文

    尽管扩散模型在经验上取得了成功，但从机制角度看，人们仍不清楚它们如何实现泛化。在这项工作中，我们对扩散模型中的算法学习给出了受控的机制性说明。我们利用基于图像的模加法任务中的 grokking 现象，将其作为一个易于分析的测试平台，剖析模型在两种不同视觉设定下的内部动态。在单图像设定中，机制剖析揭示，模型通过将运算数编码为周期性表征，并在自注意力—前馈网络接口处对其进行组合来实现模加法，其方式能够恢复三角加法恒等式。在图像多样且类内变化较大的设定中，我们发现，迭代采样过程会将任务划分为算术计算阶段和随后的视觉细化阶段，而二者之间的转换可由内部频率熵信号精确刻画。总之，我们的分析阐明了扩散模型在受控设定下实现算法泛化的机制，同时也指出这些机制能否广泛迁移到模加法以外的问题，仍有待研究。

    Deep Reasoning in General Purpose Agents via Structured Meta-Cognition

    通过结构化元认知实现通用智能体的深度推理

    Dean Light, Michael Theologitis, Kshitish Ghate, Shuyue Stella Li, Benjamin Newman, Chirag Shah, Aylin Caliskan, Pang Wei Koh, Dan Suciu, Yulia Tsvetkov

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DOLORES constructs task-specific reasoning scaffolds by composing associative inference, formal computation, and recursive subproblem solving, and reports gains across several hard benchmarks. This directly advances adaptive reasoning and agent scaffolding; composition is a substantive part of the method, while the abstract gives no model-internal interpretability contribution.

    DOLORES 通过组合联想推断、形式计算和递归子问题求解来构建任务专属推理脚手架，并报告了在多个高难度基准上的提升。这直接推进了自适应推理和智能体脚手架的发展；组合是该方法的重要组成部分，但摘要没有涉及模型内部可解释性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Humans intuitively solve complex problems by flexibly shifting among reasoning modes: they plan, execute, revise intermediate goals, resolve ambiguity through associative judgment, and apply formal procedures to well-specified subproblems. Current LLM agents lack this flexibility, as their scaffolds hard-code such reasoning decisions in advance. These scaffolds are effective when their prescribed structure matches the task, but brittle when solving the task requires adapting the structure of reasoning itself. We introduce Deep Reasoning -- an inference-time approach for constructing task-specific scaffolds through structured meta-reasoning. Deep Reasoning uses a formal language that represents meta-reasoning as executable decompositions over associative inference, formal computation, and recursive subproblem solving, enabling decomposition principles to be encoded as in-context examples that guide test-time scaffold construction. We instantiate this approach in a general-purpose agent (DOLORES) that distributes complex tasks across more controlled reasoning threads. We evaluate it against state-of-the-art scaffolding methods across four hard benchmarks: multi-hop reasoning, long-chain question answering, long-context aggregation, and deep research-style information seeking. DOLORES outperforms all evaluated scaffolds across three model sizes and two model families, improving over the strongest evaluated scaffold baseline by 24.8% on average. DOLORES distributes cognition across structured, lower-load reasoning threads, thereby reducing premature termination and hallucinations. This advantage can even bridge the scaling gap, with an 8B version surpassing all evaluated 32B baselines from the same family in more than half the settings. These results point toward future agentic systems that treat scaffolding as adaptive reasoning, constructing the structure each task requires just-in-time.

    中文

    人类解决复杂问题时，会直觉地在不同推理模式之间灵活切换：他们会规划、执行、修订中间目标，通过联想判断消除歧义，并对定义明确的子问题应用形式化步骤。当前的 LLM 智能体缺乏这种灵活性，因为它们的脚手架会预先硬编码这类推理决策。当预设结构与任务相匹配时，这些脚手架十分有效；但当解决任务需要调整推理结构本身时，它们就显得脆弱。我们提出 Deep Reasoning，这是一种在推理时通过结构化元推理构建任务专属脚手架的方法。Deep Reasoning 使用一种形式语言，将元推理表示为对联想推断、形式计算和递归子问题求解的可执行分解；由此可以将分解原则编码为上下文示例，引导测试时的脚手架构建。我们将该方法应用于通用智能体 DOLORES，将复杂任务分配到更受控的推理线程中。我们在四个高难度基准上，将其与最先进的脚手架方法进行评估：多跳推理、长链问答、长上下文信息汇总和深度研究式信息搜寻。DOLORES 在三种模型规模和两个模型家族上均优于所有受测脚手架，平均比受测表现最好的脚手架基线提高 24.8%。DOLORES 将认知过程分配到结构化、负载较低的推理线程中，从而减少过早终止和幻觉。这一优势甚至能够弥合规模差距：在超过半数的设定中，同一家族的 8B 版本胜过所有受测 32B 基线。这些结果表明，未来的智能体系统可以将脚手架视为一种自适应推理过程，按需即时构建每项任务所需的结构。

    CAVE：一种面向碎片化视觉证据推理的结构化信用分配方法

    Tengda Guo, Jie Leng, Hanlei Li, Yaoyuan Liang, Qingyue Zhang, Dian Yang, Mingyu Zhang, Yuhua Fu, Shao-Lun Huang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CAVE's main contribution is process-level reward signals for training VLMs to integrate fragmented visual evidence, alongside a benchmark for that capability, directly advancing multimodal reasoning. Its structured steps and action-level credit assignment are training mechanisms, but the abstract does not establish reusable compositional representations or internal interpretability, and the model-system connection is incidental.

    CAVE 的主要贡献是为训练 VLM 整合碎片化视觉证据提供过程级奖励信号，并构建了评估该能力的基准，直接推进了多模态推理。其结构化步骤和动作级信用分配属于训练机制，但摘要并未证明它具有可复用的组合式表征或内部可解释性，与模型系统的联系也只是附带的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance on general multimodal reasoning, yet remain challenged in integrating nonlocal visual information to support semantically underdetermined visual reasoning. We describe this challenge as Fragmented Visual Reasoning. To this end, we propose Credit Assignment for Visual Evidence (CAVE), a structured process-reward method based on GRPO for interleaved visual reasoning. Specifically, CAVE evaluates the contribution of intermediate steps at the action level via three complementary reasoning process signals: belief update, evidence acquisition, and adaptive focus control, thereby guiding the model to optimize each reasoning action and learn more reliable visual reasoning strategies. Meanwhile, we construct TRACER-Bench, which covers four nonlocal and semantically confusable reasoning dimensions and provides key intermediate evidence to supervise reasoning paths. Experiments demonstrate that CAVE substantially improves performance on tasks requiring fragmented visual evidence integration, covering both public benchmarks and our newly introduced TRACER-Bench, while retaining competitive performance on general multimodal evaluations. Further analyses reveal that CAVE effectively improves the visual reasoning capacity and exhibits stronger robustness under longer-range and deeper cross-region dependencies.

    中文

    视觉语言模型（VLM）在通用多模态推理方面已取得出色表现，但在整合非局部视觉信息以支持语义信息不足的视觉推理方面仍面临挑战。我们将这一挑战称为碎片化视觉推理。为此，我们提出视觉证据信用分配（CAVE），这是一种基于 GRPO、用于交错式视觉推理的结构化过程奖励方法。具体而言，CAVE 通过三种互补的推理过程信号，从动作层面评估中间步骤的贡献：信念更新、证据获取和自适应焦点控制，从而引导模型优化每个推理动作，并学习更可靠的视觉推理策略。同时，我们构建了 TRACER-Bench，涵盖四个非局部且语义上易混淆的推理维度，并提供关键的中间证据来监督推理路径。实验表明，CAVE 显著提升了需要整合碎片化视觉证据的任务表现，涵盖公开基准和我们新提出的 TRACER-Bench，同时在通用多模态评测中保持了有竞争力的表现。进一步分析显示，CAVE 有效提升了视觉推理能力，并且在更长距离、更深层的跨区域依赖下表现出更强的鲁棒性。

    Runyu Lu, Yubo Wu, Ethan Kou, Haotian Lin, Letian Fu, Wenli Xiao, Ajay Mandlekar, Yinzhen Xu, Guanya Shi, Ken Goldberg, Ang Chen, Mosharaf Chowdhury, Jan Kautz, Yuke Zhu, Linxi "Jim" Fan, Guanzhi Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ASPIRE combines iterative robot exploration, program repair, evolutionary search, and a reusable skill library, with evidence of transfer to unseen tasks and real robots. Reusable skills and their recombination substantially advance compositional learning and agent-system design, while failure diagnosis provides a more limited reasoning contribution; multimodal traces alone do not establish mechanistic interpretability.

    ASPIRE 将迭代式机器人探索、程序修复、进化搜索和可复用技能库结合起来，并展示了向未见任务和真实机器人迁移的证据。可复用技能及其重组显著推进了组合式学习和智能体系统设计，而故障诊断对推理的贡献较为有限；仅有多模态轨迹并不能证明存在机制可解释性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Traditional robot programming is notoriously challenging: it requires orchestrating multimodal perception, managing physical contact dynamics, and handling diverse environment configurations and execution failures. We introduce ASPIRE (Agentic Skill Programming through Iterative Robot Exploration), a continual learning system that autonomously writes and refines robot control programs in a code-as-policy paradigm while compounding experience into a reusable skill library. ASPIRE operates in an open-ended learning loop, consisting of three components: (1) a closed-loop robot execution engine that exposes fine-grained multimodal traces, enabling the agent to autonomously diagnose failures, synthesize repairs, and validate outcomes; (2) a continually expanding skill library that distills validated fixes into reusable, transferable robotic knowledge; and (3) an evolutionary search procedure that generates diverse programs, systematically debugging them to explore beyond single-trajectory refinement. ASPIRE surpasses prior methods by up to 77% on manipulation tasks under perturbation, 72% on Robosuite's bimanual handover task, and up to 32% on long-horizon household tasks. The accumulated skill library further enables zero-shot generalization: on representative unseen long-horizon tasks, ASPIRE achieves 31% success, outperforming the 4% success rate of prior methods. Performance scales with the capabilities of frontier models. With Claude Opus 5.5, ASPIRE nearly saturates these benchmarks, achieving 99% average success across all 80 LIBERO-Pro tasks and 100% success on representative Robosuite and BEHAVIOR-1K tasks. Beyond simulation, skills discovered in simulation reduce real-world robot programming effort across embodiments and robot APIs, while skills acquired through online interaction with physical robots enable ASPIRE to solve a Rubik's Cube with progressively improving efficiency.

    传统机器人编程一直以困难著称：它需要协调多模态感知、处理物理接触动力学，并应对多样的环境配置和执行故障。我们提出 ASPIRE（通过迭代式机器人探索进行智能体技能编程），这是一个持续学习系统，采用“代码即策略”范式自主编写和改进机器人控制程序，并将积累的经验汇集到可复用技能库中。ASPIRE 在开放式学习循环中运行，由三个部分组成：（1）闭环机器人执行引擎，提供细粒度多模态轨迹，使智能体能够自主诊断故障、生成修复方案并验证结果；（2）持续扩展的技能库，将经过验证的修复提炼为可复用、可迁移的机器人知识；（3）进化搜索过程，用于生成多样化程序并对其进行系统调试，从而探索单轨迹改进之外的解法。ASPIRE 在受扰动操控任务上的表现最高超过先前方法 77%，在 Robosuite 的双手交接任务上高出 72%，在长时程家庭任务上最高高出 32%。积累的技能库还支持零样本泛化：在具有代表性的未见长时程任务上，ASPIRE 的成功率达到 31%，超过先前方法的 4%。系统性能随着前沿模型能力的提升而增长。使用 Claude Opus 5.5 时，ASPIRE 几乎达到了这些基准的饱和表现：在全部 80 个 LIBERO-Pro 任务上的平均成功率为 99%，在具有代表性的 Robosuite 和 BEHAVIOR-1K 任务上成功率为 100%。除了模拟环境，模拟中发现的技能还能减少不同具身形态和机器人 API 上的真实机器人编程工作量；而通过与实体机器人在线交互习得的技能，则使 ASPIRE 能够逐步提高解决魔方任务的效率。

    S^3martCirc：自监督智能电路发现

    Wendy Zheng, Yinhan He, Liang Wu, Jundong Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper jointly discovers and interprets model circuits using general computational roles and a quantitative assignment metric, directly advancing mechanistic interpretability. Its generalization across tasks is secondary to circuit discovery, and the abstract gives no substantive contribution to reasoning or model systems.

    本文利用通用计算角色和量化分配指标，联合发现并解释模型电路，直接推动了机制可解释性的发展。跨任务泛化对于电路发现而言是次要的，摘要也没有对推理或模型系统作出实质性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across diverse tasks, from text summarization to question answering. Despite these capabilities, their black-box nature obscures internal decision-making processes. Mechanistic interpretability (MI) aims to address this by reverse-engineering neural networks into human-understandable algorithms. Current MI approaches for LLMs typically follow a two-stage paradigm: first identifying important components (circuit discovery), where components are typically individual nodes such as an attention head or feedforward neuron, and second determining the role they play in a certain task (functional interpretation). However, this sequential approach overlooks a fundamental insight: a component's importance and its functional role are inherently codependent. Unifying these stages presents two key challenges: (1) functional roles are often tied to specific nodes or components, limiting generalization, and (2) their identification relies on subjective interpretation rather than quantifiable metrics. To address these challenges, we propose S^3martCirc (Self-supervised Smart Circuit Discovery), a unified framework that simultaneously discovers circuits and interprets functionality. S^3martCirc abstracts node behavior into two general computational roles that generalize across tasks and defines a quantitative metric for assigning them, enabling importance and functional role to be discovered jointly rather than in sequence. Extensive experiments show that our framework outperforms existing methods in circuit discovery.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）在从文本摘要到问答的各种任务中展现出卓越性能。尽管具备这些能力，其黑盒特性仍使内部决策过程难以观察。机制可解释性（MI）旨在通过逆向工程将神经网络还原为人类可理解的算法来解决这一问题。当前针对 LLM 的 MI 方法通常遵循两阶段范式：首先识别重要组件（电路发现），其中组件通常是单个节点，例如注意力头或前馈神经元；其次确定它们在特定任务中所发挥的作用（功能解释）。然而，这种顺序式方法忽略了一个基本洞见：组件的重要性与其功能作用本质上相互依存。统一这两个阶段面临两项关键挑战：（1）功能作用通常与特定节点或组件绑定，限制了泛化能力；（2）对功能作用的识别依赖主观解释，而非可量化指标。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 S^3martCirc（自监督智能电路发现），一个能够同时发现电路并解释其功能的统一框架。S^3martCirc 将节点行为抽象为两种可跨任务泛化的通用计算角色，并定义了用于分配这些角色的量化指标，从而能够联合发现组件的重要性和功能作用，而非依次发现。大量实验表明，我们的框架在电路发现方面优于现有方法。

    Feature Superposition in Neural Networks: From Theory to Practice

    神经网络中的特征叠加：从理论到实践

    Dai Shi, Xiaoyu Li, Andi Han, Jos\'e Miguel Hern\'andez-Lobato

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper directly reviews and organizes theory and practical methods for understanding feature superposition, including feature recovery, evidence standards, and open questions, making internal representations its core focus. Connections to composition and reasoning are incidental to the discussion of feature storage and computation, with no central contribution to those areas.

    本文直接综述并梳理了理解特征叠加的理论和实践方法，包括特征恢复、证据标准和开放问题，因此内部表征是其核心关注点。与组合和推理的联系只是围绕特征存储与计算的讨论中的附带内容，本文并未对这些领域作出核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Superposition refers to neural networks representing more features than they have dimensions. It was proposed to explain polysemantic neurons, which respond to several features, and also other phenomena, such as neural scaling laws and adversarial vulnerability. A feature stored in superposition is useful to the extent that its value can be read back despite interference from the other features. The theory of superposition mainly asks how wide a layer must be for the features to be read back, and by which decoder. In theoretical models, a single linear map that reads back every combination of nonzero features needs a width nearly quadratic in their number, while sparse optimization can succeed with a width linear in that number. In practice, one may hope to interpret a trained network by recovering its features in the same way. However, its features are usually unknown, and thus they are estimated from its activations or weights by recovery methods, such as sparse autoencoders and transcoders. In this work, we organize the theory of superposition by the decoder class and its practice by the strength of the claims about a feature supported by each method's results. On the theory side, we review the lower bounds on the overlap between feature directions, the conditions under which trained toy models share dimensions among features, and the separation between storing features and computing new features. On the practice side, we categorize recovery methods into four families, from probes for a named feature to decompositions of the trained weights. We then compare their evaluations, failure modes, and applications, and grade the evidence on one scale of claims about a feature. Finally, we assess previously stated open problems and identify remaining theoretical and empirical questions about superposition in trained networks. Project page: https://eethanshi.github.io/awesome-superposition/

    中文

    叠加是指神经网络表示的特征数量多于其维度数量。这一概念被提出用于解释多义神经元（即会响应多个特征的神经元），以及神经网络缩放定律和对抗脆弱性等其他现象。叠加存储的特征有用与否，取决于尽管存在其他特征干扰，其取值是否仍能被读出。叠加理论主要探讨读出特征所需的层宽，以及应采用哪种解码器。在理论模型中，若要通过单个线性映射读出所有非零特征组合，所需层宽接近特征数量的平方；而稀疏优化只需与特征数量线性相关的层宽即可成功。在实践中，人们可能希望以相同方式恢复特征，从而解释一个训练好的网络。然而，网络特征通常未知，因此需要通过特征恢复方法，根据网络激活或权重估计特征，例如稀疏自编码器和转码器。在本文中，我们依据解码器类别梳理叠加理论，并依据各方法的结果能够支持何种强度的特征主张来梳理相关实践。在理论方面，我们回顾了特征方向重叠程度的下界、训练后的玩具模型在何种条件下会让多个特征共享维度，以及特征存储与新特征计算之间的区别。在实践方面，我们将特征恢复方法分为四类，从针对命名特征的探针到对训练后权重的分解。随后，我们比较这些方法的评估、失效模式和应用，并依据同一套特征主张尺度对证据进行分级。最后，我们评估先前提出的开放问题，并指出训练网络中叠加现象尚待解决的理论与实证问题。项目页面：https://eethanshi.github.io/awesome-superposition/

    Lena Libon, Alexander Panfilov, Ben Rank, Xin Chen, Jonas Geiping, Maksym Andriushchenko

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper trains models against activation probes to change internal representations while preserving monitorability, directly addressing how desired and undesired concepts are represented. Its alignment and jailbreak results concern model behavior, but the abstract does not make reasoning or system organization a substantive contribution.

    本文针对激活探针对模型进行训练，以改变内部表征并保留可监测性，直接探讨了模型如何表征预期和非预期概念。其对齐和越狱结果涉及模型行为，但摘要并未将推理或系统组织作为实质性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Models are usually aligned based on their observed outputs, using demonstrations, preference data, or reward signals. These objectives reward responses that look aligned. More capable models may learn to satisfy them without internalizing the intended behavior, for example by faking compliance during training. Such superficial compliance could be harder when the objective is defined on model internals rather than outputs. Therefore, we study probe-guided fine-tuning, using probes that detect undesired properties in model activations as a direct training signal. We evaluate linear and non-linear probes with different numbers of probes per layer across two alignment objectives: harmlessness and honesty. We find that training against probes that do not update during training is an easily exploitable objective, while continuously updated probes substantially reduce harmfulness and improve honesty while preserving utility. Probe-guided fine-tuning achieves better safety-utility trade-offs than DPO and inference-time steering, while being substantially more robust against jailbreak and abliteration attacks. Moreover, the concepts stay linearly encoded after fine-tuning, meaning oversight is not lost by our method. Training against probes thus offers a way to shape what models represent rather than only what they output, which may become increasingly important as models get better at making their outputs look aligned.

    中文

    模型通常基于其可观察输出进行对齐，采用示范、偏好数据或奖励信号。这些目标会奖励看起来符合对齐要求的回答。能力更强的模型可能学会满足这些目标，却没有将预期行为内化，例如在训练期间假装遵从。如果目标定义在模型内部而非输出上，这种表面遵从可能会更难实现。因此，我们研究探针引导的微调，将能够检测模型激活中不良属性的探针用作直接训练信号。我们在两种对齐目标——无害性和诚实性——上评估了线性与非线性探针，并考察了每层使用不同数量探针的情况。我们发现，针对训练期间不更新的探针进行训练很容易被钻空子；而持续更新的探针能够显著降低有害性并提升诚实性，同时保持模型效用。与 DPO 和推理时引导相比，探针引导微调取得了更好的安全性与效用权衡，并且对越狱和 abliteration 攻击有显著更强的鲁棒性。此外，微调后相关概念仍以线性方式编码，这意味着我们的方法不会损害监督能力。因此，针对探针进行训练提供了一种塑造模型所表征内容、而非仅塑造其输出的途径；随着模型越来越擅长让输出看起来符合对齐要求，这种方法或将变得愈发重要。

    Long-horizon agents compact their history to continue within a finite context window, but a textual summary alone may not support every subsequent decision. The tokens are conditioned on the summary and appended after it, forming an analogue of a residual connection along the sequence dimension. On SummHay, REMORY improves source attribution at nearly unchanged insight coverage and approaches the full-context joint score using only 5.2% of the input positions.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Autoregressive foundation models offer state-of-the-art capabilities to simulate the market by generating the message flow of limit order books (LOBs). Yet, without understanding their inner workings, research directions are hard to narrow and practical use in real-world trading environments remains uncertain. This study therefore asks what these models actually learn about market microstructure. We find that, similarly to games where sequence models build an internal representation of the board, an 8.2M-parameter Mamba-3 state-space model trained autoregressively on the tokenized message stream of eight large-cap US equities learns an internal representation of the market and its dynamics. In particular, order-flow imbalance, a central driver of short-horizon price moves, is decodable at $R^2 \approx 0.59$, far above controls and baselines. This representation extends to unseen stocks, suggesting that these models learn general representations rather than ticker-specific patterns. The model also generalizes across metrics beyond order-flow imbalance: results hold across traded volume and volatility. Additionally, the representation is causally steerable: pushing the state along a feature's axis shifts the model's next-message beliefs as that feature implies, monotonically in dose, consistent with the emergence of a world model.

    ReAPO：面向 LLM 推理高效探索的重试感知策略优化

    Nghi Dao, Calder Morton-Ferguson, Noah Golowich, and Adam Block

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ReAPO uses a stochastic-shortest-path view to develop retry-aware exploration and credit assignment for training LLM reasoning, with empirical gains on math and science benchmarks. Its allocation of extra generations connects secondarily to computation efficiency, but the central contribution is reasoning training.

    ReAPO 从随机最短路径的视角出发，为 LLM 推理训练设计了重试感知的探索和信用分配，并在数学和科学基准上取得了实证提升。额外生成机会的分配也与计算效率有关，但其核心贡献在于推理训练。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    RLVR improves language-model reasoning, but commonly relies on independent stochastic rollouts for exploration, which can repeatedly sample similar failed strategies. Prior work has seen success with approaches that guide exploration by introducing dependence into the sampling process by including incorrect solutions in the context for subsequent attempts. Still, these methods introduce the additional question of how to assign credit to each attempt. We propose to view the credit assignment through the lens of Stochastic Shortest Paths, a framework in classical reinforcement learning that seeks to minimize the expected cumulative cost to reach a terminal state (in our case, a verified successful response). We show that, under suitable simplifying assumptions, this perspective naturally leads to a simple modification to GRPO, which we call Retry-Aware Policy Optimization (ReAPO). ReAPO allocates additional generation to failed trajectories, allowing successful retries to be reinforced without rewarding preceding failures, and assigns credit in a theoretically principled way to each attempt. Across Qwen3 and OLMo-2 models from 0.6B to 4B and eight mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks, ReAPO improves first-attempt performance over GRPO as well as natural recent baseline algorithms, while additional ablations demonstrate the utility of both serial sampling and ReAPO's credit assignment. On Qwen3-0.6B, ReAPO also outperforms GRPO with twice the group size or twice the training steps, reaching their peak accuracy with 39% and 31% fewer generated tokens, respectively. Taken together, our results suggest that ReAPO is a simple yet effective approach for improving LM reasoning performance through improved exploration and retry-aware credit assignment.

    中文

    RLVR 能够提升语言模型的推理能力，但通常依赖独立的随机 rollout 进行探索，这可能导致反复采样到相似的失败策略。先前研究通过在后续尝试的上下文中纳入错误解，使采样过程相互依赖，从而引导探索，并取得了成功。不过，这些方法又引出了如何为每次尝试分配信用的问题。我们提出从随机最短路径的视角来审视信用分配。随机最短路径是经典强化学习中的一种框架，旨在最小化到达终止状态（在本研究中为经验证的成功回答）的期望累积成本。我们证明，在适当的简化假设下，这一视角自然导出对 GRPO 的一种简单修改，我们称之为重试感知策略优化（Retry-Aware Policy Optimization，ReAPO）。ReAPO 为失败轨迹分配额外生成机会，使成功重试得到强化而此前的失败不会受到奖励，并以理论上有原则的方式为每次尝试分配信用。在涵盖八项数学与科学推理基准的实验中，ReAPO 在 0.6B 至 4B 的 Qwen3 和 OLMo-2 模型上，相较 GRPO 以及近期常用基线算法提高了首次尝试的表现；更多消融实验则证明了串行采样和 ReAPO 信用分配的作用。在 Qwen3-0.6B 上，ReAPO 的表现还优于组大小翻倍或训练步数翻倍的 GRPO；它以分别少生成 39% 和 31% token 的代价，达到了这两种 GRPO 设定的峰值准确率。总的来说，我们的结果表明，ReAPO 是一种简单而有效的方法，可通过改进探索和采用重试感知信用分配来提升 LM 推理表现。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In case-based legal reasoning, legal professionals identify legally significant fact patterns in a new dispute and compare them with those of decided cases. In AI & Law, HYPO dimensions and CATO factors represent these patterns symbolically, organizing expert knowledge distilled from case narratives as explicit, structured, interpretable, and auditable legal concepts and relations that support case comparison, legal argument, and precedent-based reasoning. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for legal tasks, yet their internal organization of legal knowledge remains difficult to trace. We investigate whether LLMs form internal representations corresponding to all 26 CATO factors. Two research questions examine linear decodability and sparse localization with sparse autoencoders. Experiments cover three open models, Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma-2 2B, supported by cross-model comparison and human audit of controlled natural-language passages. Results show that all 26 factors are linearly decodable in all three models. Single-feature sparse readouts cover the complete factor catalog, with best-layer test AUCs ranging from 0.86 to 1.00. Five selected features approach full-vector readout performance. We report 78 model-specific layer-feature coordinates, one for each factor in each model. Together, these results show that information corresponding to expert-defined legal factors can be read from the internal activations of LLMs processing legal narratives. By locating these readouts, our study connects legal language and the symbolic abstractions of HYPO and CATO to learned internal representations.

In Hidden Messages, a sender compresses its denoising state into four signed dense vectors; the receiver consumes them while retaining its own context, canvas, and trajectory. Removing a message tests whether the channel matters; replacing it with a message from another example tests whether its content matters. Across controlled tasks, derangement removes a +63.6-point advantage on Tiny-A2D and a +100.0-point advantage on Dream-7B, while targeted substitutions steer the receiver toward the substituted fact.     PerMIT: Securing Persistent Memory for LLM Agents via Machine-Checked Integrity Theorems and Scalable Community Trust

    PerMIT：通过机器验证的完整性定理和可扩展的社区信任保障 LLM 智能体的持久记忆安全

    Tanqiu Jiang, Min Bai, Sadat Shahriar, Wanyu Du, Sandesh Swamy

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PerMIT contributes a persistent-memory architecture, machine-checked integrity guarantees, and community sharing for LLM agents, directly advancing agent memory and system design. Multi-turn planning is preserved, but reasoning and compositional generalization are not central contributions.

    PerMIT 为 LLM 智能体提供持久记忆架构、机器验证的完整性保证和社区共享机制，直接推进了智能体记忆与系统设计。该方法保留了多轮规划，但推理和组合泛化并非其核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Persistent memory is a largely undefended surface for injection and poisoning, and the same risk limits memory sharing among agents. We present PerMIT, a memory architecture with provable integrity guarantees under an explicit trust assumption: only user-typed inputs and values confirmed at a gate are trusted. PerMIT mediates the release and use of untrusted environment-derived values through a finite memory interface, while preserving agent-driven multi-turn planning and tool choice. Over this finite interface, we prove two integrity theorems that are also machine-checked in Lean 4, which together ensure that environment-derived memory reaches a sensitive action only if confirmed at the gate and influences the agent's behavior only through what the gate displays. Every attack in our threat model thereby reduces to a single auditable decision, which a human, an LLM verifier, or both can make in practice. On Trojan Hippo, PerMIT records zero observed attack success with self-verification and lightweight verifiers. Because each confirmation is a logged verdict on exact content, endorsements accumulate across users, and sufficiently endorsed items become community-confirmed with no further verification required. Under explicit assumptions, we prove and corroborate in simulation a co-scaling property: as the community grows, the risks of promoting poison and of wrongly evicting benign knowledge fall, while per-user verification effort does not rise. On $\tau^2$-bench, communities of up to 90 autonomous agents use PerMIT to build shared knowledge bases with no direct memory injection promoted, and the resulting knowledge significantly improves new agents on held-out tasks, suggesting a path toward agents that safely self-improve at test time.

    中文

    持久记忆是一个防护薄弱的注入与投毒入口，同样的风险也限制了智能体之间共享记忆。我们提出 PerMIT，这是一种具有可证明完整性保证的记忆架构，其信任假设明确规定：只有用户输入的内容以及在关卡处确认的值才可信。PerMIT 通过一个有限记忆接口，调控源自环境的不可信值的释放与使用，同时保留由智能体驱动的多轮规划和工具选择。我们在这个有限接口上证明了两个完整性定理，并使用 Lean 4 对其进行机器验证；两者共同确保源自环境的记忆只有在关卡处得到确认后才能触及敏感操作，并且只有通过关卡所展示的内容才能影响智能体行为。因此，我们威胁模型中的每种攻击都归结为一个可审计的决策，实践中可由人类、LLM 验证器或两者共同作出。在 Trojan Hippo 上，使用自我验证和轻量级验证器时，PerMIT 记录到的攻击成功次数为零。由于每次确认都是针对确切内容记录的判定，背书会在用户之间累积；获得足够背书的条目会成为社区确认条目，无需进一步验证。在明确假设下，我们证明并通过模拟佐证了一种协同扩展性质：随着社区扩大，投毒内容被推广的风险和无害知识被错误删除的风险都会降低，而每位用户的验证工作量不会增加。在 $\tau^2$-bench 上，最多 90 个自主智能体使用 PerMIT 构建共享知识库，且没有直接注入的记忆被推广；由此形成的知识显著提升了新智能体在留出任务上的表现，这表明智能体有望在测试时安全地自我改进。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Although large language models (LLMs) encode language in highly distributed spaces, they remain vulnerable to focal disruptions---a phenomenon strikingly similar to how localized brain damage causes clinical aphasia in humans. To investigate this theoretical tension, we ask whether LLMs possess a functional structure analogous to the human language system, by introducing a novel mechanistic interpretability framework inspired by aphasia. Through two complementary approaches, classifier-guided lesioning and continuous activation steering, we systematically induce aphasia-like breakdowns in LLMs. We find that language functions can be successfully isolated to discrete structural circuits and continuous representational vectors, yet these functions remain densely entangled with significant circuit overlap and vector similarities across distinct aphasic profiles. Furthermore, while steering generalizes robustly across downstream tasks, structural lesioning remains asymmetrically constrained. By bridging neuropsychology and mechanistic interpretability, we demonstrate that LLMs, functionally analogous to biological brains, rely on a densely entangled architecture that can be systematically mapped through clinically-informed interventions.

The teacher–student setup is incidental to compositional generalization, and does not present a broader agent or systems contribution.

    TeachBack 的核心贡献是一种双向偏好学习方法，它通过塑造教师监督来保留探索、验证和自我纠正能力，从而提升数学和逻辑推理表现。教师—学生设置与组合泛化仅有偶然关联，本文也没有提出更广泛的智能体或系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) enables a language model to learn from a Teacher instantiated from the same model but given access to privileged information, such as a reference solution. We find that access to sufficient privileged information allows the Teacher to generate highly accurate trajectories; however, accuracy alone does not guarantee that these trajectories are suitable for Student learning. Direct access to a complete solution may encourage shortened, reference-conditioned derivations that omit the exploration, verification, and self-correction required to solve problems without privileged information. We introduce TeachBack, a bidirectional preference-learning framework for on-policy self-distillation that learns not only from the Teacher but also how the Teacher should teach. TeachBack shapes the Teacher's generation behavior by controlling the length of the reference-reasoning suffix injected into the prompt and by varying the prompt style. While maintaining comparable Teacher accuracy, it encourages the Teacher to explore and re-solve problems, thereby reducing its reliance on the reference solution. At each rollout refresh, the shared policy generates both a privileged Teacher trajectory and a problem-only Student trajectory. A pairwise preference objective uses privileged Teacher trajectories to improve Student learning, while the reversed preference uses the Student's behavior to shape future Teacher supervision under the privileged condition. Experiments on mathematical and logical reasoning tasks show that TeachBack consistently improves Student performance over existing OPSD methods and related baselines.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Analogical reasoning is widely considered a fundamental component of human intelligence. Few benchmarks are designed to explicitly test far analogical reasoning - reasoning between domains that are superficially dissimilar yet share deep relational or structural similarities. In this work, we introduce an analogical reasoning benchmark called Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus of ANAlogy (ARCANA). The tasks of ARCANA require performing far analogical mappings from real-world objects or physical phenomena to abstract grid-based transformations, different from the well-known ARC-AGI benchmark which primarily emphasized innate human priors. We validate ARCANA through a human study, demonstrating that humans solve these tasks reliably. In contrast, evaluations across a range of large language models show a distinct performance gap compared to humans, revealing systematic failure modes that remain challenging for current models. To address this gap, we propose ConceptSIR, a reasoning framework based on concept slippage, introspection, and reflection. Experiments demonstrate that ConceptSIR enables standard LLMs to solve several challenging ARCANA tasks that were unsolved by direct prompting in our evaluation. Overall, our results suggest that far analogical reasoning remains an open problem for contemporary LLMs. All the materials are available at sites.google.com/view/arcanacogtest. The complete codebase, including benchmark, and ConceptSIR, is publicly available at https://github.com/density-11/arcana-test. All ARCANA data and task instances can be accessed and explored at https://arcanacogtest.org/.

    Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), particularly through group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), has emerged as a central paradigm for the post-training of large language models (LLMs). While RLVR is highly effective at enhancing the reasoning capabilities of LLMs, it commonly induces \textit{distribution sharpening}, whereby the policy distribution becomes excessively peaked and rare-yet-correct trajectories are progressively suppressed, thus diminishing sample diversity. To this end, we promote flat-reward optima in RLVR to smooth the policy distribution. We theoretically link flat reward RLVR to reduced distribution sharpening, and empirically show improved sample diversity while maintaining single-attempt accuracy. Our method, called \texttt{Flat}-RLVR, searches for flat reward regions via sharpness-aware minimization during LLM post-training, combining this with GRPO variants to achieve better trade-offs between sampling efficiency and reasoning capacity.

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied across the scientific discovery pipeline, from synthesizing literature to generating hypotheses to informing experimental design. A unifying principle behind these tasks is the need to continuously update beliefs as evidence accumulates, for which Bayesian inference provides a natural framework. However, existing work assumes that LLMs cannot carry out principled Bayesian belief updating in context, instead relying on simplifications and heuristics. To challenge this assumption, we present a principled evaluation of Bayesian reasoning capabilities in LLMs, analyzing both the model's internal consistency as well as its ability to recover an externally determined posterior. Specifically, we build an evaluation framework spanning qualitative epistemological examples to probe probabilistic coherence, quantitative benchmarks of Bayesian inference capabilities, and analyses of the impact of non-Bayesian updates on downstream task performance. Across different scenarios, we find that LLMs generally violate Bayes' rule when updating their beliefs in context. However, when equipped with modern reasoning abilities and code execution capabilities, their performance drastically improves, enabling even the close approximation of analytically intractable posteriors. Our evaluation shows that current LLMs with access to appropriate tools could already be used to make complex belief updates in scientific discovery, enabling rapid acceleration of the efficiency and scale of AI-powered scientific discovery.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper directly investigates how transformer MLP readers and writers couple, using Jacobian analysis and interventions to characterize a recurring internal mechanism and its training dynamics.     本文直接研究 Transformer MLP 中读取器与写入器如何耦合，并运用雅可比分析和干预来刻画一种反复出现的内部机制及其训练动态。尽管文中将通道描述为成对组件，但组合并非其核心贡献，文章也未涉及推理或模型系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A transformer MLP gives each hidden channel two roles: a reader that decides when the channel responds, and a writer that decides what it adds back to the residual stream. Read as a key--value memory, the layer can be measured one factor set at a time: the pairing of readers to writers is carried only by their shared index, invisible to any quantity computed from one factor set alone. Yet training couples the two factors through their joint update, so we ask what reading them together shows. The block supplies the joint instrument: the MLP writes back into the very stream it reads, so the exact Jacobian of its update is square, and its agreement with its own transpose resolves into reader--writer terms whose inner products give each channel, read as a couple, a signed pairing coordinate. Ranked by this coordinate, each block we measure has a small core of strongly coupled channels; where initialization gives either sign equally, the core is nearly all opposed: each writer points against the direction its reader responds to. This opposed core recurs from the smallest models trained from scratch to released checkpoints; its sign is in place within a few percent of training and holds while the coupling grows. Read as couples, most channels return their contribution against the reader that fired it, and the readers of later blocks take it up; few show in the logits. Training holds the couples in place: flipping the opposed writers moves the output toward common tokens, and a writer permuted onto another reader regrows to fit that reader while the reader stays.

    中文

    Transformer MLP 为每个隐藏通道赋予两种角色：读取器决定该通道何时响应，写入器决定它向残差流中写回什么。若将该层视为键值记忆，可以一次测量一组因子：读取器与写入器的配对仅由它们共享的索引承载，任何仅根据单组因子计算的量都无法体现这种配对。然而，训练会通过联合更新将这两个因子耦合起来，因此我们考察同时读取它们能揭示什么。该模块本身提供了联合分析工具：MLP 写回的正是它所读取的流，因此其更新的精确雅可比矩阵是方阵；它与自身转置矩阵的一致性可分解为读写器项，这些项的内积为每个通道提供一个带符号的配对坐标，可将该通道视为一对来读取。按此坐标排序后，我们测量的每个模块都包含一个由强耦合通道构成的小核心；在初始化时两种符号出现概率相等的情况下，这个核心几乎完全呈相反方向：每个写入器都指向与其读取器响应方向相反的方向。从最小的从头训练模型到已发布的检查点，这种相反方向的核心反复出现；其符号在训练进程仅完成几个百分点时就已确定，并在耦合增强期间保持不变。将大多数通道作为成对单元来观察时，它们会沿触发它的读取器的反方向写回自身贡献，而后续模块的读取器会接收这些贡献；只有少数会在 logits 中显现。训练使这些成对单元保持稳定：翻转方向相反的写入器会使输出偏向常见 token；将一个写入器置换到另一个读取器后，它会重新生长以适配该读取器，而读取器保持不变。

    The paper proposes a framework for agent memory that supports continual learning, with a taxonomy, behavioral evaluation protocol, and scaling model.     本文提出了一个支持持续学习的智能体记忆框架，包含分类体系、行为评估协议和扩展模型。其对智能体记忆和学习系统的关注是系统研究的核心；文中提及的推理和任务迁移并未描述推理机制或组合泛化方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Autonomous agents powered by foundation models can reason, plan, and use tools, but their fixed weights and context limits hinder sustained learning from experience over long-term deployment. While external memory systems attempt to bridge this gap, they mostly act as passive retrieval caches, evaluated primarily by whether they can recall stored facts or past interactions. Whether memory can drive genuine continual learning remains an open question. In this paper, we introduce Memory-Centric Continual Learning (MCCL), arguing that memory should be judged by whether it improves future actions, not merely what it retrieves. MCCL has three main parts. First, a three-axis taxonomy organizes memory by where state is stored (substrates), what form it takes (assets), and how it is managed (policies). This defines a two-loop lifecycle that updates memory state in an inner loop while refining management policies in an outer loop based on task feedback. Second, an evaluation protocol measures retention under interference, adaptation to change, and task transfer to isolate genuine behavioral gains from simple context expansion. Third, a memory scaling framework models how agent performance scales with experience, storage capacity, and compute budgets across non-parametric and parametric memory. Together, these components reframe agent memory from passive lookup to continuous learning, offering a principled route toward self-improving autonomous agents.

    ECHO：新兴的共模隐藏偏移驱动偏好优化中的词汇坍塌

    Yun Li, Ehsan Javanmardi, Simon Thompson, Jiachen Gong, Qunli Zhang, Zifan Zeng, Shiming Liu, Peng Wang, Zixuan Guo, Manabu Tsukada

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies a shared hidden-state offset, traces how it drives vocabulary collapse, and tests interventions that isolate its causal role, directly advancing representation and mechanism analysis. Preference optimization is the setting; it does not substantively address composition, reasoning, or model-system design.

    本文识别出一种共享隐藏状态偏移，追踪其如何驱动词汇坍塌，并通过干预检验其因果作用，直接推进了表征与机制分析。偏好优化是本文的研究背景；文章并未实质涉及组合、推理或模型系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Preference optimization can improve every ranking metric while building a hidden, shared representation shift that the relative loss barely sees, one that can eventually destroy generation. We trace this failure to the common-mode offset, a shared directional shift in the model's hidden states that appears across token positions, prompts, and both chosen and rejected responses. Because it moves chosen and rejected representations together, the relative ranking loss barely reacts to its accumulation. As this offset grows, it projects onto the output layer to form a vocabulary well, elevating a single token's probability until it dominates decoding and causes generation collapse. The isolated offset alone reconstructs the vocabulary well, injecting the learned offset into an untreated base model recreates the collapse where norm-matched random directions do not, and masking this common component from the loss prevents the well in our flagship setting. Under the per-token ranking loss we study, the same collapse appears in 14 of 17 base-model lineages and under full-parameter fine-tuning. Moreover, the offset is not merely an artifact of collapse, since it is already present in textbook DPO and SimPO runs that form no well. Textbook DPO keeps it weakly aligned with any single vocabulary direction even with three times our base budget. Trained from base models for that budget, however, full-parameter SimPO drives it into collapse on both Llama-2 and Llama-3.1, and the same kind of offset grows, without a well, from a public SFT checkpoint under the official SimPO recipe. Across 17 UltraFeedback runs, the better a run ranks held-out responses, the less often two public reward models prefer its samples to the base model's. These findings expose a blind spot in standard ranking metrics and introduce a representation-level signal that can warn of generation collapse before it occurs.

    中文

    偏好优化可以提升所有排序指标，同时形成一种相对损失几乎无法察觉的隐藏共享表征偏移；这种偏移最终可能摧毁生成能力。我们将这种失效归因于共模偏移，即模型隐藏状态中一种共享的方向性偏移，它出现在不同 token 位置、提示以及被选中和被拒绝的响应中。由于它使被选中和被拒绝的表征同步移动，相对排序损失几乎不会对其累积作出反应。随着这种偏移增大，它会投影到输出层，形成一个词汇井，使单个 token 的概率不断升高，直至该 token 主导解码并导致生成坍塌。单独提取该偏移就能重建词汇井；将学得的偏移注入未经处理的基础模型会重现坍塌，而范数匹配的随机方向则不会；在损失中屏蔽这一共同分量，则能在我们的代表性设置中阻止词汇井形成。在我们研究的逐 token 排序损失下，同样的坍塌出现在 17 个基础模型谱系中的 14 个，并且在全参数微调下也会出现。此外，这种偏移并非坍塌造成的单纯假象，因为它在没有形成词汇井的教科书式 DPO 和 SimPO 运行中已经存在。即使使用我们基础预算的三倍，教科书式 DPO 仍使该偏移与任意单一词汇方向仅保持弱对齐。然而，从基础模型出发、使用该预算训练时，全参数 SimPO 会在 Llama-2 和 Llama-3.1 上驱动坍塌；按照官方 SimPO 配方，从公开 SFT 检查点出发也会出现同类偏移增长，尽管并未形成词汇井。在 17 次 UltraFeedback 运行中，一次运行对留出响应的排序越好，两个公开奖励模型将其样本评为优于基础模型样本的频率反而越低。这些发现揭示了标准排序指标的盲点，并提出一种表征层面的信号，可在生成坍塌发生之前发出预警。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Parallel thinking has emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) by exploring multiple reasoning paths simultaneously. However, we identify that parallel thinking via Reinforcement Learning (RL) typically suffers from the mode collapse of reasoning paths, where parallel thinking trajectories degenerate into similar ones. This homogeneity undermines the fundamental motivation of parallel thinking, that is, maintaining multiple hypotheses concurrently to prevent premature loss into a suboptimal solution. In this paper, we propose Diverse Parallel Thinking (DPT), a simple yet effective RL approach for parallel thinking designed to encourage path diversity. DPT rewards the model to develop distinct reasoning strategies by penalizing the prefix similarity of parallel thinking paths, thereby enhancing a more comprehensive exploration of the reasoning space. We conduct various experiments and analyses across multiple reasoning benchmarks to demonstrate the effectiveness of DPT. Results show that DPT successfully outperforms previous parallel thinking methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance over baselines. We validate path diversity as a key element to improve parallel thinking. Our code is available at https://github.com/JiaruQian/DPT.

    ENGLISH

    Long-term agent memory is shifting from predefined workflows toward learnable policies for memory construction and retrieval. Existing learning-based methods either optimize construction alone or combine retrieval-side online reinforcement learning (RL) with offline construction supervision, limiting co-adaptation between the two stages. In this paper, we explore end-to-end online RL for a unified memory manager (Uni-Mem) that learns both capabilities under a shared policy. However, joint optimization with existing RL algorithms such as GRPO faces confounded group comparisons and sparse feedback over long memory-management trajectories. To this end, we propose Stage-Decoupled GRPO, which alternates construction and retrieval optimization while controlling variation from the other stage within each rollout group, yielding stage-specific learning signals. We further introduce Event-Wise Credit Assignment (ECA), which localizes feedback to responsible events and propagates event-level advantages to their constituent operations. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show that Uni-Mem outperforms the strongest RL-based memory, demonstrating the effectiveness of jointly learning memory construction and retrieval via Stage-Decoupled GRPO and ECA.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-term memory for multimodal agents remains challenging, as it must preserve fine-grained visual evidence while tracking entity evolution across sessions. Existing abstraction-based memories compress images into text, often discarding visually discriminative details, whereas pixel-preserving memories retain raw observations but struggle to reliably associate diverse observations with persistent entity identities and track their evolving states. To address these limitations, we propose MHG-Mem, a multimodal hypergraph memory that jointly organizes entity identity, state evolution, and provenance to visual evidence. Specifically, MHG-Mem represents distinct entity mentions and their observed facts as individual nodes, grouping identity-consistent mentions and facts through occurrence hyperedges. It then synthesizes aspect-specific evolution states from these grouped observations and links them to supporting entities, facts, and source evidence through evolutionary and evidential hyperedges. To navigate this structured memory, we introduce hypergraph-based agentic search, which adaptively selects an entry layer, traverses typed hyperedges across memory levels, and inspects source observations when fine-grained verification is required. These designs support both detailed visual verification and reasoning over cross-session state changes. Extensive experiments across three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of MHG-Mem, improving performance by 8.20-9.98% over the strongest baseline.

    Reinforcement learning (RL) based on PPO-style clipping has become an effective approach to improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, standard token-level clipping measures policy change only through the conditional probability of the current token, while the prefix conditioning context is itself generated by the policy. This mismatch becomes especially consequential in long-response and off-policy training. We reformulate autoregressive generation as a finite-horizon Markov decision process and derive its performance-difference identity under behavior-policy sampling. The resulting change of measure identifies the cumulative likelihood ratio of the generated prefix as the exact importance weight for each stepwise policy-improvement term. Starting from the monotonic-improvement principle of trust-region policy optimization, we then construct a prefix-level trust region using the exact reverse-KL coordinate $r-1-\log r$, whose behavior-policy expectation equals the corresponding prefix-distribution KL divergence. This yields EPIC, a PPO-style sequence-clipping method that directly regulates prefix-level policy drift without relying on a local quadratic approximation or expert-routing replay. Experiments on off-policy reinforcement learning with a sparse mixture-of-experts language model show that EPIC consistently outperforms standard and sequence-level clipping baselines across mathematical-reasoning benchmarks, while remaining competitive with routing-replay-based alternatives. Code is available at https://github.com/LiChengxi666/EPIC.

    AI-generated text detectors are increasingly deployed in consequential settings---peer review, education, admissions, journalism, and content moderation---where their outputs directly affect individuals. Yet the strongest detectors are fine-tuned neural classifiers whose decisions are opaque, while transparent alternatives (stylometric and linguistic-feature classifiers) underperform them by wide margins. We accomplish this by training sparse autoencoders (SAEs) directly on a detector's residual stream, assigning auto-interpretation labels to each SAE feature, and retaining only features whose generated descriptions pass a global fidelity threshold. We then train a lightweight classifier on just the interpretable features.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Harness optimization, which improves an agent's prompts, tools, and workflows, is an increasingly effective way to enhance agents built on frozen or closed-source LLMs. Leading approaches such as the Darwin--Godel Machine and the Huxley--Godel Machine (HGM) rely on recursive self-improvement and were developed mainly for coding, where the competence needed to improve the agent coincides with the competence being improved. Planning tasks, in which an agent must produce a sequence of tool calls that jointly satisfies interacting constraints, break this alignment. There, open-ended self-modification repeatedly explores ineffective changes and consumes substantial evaluation budgets. We introduce HGM-Dual, a diagnostic-guided framework for budget-efficient harness evolution for planning agents. First, HGM-Dual represents agent evolution as lineage-aware context. This context records what each ancestor changed, which behaviors improved or regressed, and which modifications were ineffective, giving the editor explicit edit-outcome attribution instead of an unstructured archive of past agents. Second, HGM-Dual introduces error-conditioned dual-path child generation. For each selected parent, it generates a general child that preserves open-ended exploration and specialized children that target the harness components most likely responsible for the parent's highest-ranked constraint violations. HGM-Dual outperforms the strongest baseline by up to 14.45% relative improvement in case accuracy while matching HGM variants' final performance with 2x-4x fewer evaluation budget.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The main contribution is a graph-structured coordination algorithm for merging parallel agents’ edits, with guarantees on retained improvement and convergence. This directly advances multi-agent organization and scheduling; its optimization framing has only an incidental connection to general reasoning or compositionality.

    主要贡献是一种图结构协调算法，用于合并并行智能体的修改，并对保留的改进和收敛提供保证。这直接推动了多智能体组织与调度；其优化建模与一般推理或组合性的关联仅属附带。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Parallel AI agents can produce useful local edits yet degrade a shared solution when their edits are combined. We model this coordination problem as discrete block optimization with an exactly evaluable objective and a known dependency graph. Independent sets certify compatible edits whose verified gains, measured against the same current solution, add exactly. A coordinator constructs a safe compatible candidate and can also evaluate interacting edits to capture favorable interactions. We prove that an optimal fractional coloring yields a merger that preserves a $1/\chi_f(G)$ fraction of the total verified local improvement, where $\chi_f(G)$ is the graph's fractional chromatic number. This guarantee is tight among mergers that select a subset of the same proposals. Under conditional local-improvement guarantees and a block error-bound condition, repeated collaboration converges geometrically in the objective gap. The rate separates task structure, agent allocation, and computation cost, yielding a linear program for agent assignment and an explicit time-cost trade-off. Code-repair experiments show that verified merging resolves conflicts between individually useful edits that cause naive merging to fail. On larger conflict-free tasks, parallel agents reduce modeled completion time at higher input-token-equivalent cost. On three public road networks, fractional integration retains 922 units of verified graph-cut improvement across 90 paired runs. For route-search agents sharing exclusive access to vehicle routes, fractional scheduling reduces measured wall time by a median of 15% across twelve paired runs, with route-cost changes varying across runs.

    Reinforcement learning (RL) is an effective way to strengthen the long-context reasoning of large language models (LLMs), but it needs training data that are long, diverse, challenging, and verifiable. Human annotation of such data is expensive, naturally occurring data are too scarce to sustain RL, and existing synthesis methods depend on external corpora or stronger teacher models, which become harder to obtain as the trained models get stronger. Recently, RL from zero data, in which a model learns from tasks it proposes itself, has achieved excellent performance, but existing methods target short-context tasks. Therefore, we propose $\textbf{LongZero}$, a method that lets an LLM improve its own long-context reasoning without any external data. Instead of writing questions and answers over existing documents, LongZero first has the model synthesize the question and answer with its supporting evidence in a compact structured form, and only then separately expands the evidence into a long multi-document context. LongZero combines these self-written multi-hop reasoning tasks with self-written multi-round retrieval tasks and trains the model with GRPO. We evaluate LongZero on two LLMs across five long-context reasoning benchmarks and compare it with RL on data synthesized from external corpora. Experimental results show that LongZero can generalize to real tasks, and outperforms both baselines, suggesting a viable and promising path to improving long-context reasoning of LLMs.

    Understanding the internal mechanisms of deep neural networks remains a central challenge in machine learning. In computer vision, one promising yet only preliminarily explored approach is feature inversion via inverse networks, which reconstructs images from intermediate representations using trained inverse networks. In this study, we revisit feature inversion via inverse networks, introducing a novel, modular variant that enables a computationally more efficient application of the technique while, in some cases, producing semantically more coherent image reconstructions. We apply our method to large-scale transformer-based vision models, specifically Detection Transformer, Vision Transformer, Swin Transformer, and Data-Efficient Image Transformer, analyzing the resulting reconstructions across network depth. Our main analysis compares Detection Transformer and Vision Transformer, which exhibit the most informative differences among the evaluated architectures. At the same time, results for Swin Transformer and Data-Efficient Image Transformer support the broader applicability of our framework. Our findings reveal gradual representational changes across transformer layers as a shared characteristic of Detection Transformer and Vision Transformer, as well as systematic differences in how they preserve contextual shape and fine-grained image details, and in their robustness to color perturbations.     Analytical solutions to differential equations offer exact, interpretable insight but are rarely available because discovering them requires expert intuition or exhaustive search of combinatorial spaces. We introduce SIGS, a neuro-symbolic framework for equation-driven closed-form solution discovery. SIGS uses a context-free grammar to generate mathematically valid and physically meaningful building blocks, with a user-specified Ansatz prescribing how these blocks combine, embeds them into a topology-regularised continuous latent manifold, and searches this manifold in two stages: structure selection followed by coefficient refinement using gradient descent, scoring candidates only against the PDE residual and prescribed boundary and initial conditions. This design unifies symbolic reasoning with numerical optimization; the grammar constrains candidate solution blocks to be proper by construction, while the latent search makes exploration tractable and data-free. SIGS is the first neuro-symbolic method to (i) recover analytical solutions for coupled nonlinear PDE systems, (ii) discover equivalent symbolic forms when the grammar lacks the natural primitives, and (iii) produce accurate symbolic approximations for PDEs lacking known closed-form solutions.     Kate A. Richardson, Sokratis Trifinopoulos, and Mike Williams

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes internal representation geometry and hierarchically factorizes predictions, connecting learned structure to nuclear physics and symbolic models; this is substantial transferable interpretability insight. The factorization is not presented as a study of compositional generalization, and nuclear-mass prediction alone does not support the other directions.

    本文分析内部表示几何，并对预测进行层级因子分解，将学习到的结构与核物理和符号模型联系起来，提供了重要且可迁移的可解释性洞见。该因子分解并非作为组合泛化研究提出，而单独的核质量预测也不支持其他方向。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Obtaining high-precision predictions of nuclear masses, or equivalently nuclear binding energies, $E_b$, remains an important goal in nuclear-physics research. Recently, many AI-based tools have shown promising results on this task, some achieving precision that surpasses the best physics models. However, the utility of these AI models remains in question given that predictions are only useful where measurements do not exist, which inherently requires extrapolation away from the training (and testing) samples. Since AI models are largely black boxes, the reliability of such an extrapolation is difficult to assess. We present an AI model that not only achieves cutting-edge precision for $E_b$, but does so in an interpretable manner. For example, we find that (and explain why) the most important dimensions of its internal representation form a double helix, where the analog of the hydrogen bonds in DNA here link the number of protons and neutrons found in the most stable nucleus of each isotopic chain. Furthermore, we show that the AI prediction of $E_b$ can be factorized and ordered hierarchically, with the most important terms corresponding to well-known symbolic models (such as the famous liquid drop). Remarkably, the improvement of the AI model over symbolic ones can almost entirely be attributed to an observation made by Jaffe in 1969 based on the structure of most known nuclear ground states. The end result is a fully interpretable data-driven model of nuclear masses based on physics deduced by AI.

    中文

    获得核质量，或等价地说核结合能，$E_b$仍是核物理研究的重要目标。近年来，许多基于 AI 的工具在这项任务上展现出良好结果，其中一些工具达到的精度超过了最好的物理模型。然而，鉴于这些 AI 模型只有在不存在测量数据的地方才能发挥作用，而这必然要求它们从训练样本（以及测试样本）向外推断，因此其效用仍受到质疑。由于 AI 模型大多是黑箱，难以评估这种外推的可靠性。我们提出一种 AI 模型，它不仅在$E_b$方面达到了最先进的精度，而且还具有可解释性。例如，我们发现（并解释了原因），其内部表示中最重要的维度形成了双螺旋；其中类似于 DNA 氢键的结构连接了每条同位素链中最稳定原子核的质子数和中子数。此外，我们表明，AI 对$E_b$的预测可以进行因子分解并按层级排序，其中最重要的项对应于广为人知的符号模型（如著名的液滴模型）。值得注意的是，AI 模型相较于符号模型的改进几乎完全可以归因于 Jaffe 在 1969 年基于大多数已知核基态结构提出的一项观察。最终得到的是一个完全可解释、数据驱动的核质量模型，其依据的是 AI 推导出的物理规律。

We introduce a novel framework that closes this gap with two components: (1) COGRE, a cognitively-inspired reasoning framework that structures RE into a series of processes mimicking human text-processing; and (2) HIT@DICT, a reinforcement learning intermediate reward strategy that encourages reasoning to align with relational labels by rewarding relation-relevant phrases in reasoning.     Chen Wang, Zhaochun Li, Jionghao Bai, Hexuan Deng, Guanting Dong, Ge Lan, Yue Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes entropy dynamics in RL post-training and proposes temperature-adaptive positive-sample regularization to stabilize exploration, with empirical reasoning-performance gains. This substantially advances training for reasoning, while its policy control is a limited systems connection and the abstract gives no interpretability or composition contribution.

    本文分析 RL 后训练中的熵动态，并提出温度自适应正样本正则化来稳定探索，同时实证展示了推理性能的提升。这显著推进了推理训练；策略控制与系统的关联有限，摘要也没有涉及可解释性或组合方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning (RL) is a key paradigm for post-training large language models (LLMs), but the widely used Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) often suffers from entropy collapse: exploration quickly disappears, policies converge prematurely, and sample diversity declines, ultimately harming training effectiveness. Existing remedies, including entropy bonuses and clip-based methods, rarely keep entropy within a stable exploration regime and often introduce oscillatory entropy or reward degradation. In this work, we identify a previously overlooked asymmetry in entropy dynamics: under high-temperature sampling, positive and negative samples have opposite effects on policy entropy. Specifically, high-temperature positive samples promote entropy growth, whereas negative samples suppress it. We provide a qualitative theoretical explanation for this phenomenon: when entropy decreases during policy updates, its derivative with respect to temperature is strictly positive under positive sample updates, indicating that high-temperature positive samples can counteract entropy decay, thereby slowing entropy collapse and potentially reversing it. Motivated by this insight, we propose SCOPE-RL, a stable entropy control framework through a regularization term constructed from temperature-adaptive positive samples. Extensive experiments show that SCOPE-RL consistently outperforms strong RL baselines on both Pass@1 and Pass@k. Our results provide evidence that escaping entropy collapse can improve reasoning performance, while our quantitative empirical analysis further reveals a non-monotonic entropy-performance relationship, with an optimal level of exploration for RL post-training in reasoning LLMs. Our code is available at https://github.com/597358816/SCOPE-RL.

    强化学习（RL）是大型语言模型（LLM）后训练的一种关键范式，但广泛使用的组相对策略优化（GRPO）常遭遇熵坍塌：探索迅速消失，策略过早收敛，样本多样性下降，最终损害训练效果。现有补救方法包括熵奖励和基于裁剪的方法，但它们很少能将熵维持在稳定的探索区间内，而且往往会导致熵振荡或奖励退化。在这项工作中，我们发现了熵动态中一个此前被忽视的不对称性：在高温采样下，正样本和负样本对策略熵的影响相反。具体而言，高温正样本会促进熵增长，而负样本会抑制熵增长。我们为这一现象提供了定性理论解释：当策略更新期间熵降低时，在正样本更新下，熵对温度的导数严格为正，这表明高温正样本能够抵消熵衰减，从而减缓熵坍塌，甚至可能使其逆转。受这一洞见启发，我们提出 SCOPE-RL，这是一种通过由温度自适应正样本构建的正则项实现稳定熵控制的框架。大量实验表明，SCOPE-RL 在 Pass@1 和 Pass@k 上均持续优于强 RL 基线。结果表明，摆脱熵坍塌能够提升推理性能；我们的定量实证分析进一步揭示了熵与性能之间的非单调关系，并指出 RL 后训练的推理型 LLM 存在一个最优探索水平。代码见 https://github.com/597358816/SCOPE-RL。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    Learning disentangled representations, where semantic features are independently captured in a latent space, is dominated by Variational Auto Encoders (VAE) and Adversarial Training. In this paper, we provide direct quantitative and visual evidence that these methods consistently fail to enforce the target factorized representation on the aggregate posterior, leading to entangled representations. We quantify this failure using the Latent Predictability Score (LPS), an unsupervised metric of mutual predictability that empirically lower bounds the level of entanglement in a latent space. To address these limitations, we leverage the non-parametric Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to directly sculpt the aggregate posterior enabling programmable priors. We demonstrate (1) state-of-the-art unsupervised statistical independence, with a 70% reduction in detected entanglement compared to leading baselines; (2) the flexibility to optionally inject semi-supervised information for explicit semantic alignment; and (3) precise shaping of the aggregate posterior distribution (validated through quantization-aware training) without sacrificing reconstruction quality.
