    Nikolaus Kopp, Franz Pernkopf, Bernhard Geiger

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies temporal compression in recurrent networks and uses controlled interventions to connect it to class separability, temporal stationarity, and capacity, including effects on task memory and generalization. This provides substantial transferable insight into representation dynamics, while the abstract does not center on compositionality, reasoning, or system organization.

    本文研究循环网络中的时间压缩，并通过受控干预将其与类别可分性、时间平稳性和容量联系起来，包括对任务记忆和泛化的影响。这为表征动态提供了具有广泛适用性的深入见解；摘要并未以组合性、推理或系统组织为中心。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Information-theoretic and geometric compression have been widely studied as possible explanations for generalization. Yet their temporal dynamics in recurrent networks remain largely unexplored. Using discretized LSTMs, whose finite embedding space enables direct estimates of information quantities, we observe pronounced compression across the final timesteps of many datasets. We explain this effect through three competing mechanisms: (i) class separability permits stronger compression at the final timestep; (ii) shared recurrent dynamics propagate this pressure across timesteps with similar activation states, making its extent depend on temporal stationarity; and (iii) limited representational capacity opposes prolonged compression because it restricts information available for subsequent computation. We systematically test these mechanisms through controlled synthetic interventions and real-world sequence tasks. Our results identify class separability, temporal stationarity, and network capacity as key determinants of temporal compression, and suggest that compression acts as a regularizer-potentially beneficial when excess capacity is available, but harmful to generalization when it consumes memory needed for the task.

    信息论压缩和几何压缩已被广泛研究，作为泛化的可能解释。然而，它们在循环网络中的时间动态仍很少得到探索。我们使用离散化 LSTM，其有限嵌入空间使得信息量可以直接估计，并观察到许多数据集在最后几个时间步出现显著压缩。我们通过三种相互竞争的机制解释这一现象：(i) 类别可分性使最后一个时间步能够实现更强压缩；(ii) 共享的循环动态会将这种压力传播到激活状态相似的时间步，因此其影响范围取决于时间平稳性；(iii) 表征容量有限会阻碍压缩持续进行，因为这会限制后续计算可用的信息。我们通过受控的合成干预和真实世界序列任务系统地检验这些机制。结果表明，类别可分性、时间平稳性和网络容量是时间压缩的关键决定因素，并提示压缩具有正则化作用——在存在过剩容量时可能有益，但若压缩消耗了任务所需的记忆，则会损害泛化。

    ENGLISH

    Drug discovery remains a resource-intensive and time-consuming process, involving billions of dollars and a decade of development to advance a drug to market. While many in silico tools have accelerated this process, operating them still demands substantial time, effort, and expertise from medicinal chemists. Autonomous systems built on Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising solution, yet current designs limit their performance. Existing single-agent systems scale poorly to long-horizon, multi-step, and realistic tasks, whereas multi-agent systems typically execute predefined workflows that cannot capture the iterative, non-linear nature of a real drug discovery campaign. Here, we present MADDIE, a multi-agent drug discovery engine. It comprises a central agent, Orchestrator, and four specialized worker agents: HitIdentifier, LeadOptimizer, Synthesizer, and Evaluator, each representing a critical step in a drug discovery campaign. Across 50 protein targets, MADDIE produces molecules satisfying key property requirements and their synthesis routes, outperforming existing agentic systems, generative models, and general-purpose LLMs by a wide margin. Our analysis reveals how these agents collaborate and that MADDIE can employ different strategies across targets to achieve the campaign's goal, while still being efficient in time and tokens. Together, they demonstrate MADDIE as a low-cost, effective, and efficient autonomous engine for accelerating drug discovery. Code and dataset is available via https://github.com/ninglab/MADDIE.

    Xupeng Chen, Chenqian Le, Jiayi Cheng, Runhao Li, Michael Yue

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper measures reproducible post-training changes in activation geometry and calibrates them against run-to-run noise, a substantial contribution to representation analysis.     本文测量并分析了可复现的后训练激活几何变化，并将其与运行间噪声校准；这是对表征分析的重要贡献。其因果扫描并未证明机制发生改变，摘要也未显示其与组合性、推理或系统有实质关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A model diff credits post-training with whatever separates a base checkpoint from one post-trained descendant, presuming a rerun would land close by. On the sparse co-activation graph of Qwen3-1.7B it does not: two LoRA-SFT reruns sit over half as far apart as either sits from the base. We score each base-to-post contrast against the run-to-run band of its own recipe, and show that $k$ runs certify no better than $p=1/(k+1)$ under run exchangeability, however large the effect, so the band $z$-score is a descriptive scale. SFT leaves a large, reproducible signature: base $\to$ SFT displaces the graph by 17.8 pairwise-distance SDs beyond the mean distance between four independent LoRA-SFT runs, and the pre-registered estimator replicates on Llama-3.1-8B with Llama-Scope. At 29 steps each, four SFT and four DPO runs occupy disjoint displacement ranges, a gap $5.0\times$ and $5.6\times$ the spreads of the two arms, without any band. All bands use graphs built on one GPU architecture. Three other readings stop short of a verdict: DPO band counts (3/4, 1/4, 3/4 contrasts outside at 12, 29, 60 steps) show no consistent dose ordering while its displacement stays flat; light GRPO is a secondary non-detection, not an absence, and we run no equivalence test; and the graph concentration read as an RL signature is already in the zero-RL base. A pre-registered causal sweep at three edge budgets on 4,816 held-out prompts found the displaced sources load-bearing ($12\times$ a matched random control in mean, $3.5\times$ in median at 10,000 edges), but their stage-specificity interaction reversed at two budgets and the third failed its faithfulness gate, so we claim calibrated structural displacement, not a changed mechanism.     中文

    Natural Language Autoencoders (NLAs) are proposed as oversight tools for language models: an Activation Verbaliser (AV) writes an English explanation of an activation vector, and an Activation Reconstructor (AR) maps the explanation back to a vector. Their value for oversight depends on a human monitor being able to tell a true account of an activation from a false one, given the AV's explanation. We formalise NLA training and NLA oversight deployment as two different referential games from Emergent Communication: training is a generative referential game, while oversight is a discriminative, multi-modal, partially-observable referential game played over a many-to-many relation between the monitored language model's activations and the accounts that are true of them. The gap between the two games predicts that AV's explanations will identify which activation they describe without discriminating its true account from closely matched false ones, since training never asks explanations to rule anything out. Using the NLA's own AR as a maximally-sympathetic surrogate monitor model, we experimentally confirm this theoretical insight on one released checkpoint: true accounts beat accounts of other activations in all 320 comparisons, but beat fluent rivals differing in a single claim only 60.2% of the time (standard error 6.7%, chance at 50%, $n = 35$). A meaning-preserving rewrite by an uninvolved model costs only 2.1% of the distance to another activation's account, so the failure is not due to the NLA pair having developed private conventions in the AV's explanations. Our rival accounts test only transcript-level truths, which the monitored language model's conversation settles, so these results bound the easiest case and leave claims about the monitored model's own processing untested. We state conjectures that would make both results consequences of the framework.

    中文

    自然语言自编码器（NLA）被提出作为语言模型的监督工具：激活表述器（AV）用英语解释激活向量，激活重构器（AR）则将解释映射回向量。它们能否用于监督，取决于人类监测者能否根据 AV 的解释区分对激活的真实描述和虚假描述。我们将 NLA 训练和 NLA 监督部署形式化为源自涌现式通信的两种不同指称博弈：训练是生成式指称博弈，而监督是判别式、多模态、部分可观测的指称博弈，它在被监测语言模型的激活与对这些激活成立的描述之间的多对多关系上进行。两种博弈之间的差异预示着，AV 的解释能够识别其描述的是哪个激活，却无法将真实描述与极为相似的虚假描述区分开来，因为训练从未要求解释排除任何可能性。我们将 NLA 自身的 AR 用作尽可能有利于 NLA 的代理监测模型，在一个已发布的检查点上通过实验确认了这一理论洞见：在全部 320 次比较中，真实描述都胜过其他激活的描述；但面对仅有一项主张不同、表达流畅的竞争描述时，真实描述仅有 60.2% 的胜率（标准误为 6.7%，随机水平为 50%，$n = 35$）。由无关模型进行的保留语义改写，其与另一激活描述之间的距离仅增加 2.1%，因此这种失败并非 NLA 配对在 AV 解释中形成了私有约定所致。我们的竞争描述测试仅涉及对话所确定的转录文本层面事实，因此这些结果界定的是最简单情形，尚未检验关于被监测模型自身处理过程的主张。我们提出一些猜想，使这两项结果都能由该框架推导得出。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multilingual models share capacity across languages, so adding languages can hurt performance on existing ones. Mixture-of-experts models expand this capacity with little additional per-token computation. Given this extra capacity, does adding experts reduce what each additional language costs? To answer this question, we propose a repetition-aware joint scaling law relating number of active parameters, training tokens per language, number of experts, and language coverage. Fitted on 26,300 per-language loss observations from 64 pretrained configurations, our law reduces prediction error on held-out configurations by 28% relative to the strongest evaluated baseline. At matched number of active parameters and training tokens per language, 32 experts reduce the loss penalty of expanding from 12 to 200 languages by 83% compared with a dense model. Our law further shows that broader language coverage favors more experts across a wider range of compute budgets, guiding capacity allocation as multilingual models scale.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SkillNEO evolves reusable procedural artifacts for agents by separately choosing versions to deploy and continue improving, using execution evidence to guide repairs; results show skills transfer across models. This substantially advances agent skill optimization and reuse, with a partial connection to composition through reusable procedures, but no model-internal or reasoning mechanism is established.

    SkillNEO 通过分别选择要部署和继续改进的版本，并依据执行证据指导修复，来进化可复用的智能体程序产物；结果显示这些技能能迁移到不同模型。这实质性推进了智能体技能优化与复用，并通过可复用程序与组合性有一定关联，但并未确立模型内部机制或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agent skills turn procedural knowledge into reusable artifacts, allowing LLM agents to accumulate and refine expertise through experience. Building on this, skill evolution iteratively improves skills using execution feedback. However, improvement may require several interdependent edits, so low-reward versions can still be worth developing. Requiring immediate reward gains can discard useful partial repairs before their benefits emerge. Non-elitist evolution allows new versions to receive further edits despite scoring below earlier ones. For agent skills, this calls for evidence of what to preserve and repair next. We introduce SkillNEO (Non-Elitist Evolutionary Optimization for Agent Skills), which separately selects a version to use and versions to keep improving. Comparing how related versions perform the same task reveals working steps to preserve and remaining failures to fix. It can also revisit and revise earlier versions using later evidence. Across 86 SkillsBench tasks in eight domains, including software engineering and office work, SkillNEO raises GPT-5.4 Mini's average reward from 49.1% to 66.4%, within GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.6 Luna's original-skill range. Mini executes tasks, proposes revisions, and edits skills; final evaluation uses the same task instances. Gains span all eight domains. The same skills improve stronger models without further editing. On the 41 tasks with modified skills, reuse improves Luna by 10.5 percentage points and places GPT-5.5 10.6 points above its published original-skill reference. Execution records show these skills can benefit stronger models even when Mini still fails some task requirements. Search histories also show lower-scoring versions leading to skills ultimately selected for use. Together, these findings show that skill evolution can turn a weaker model's partial progress into reusable procedural knowledge for improving more capable agents.

    中文

    智能体技能将程序性知识转化为可复用的产物，使 LLM 智能体能够通过经验积累和精进专业能力。在此基础上，技能进化利用执行反馈迭代改进技能。然而，改进可能需要多项相互依赖的编辑，因此奖励较低的版本仍值得继续开发。若要求奖励立即提升，可能会在有益的部分修复显现效果之前将其丢弃。非精英式进化允许新版本即使得分低于早期版本，仍继续接受编辑。对于智能体技能而言，这需要根据证据判断应保留什么以及下一步应修复什么。我们提出 SkillNEO（智能体技能的非精英式进化优化），分别选择要使用的版本和要继续改进的版本。通过比较相关版本执行相同任务的表现，可以发现应保留的有效步骤和仍需修复的问题。它还可以根据后续证据重新审视并修改早期版本。在涵盖八个领域（包括软件工程和办公工作）的 86 项 SkillsBench 任务中，SkillNEO 将 GPT-5.4 Mini 的平均奖励从 49.1% 提升至 66.4%，达到 GPT-5.5 和 GPT-5.6 Luna 原始技能表现范围之内。Mini 执行任务、提出修订建议并编辑技能；最终评估使用相同的任务实例。八个领域的表现均有所提升。同一批技能无需进一步编辑，也能提升更强模型的表现。在技能经过修改的 41 项任务上，复用技能使 Luna 的表现提高了 10.5 个百分点，并使 GPT-5.5 比其已发表的原始技能基准高出 10.6 个百分点。执行记录表明，即使 Mini 仍无法满足部分任务要求，这些技能也能使更强模型受益。搜索历史还显示，得分较低的版本最终也可能促成被选用的技能。总之，这些发现表明，技能进化可以将较弱模型取得的部分进展转化为可复用的程序性知识，从而提升更强智能体的能力。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    OPRD trains coding agents to use contextual information and tool feedback across long-horizon tasks, combining self-imitation with reminder-conditioned teacher supervision.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reliable repository-level coding requires agents not only to generate correct code but also to preserve constraints and respond to tool feedback across long interactions. However, our diagnostic analysis shows that agents often fail to act on relevant information already available in context, while final Pass/Fail outcomes provide only sparse process supervision. We introduce On-Policy Reminder Distillation (OPRD), which combines Multi-Scope Reminder supervision with outcome-based routing on reminder-free student rollouts. Successful rollouts provide autoregressive self-imitation targets, whereas failed rollouts receive Reminder-conditioned reverse-KL supervision from a teacher that re-evaluates the same student-generated prefixes. A Global Reminder converts final-test diagnostics into trajectory-level guidance, while Turn-local Reminders apply only to the next decision following the relevant environment observation. The teacher and student share a two-stage initialization from Coding SFT and Instruction-Following (IF) SFT. At inference, the student operates without Reminders. On SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Pro, and SWE-bench Multilingual, OPRD improves the benchmark-averaged task resolution rate by 11.3 points over the open-source Qwen3.5-4B base model. Under the same diagnostic protocol, it reduces the aggregate error-event count from 446 to 222, a 50.2% reduction.

    可靠的仓库级编码要求智能体不仅生成正确代码，还要在长时间交互中保留约束并响应工具反馈。然而，我们的诊断分析显示，智能体经常无法利用上下文中已经存在的相关信息，而最终的通过/失败结果只能提供稀疏的过程监督。我们提出在线策略提醒蒸馏（OPRD），将多范围提醒监督与基于结果的路由结合起来，作用于不含提醒的学生模型轨迹。成功轨迹提供自回归自模仿目标；失败轨迹则接受提醒条件化的反向 KL 监督，监督信号来自重新评估相同学生模型生成前缀的教师模型。全局提醒将最终测试诊断转化为轨迹级指导，而轮次局部提醒只作用于相关环境观察之后的下一次决策。教师模型和学生模型采用相同的两阶段初始化：编码 SFT 和指令遵循（IF）SFT。在推理时，学生模型不使用提醒。在 SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench Pro 和 SWE-bench Multilingual 上，与开源 Qwen3.5-4B 基础模型相比，OPRD 将基准平均任务解决率提高了 11.3 分。在相同诊断协议下，它将错误事件总数从 446 降至 222，减少了 50.2%。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Conditional Program compresses n-gram lookup tables using shared reconstruction and independently decodable row codes, reducing storage while preserving output quality. This is a substantial memory and model-efficiency contribution relevant to Systems; the reported row statistics concern compression behavior, not internal model mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    条件程序通过共享重建和可独立解码的行代码压缩 n-gram 查找表，在保持输出质量的同时减少存储量。这是对内存和模型效率的重要贡献，与系统研究相关；文中报告的行统计反映的是压缩行为，并不涉及内部模型机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Conditional memory expands language-model capacity through selective lookup, but the full embedding table must remain available for every possible input. We introduce Conditional Program (CP), a compressed representation that reconstructs only the rows an input requests. CP represents each row by a short code and a local scale, with a reconstruction program shared across the table. We instantiate this representation with a Gaussian trellis, norm restoration and independently decodable row records. CP's two-bit code lowers output KL by 41--63\% relative to 2-bit round-to-nearest. Analysis across three trained n-gram memory families shows that Gaussian-like coordinate statistics coexist with learned relationships among rows; at matched storage budgets, the shared trellis outperforms the fitted codebooks and low-rank residual variants we test. For DeepSeek, it reduces table storage from 203GB to 51GB, leaving room for larger workloads when the table is kept on GPU.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

Dependency-aware task composition and agent learning are substantive, but the abstract centers on benchmark and system design rather than general compositional reasoning mechanisms.

    WEAVE 构建依赖结构化的仓库任务，并提出以测试为依据的进展指标，用于训练和评估长期运行的代码智能体。依赖感知的任务组合和智能体学习具有实质性意义，但摘要重点在基准与系统设计，而非通用组合推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Real-world software engineering rarely consists of isolated changes. Features, migrations, and systematic fixes often unfold across multiple pull requests (PRs), requiring coordinated modifications across a repository. Yet most executable repository-level benchmarks retain a single issue or PR as the task unit, while existing multi-PR settings rely on coarse aggregation and structure-agnostic evaluation. This mismatch obscures dependencies among changes and limits progress measurement and learning signals for long-horizon code agents. We introduce WEAVE, a framework that transforms verified PR histories into executable, dependency-structured tasks. WEAVE leverages repository-calibrated typed change loci to organize related PRs into bounded DAGs and instantiate each as a unified executable task. We further introduce Graph Credit, a deterministic, test-grounded metric that measures dependency-consistent partial progress and supports dense, verifiable rewards for reinforcement learning. Experiments on task construction, agent evaluation, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning show that WEAVE yields coherent executable tasks, enables more faithful progress measurement than flat scoring, and provides effective supervision and verifiable rewards for training code agents.

    From Natural Language Intent to Executable Control: Hierarchical Feedback-Guided LLM Planning for Multi-component Cyber-Physical Systems

    从自然语言意图到可执行控制：面向多组件信息物理系统的分层反馈引导式 LLM 规划

    Jinglin Dai, Jiawan Wang, Ruiqi Hong, Lei Bu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The contribution is a feedback-guided LLM planning method that diagnoses plan inconsistencies and control failures to produce executable CPS plans, advancing planning and agent task execution. Its hierarchical structure is only an incidental connection to composition, and it offers no insight into internal representations.

    该工作的贡献是一种反馈引导的 LLM 规划方法，通过诊断计划不一致和控制失败来生成可执行的 CPS 计划，从而推进规划和智能体任务执行。其分层结构与组合性的联系只是偶然的，也没有揭示内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) provide a convenient interface for translating natural language commands into task plans for cyber-physical systems (CPSs). However, two gaps hinder their use for real execution: generated plans may misinterpret or omit the user's intent, and even a logically plausible plan may be infeasible under component dynamics, interactions, or safety constraints. Existing LLM-based planning approaches often lack informative feedback on why a generated plan fails, providing little guidance for revising the plan accordingly. To address these challenges, we present a hierarchical feedback framework that uses different types of feedback information to guide LLMs in generating executable plans for CPSs. We prompt LLMs to generate both a structured task plan and corresponding signal temporal logic (STL) constraints, and design a sound algorithm that identifies definite contradictions between them and provides feedback for revising inconsistencies. At the execution level, when control synthesis fails, we extract different types of diagnostic information, such as violated constraints and conflicting component assignments, and feed them back to guide task replanning. Experiments on seven heterogeneous multi-component CPS scenarios have shown that our framework can generate executable plans and feasible control executions that satisfy the original natural language missions with a success rate of 87.9% with GPT-5.

    As assistants move from reactive answering toward proactive intervention, memory changes role: it no longer only supplies the answer to a query, it determines whether and when to speak at all. Prior work in this setting hands the system the relevant fact in context; we study the regime that makes the problem hard, where the evidence justifying an intervention must be mined from a long-horizon personal memory. We introduce MemoProBench, a benchmark for memory-driven proactive assistance (MPA), pairing egocentric video with year-long, distractor-rich user memories (~618K tokens on average), human-verified trigger windows, and a protocol that scores content and timing jointly. Every baseline we evaluate performs poorly (at most 15%), including frontier models given summarized or retrieval-augmented memory. A controlled study explains why: with oracle evidence delivered inside the trigger window GPT-5.3-Chat reaches 96%; letting it choose the timing drops it to 38%, and replacing oracle evidence with retrieval drops it to 15%. Content and timing are separately necessary, and missing either is catastrophic.     First Passage Attention

    首次通过注意力

    Yuxuan Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    FPA introduces an attention mechanism that uses path extrema to retain structurally relevant keys, with theoretical expressivity results and experiments on retrieval and cache compression. The stack-like retention pattern offers a partial connection to structured composition, while the main contribution advances attention computation and memory use in model systems.

    FPA 提出一种利用路径极值保留结构相关键的注意力机制，并给出理论表达能力结果以及检索和缓存压缩实验。其类似栈的保留模式与结构化组合存在一定联系，而其主要贡献在于推进注意力计算和模型系统的内存使用。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Augmenting softmax attention with forget gates typically relies on summing decay contributions along the key--query path. Because such accumulation is monotonic, these mechanisms cannot selectively erase intermediate context while preserving older, structurally relevant tokens. We propose First Passage Attention (FPA), which shifts from path summation to path extrema by lowering a key's logit proportionally to the deepest dip of a learned scalar field below that key's level over the intervening span. FPA encompasses the Forgetting Transformer (FoX) as a special case, and when the field and levels follow a shared learned walk, the alive keys with unpenalised logits naturally form a stack. We show that a constant-dimension FPA head realises any subset of keys left alive by subsequent dips, whereas softmax heads with positional biases or token-level forget gates require a head dimension linear in the number of keys. In synthetic experiments, one-layer FPA heads converge to these target sets while comparable softmax and FoX baselines fail on every seed. Scaling to a 110M-parameter language model, FPA matches FoX in perplexity and uniquely achieves perfect passkey retrieval at $8\times$ the training length, even with its key--value cache compressed to about $25\%$.

    通过遗忘门增强 softmax 注意力，通常依赖于沿键—查询路径累加衰减贡献。由于这种累积是单调的，这些机制无法在保留较早且结构上相关的 token 的同时，有选择地擦除中间上下文。我们提出首次通过注意力（First Passage Attention，FPA），它从路径求和转向路径极值：根据学习得到的标量场在所跨越区间内低于该键所在水平的最深跌幅，按比例降低键的 logit。FPA 将遗忘 Transformer（Forgetting Transformer，FoX）涵盖为一个特例；当标量场和水平遵循共享的学习游走时，未受惩罚、仍然存活的键会自然形成一个栈。我们证明，常数维度的 FPA 注意力头可以实现任意由后续跌幅决定的存活键子集；而具有位置偏置或 token 级遗忘门的 softmax 注意力头，则需要与键数量成线性关系的头维度。在合成实验中，单层 FPA 注意力头能够收敛到这些目标集合，而可比的 softmax 和 FoX 基线在每个随机种子下都失败。将其扩展到 110M 参数的语言模型后，FPA 的困惑度与 FoX 相当，并且独有地实现了完美的通行密钥检索，检索长度达到 $8\times$训练长度；即使其键值缓存压缩至约 $25\%$。

    Lewen Yan, Yanxu Zhu, Jie Zhang, Jing Shao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a configurable monitor for chain-of-thought behavior and evaluates its performance across tasks, unseen models, and altered trajectories, making CoT monitoring a substantial contribution to reasoning oversight. The monitor is a tool for oversight rather than a contribution to internal mechanisms or agent-system design.

    该论文提出一种可配置的思维链行为监测器，并在不同任务、未见过的模型及经过改动的轨迹上评估其表现，使 CoT 监测成为推理监督领域的一项实质性贡献。该监测器是监督工具，并未对内部机制或智能体系统设计作出贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Chain-of-Thought (CoT) monitoring offers actionable evidence for oversight AI systems, with the potential to enable early detection and intervention. However, existing approaches are focused on specific tasks, whereas the regulation of AI, particularly reasoning models, requires monitoring a broader range of tasks. We introduce Factor for CoT monitoring, a strategy that supports customizing monitoring requirements in the prompt, which enables a single monitor to cover different tasks by relying on different factors. Furthermore, we introduce two types of factors, fine-grained and coarse-grained (e.g., monitoring whether a specific email address has been leaked versus monitoring privacy leakage), to accommodate diverse user monitoring needs. Based on this, we develop a CoT monitor named OwlSight that relies solely on factor to monitor behaviors related to multiple dimensions, including capability, safety, and trustworthiness. Experiments across 15,971 reasoning trajectories show that OwlSight surpasses general-purpose LLMs by 1.32-30.57 and 11.71-27.81 points at fine and coarse granularity, respectively, and achieves state-of-the-art results on OpenAI's CoT monitorability benchmark. It also generalizes to unseen models' CoTs and remains robust to Factor rephrasings, CoT compression, and obfuscation, offering a promising paradigm for CoT monitoring that can contribute to the oversight of frontier AI.

    本文提出一个模拟软件环境，用于研究通信、所有权和资源分配如何影响多智能体协作及其随推理时计算量的扩展。其重点是智能体组织；任务发现和代码改进是评估场景，而非对推理机制或组合泛化的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As teams of AI agents take on larger projects and long-standing open problems, agent collaboration offers another dimension for scaling inference-time compute. To understand what makes such collaboration effective and scalable, we develop Software World, a framework for simulating multi-agent coworking in realistic software ecosystems. It comes with a pipeline to create environments of real, interdependent Python packages of different topics, sizes, and dependency structures, which we call software worlds. In a simulation, agents maintain packages in the world with a high-level goal of improving software efficiency, and they are free to discover tasks to work on and collaborate with others. We evaluate agents' work in a world collectively by measuring speedup in hidden dependent packages. The framework allows us to study different elements of collaboration by varying communication, ownership, and resource allocation. We run simulations in three different worlds, totaling more than 10,000 hours of agent work across eight models. Overall, performance improvement scales with inference-time compute, with the best model improving downstream efficiency by up to 31%. We show that most agents can find meaningful tasks via collaboration, but some frontier models can prematurely stop looking for improvements and make little progress. We release the simulation framework and traces to support future studies of agent collaboration at https://szj.io/sw.

    An important Bottleneck in LLM Optimizers: Principle-Level Local Optima

    LLM 优化器中的一个重要瓶颈：原理层面的局部最优

    Nian Ran, Tianhe Jia, Zhengyang Mu, Yue Wang, Sebastian Brulin, Markus Olhofer, Mauricio A. Alvarez, Yang Liu, Richard Allmendinger

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper diagnoses principle-level search collapse in feedback-driven LLM optimizers and evaluates diversity and reference-principle interventions, advancing understanding of optimization and strategy formation in problem-solving systems. Its connection to composition is incidental because it studies diversity of design principles rather than compositional representations or generalization.

    本文诊断了反馈驱动的 LLM 优化器中的原理层面搜索坍缩，并评估多样性干预和参考原理干预，推进了我们对问题求解系统中优化与策略形成的理解。它与组合能力的联系仅属间接，因为研究关注的是设计原理的多样性，而非组合表征或泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Feedback-driven LLM optimizers are increasingly used for evolutionary search, Bayesian optimization, heuristic design, and scientific discovery. Yet rapid initial gains often give way to prolonged plateaus despite substantial remaining evaluation budgets. We investigate \emph{principle-level search collapse}, where an optimizer's search becomes confined to a narrow set of design principles, even though it may continue to generate distinct candidates and achieve small improvements. We assemble a diagnostic benchmark spanning molecular optimization, network sentinel-node selection, and GPU-kernel optimization, and introduce a decision-tree protocol combining principle narrowing, prolonged performance plateaus, and gaps to attainable reference solutions. Across 161 assessable runs on the three problem domains, 78.3\% receive support for collapse, including 55.3\% with strong support. Candidate-level variation can nevertheless conceal restricted search at the principle level. We then test \emph{diversity injection}, a common response to search stagnation, such as higher t, multiple LLMs, and web search, and show that it provides limited and inconsistent benefits: among 65 molecular runs, still 73.8\% and 53.8\% receive support and strong support respectively. We finally test reference-principle interventions and find that they improve some runs, but their benefits vary across models and tasks: access to a better principle does not guarantee its effective use. Our benchmark and diagnostic protocol provide a basis for evaluating future optimizers on principle-level collapse. Our findings highlight the need for online collapse detection and better mechanisms for generating and maintaining alternative principles during optimization.

    反馈驱动的 LLM 优化器越来越多地用于进化搜索、贝叶斯优化、启发式设计和科学发现。然而，初期的快速提升往往会转为长期停滞，尽管仍有大量评估预算。我们研究“原理层面的搜索坍缩”现象：优化器的搜索被限制在一小组设计原理之内，尽管它可能继续生成不同的候选方案并取得小幅改进。我们构建了一个诊断基准，涵盖分子优化、网络哨兵节点选择和 GPU 内核优化，并提出一种决策树流程，综合考察原理收窄、长期性能停滞，以及与可达参考解之间的差距。在三个问题领域的 161 次可评估运行中，78.3\% 的结果支持存在搜索坍缩，其中 55.3\% 有强支持。然而，候选方案层面的变化仍可能掩盖原理层面的搜索受限。接着，我们测试了“多样性注入”这一应对搜索停滞的常见做法，例如提高 t、使用多个 LLM 和进行网络搜索，发现其收益有限且不一致：在 65 次分子领域运行中，仍有 73.8\% 的结果得到支持，53.8\% 得到强支持。最后，我们测试了参考原理干预，发现这种干预能改善部分运行，但效果因模型和任务而异：能够接触更好的原理，并不意味着能有效运用该原理。我们的基准和诊断流程为评估未来优化器是否存在原理层面的坍缩提供了依据。研究结果凸显了在线坍缩检测的必要性，也表明需要更好的机制来生成并维护优化过程中的备选原理。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

This substantially targets multi-step reasoning, with partial relevance to compositional generalization and agent systems; it does not study internal representations or mechanisms.

    HybridResearcher 使用精选轨迹训练小型智能体，这些轨迹要求将数据库结果与网络证据结合起来，并提升了跨来源任务和留出任务的表现。该研究实质上针对多步推理，并与组合泛化和智能体系统有一定关联；但它没有研究内部表征或机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    While LLM agents are increasingly capable of gathering and synthesizing evidence from a single homogeneous source, such as structured tables or unstructured data, real-world analytical questions frequently span heterogeneous sources. For example, answering one enterprise question may require both a result computed over an internal database and evidence found on the web. Recent evaluations on benchmarks like HybridDeepResearch show that even frontier agents struggle when evidence must cross this boundary. While these benchmarks have exposed the limitation, methodologies to explicitly teach cross-source reasoning remain absent. To address this, we introduce HybridResearcher, a 4B agent trained to bridge evidence across the structured and unstructured boundary. To build it, we synthesize cross-source bridge trajectories by starting with validated single-source tasks-such as existing text-to-SQL or web search queries-and fabricating the missing source around a bridge entity drawn from the seed's own output. We retain a sample only when strict construction gates confirm that neither side alone suffices, ensuring the data requires true cross-source interdependence. Finally, we train on this curated dataset using supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. Evaluated on the existing HybridDeepResearch benchmark, HybridResearcher improves over our base model, Qwen3.5-4B, by 30.0 points pass@8 and surpasses the far larger Qwen3.5-397B-A17B by 8.3 points, while also improving over its base model on established, held-out single-source benchmarks (BrowseComp and BrowseComp-Plus), demonstrating that this complex cross-source reasoning can be taught directly to small models without triggering catastrophic forgetting.

    LLM 智能体越来越擅长从单一同质来源（如结构化表格或非结构化数据）收集并综合证据，但现实中的分析问题往往涉及异构来源。例如，回答一个企业问题可能既需要从内部数据库计算出的结果，也需要从网络上找到的证据。近期在 HybridDeepResearch 等基准上的评估表明，即使是前沿智能体，在证据必须跨越这一边界时也会遇到困难。尽管这些基准揭示了这一局限，明确教授跨来源推理的方法仍然缺失。为此，我们推出 HybridResearcher，这是一个经过训练、能够跨越结构化与非结构化边界连接证据的 4B 智能体。为构建该模型，我们从已验证的单来源任务（例如现有的 text-to-SQL 或网页搜索查询）出发，围绕种子任务自身输出中的桥接实体，构造缺失的来源，从而合成跨来源桥接轨迹。只有在严格的构造门槛确认任一来源单独都不足以完成任务时，我们才保留样本，以确保数据确实要求跨来源相互依赖。最后，我们在这一精选数据集上先进行有监督微调，再进行强化学习。在现有 HybridDeepResearch 基准上的评估显示，HybridResearcher 相较于基础模型 Qwen3.5-4B，在 pass@8 上提高 30.0 个百分点，并超过规模大得多的 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 8.3 个百分点；它在成熟的留出单来源基准（BrowseComp 和 BrowseComp-Plus）上的表现也优于基础模型。这表明，可以直接教会小模型这种复杂的跨来源推理能力，而不会引发灾难性遗忘。

    VLA-Rolling：通过自适应动作复用减少去噪步数、提升控制效果

    Sicheng He, Yi Pan, Qiuting Yu, Jiaming Huang, Qi Lu, Shuyan Wu, Hongyan Feng, Xuanyu Liu, Jun Zhang, Jie Zhang, Wenqi Zhang, Xuhong Zhang, Jianwei Yin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    VLA-Rolling reuses partially denoised action tails and adaptively allocates refinement steps to improve control efficiency, a substantial algorithmic contribution to inference computation in model systems. The intermediate-state reuse is not an analysis of internal representations, and the control task alone does not establish a reasoning contribution.

    VLA-Rolling 复用部分去噪的动作尾部，并自适应地分配细化步数，以提升控制效率；这是对模型系统推理计算的重要算法贡献。中间状态复用并非对内部表征的分析，而控制任务本身也不足以证明其对推理能力有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models generate an action chunk by iteratively denoising Gaussian noise, but typically execute only a short prefix before replanning with updated observations. Under this receding-horizon paradigm, the unexecuted remainder---the action tail---is discarded, and the next chunk is regenerated from fresh noise. We show that this discarded tail retains transferable denoising progress: action-tail initialization can match or outperform a native 10-step Gaussian baseline using fewer denoising steps. However, the optimal denoising budget varies substantially across samples, indicating that tail reuse should be adapted to the updated environment. Based on this observation, we introduce VLA-Rolling, a lightweight inference framework that reuses action tails through three stages: action-tail inheritance, per-action confidence estimation, and confidence-guided refinement through renoising and denoising budget allocation, while the underlying VLA remains frozen. Across $\pi_{0.5}$, SmolVLA, X-VLA, and MolmoAct2 on LIBERO, MetaWorld, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0, VLA-Rolling reduces action-chunk inference cost in all 16 model--benchmark pairs, achieving up to a $1.48\times$ speedup, while improving success rate in 14 pairs by up to $15.08$ percentage points. These results show that action tails are not merely discarded predictions, but reusable intermediate states that enable more efficient and accurate VLA inference. These results demonstrate that the action tail can support the generation of better actions with fewer denoising steps. Our project is available at https://chenbao123ww.github.io/VLA-Rolling/.

    中文

    流匹配视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过反复对高斯噪声进行去噪来生成一个动作块，但通常只执行其中较短的前缀，随后根据更新后的观测重新规划。在这种滚动时域范式下，未执行的剩余部分——动作尾部——会被丢弃，下一动作块则从新的噪声重新生成。我们表明，这个被丢弃的尾部保留了可迁移的去噪进展：使用动作尾部初始化时，所需去噪步数更少，效果即可达到或超过原生的 10 步高斯基线。然而，不同样本的最优去噪预算差异很大，表明尾部复用应根据更新后的环境进行调整。基于这一观察，我们提出 VLA-Rolling，这是一种轻量级推理框架，通过三个阶段复用动作尾部：继承动作尾部、估计每个动作的置信度，以及通过重新加噪和分配去噪预算进行置信度引导的细化，同时保持底层 VLA 冻结。在 LIBERO、MetaWorld、LIBERO-Plus 和 RoboTwin 2.0 上使用$\pi_{0.5}$、SmolVLA、X-VLA 和 MolmoAct2 进行的实验中，VLA-Rolling 在全部 16 个模型—基准组合中降低了动作块推理成本，最高实现$1.48\times$倍加速；在 14 个组合中提升了成功率，最高提升$15.08$个百分点。这些结果表明，动作尾部不只是被丢弃的预测，而是可复用的中间状态，能够实现更高效、更准确的 VLA 推理。这些结果证明，动作尾部能够以更少的去噪步数支持生成更好的动作。项目地址：https://chenbao123ww.github.io/VLA-Rolling/。

    Xuyuan Liu, Xinshuai Dong, Elynn Chen, Yujun Yan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces logical-structure conditioning and evaluates consistency across equivalent inputs and generalization to unseen logical forms. These are substantial contributions to compositional generalization and logical reasoning; the embedding is a reasoning aid, not an analysis of internal mechanisms or model systems.

    本文提出逻辑结构条件化方法，并评估模型在等价输入间的一致性以及对未见逻辑形式的泛化。这些工作对组合泛化和逻辑推理作出了重要贡献；嵌入是一种推理辅助工具，并非对内部机制或模型系统的分析。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across diverse reasoning tasks, yet it remains unclear whether this performance reflects an understanding of underlying logical structure or a reliance on shallow semantic cues. A key indicator of such understanding is whether models treat logically equivalent inputs consistently, producing the same predictions despite differences in expression. Through systematic evaluation on curated data, we show that even strong LLMs often fail this test: they do not consistently preserve predictions across logically equivalent inputs and generalize poorly to unseen logical forms. To address this limitation, we propose LoGIcal STructure-guided reasoning (LoGIST), a framework that guides LLM reasoning with explicit logical structure. LoGIST maps each input instance to a decision diagram, a directed acyclic graph that captures the underlying logical structure, and encodes this graph into a logical embedding that conditions the LLM's reasoning process. Across multiple training settings, LoGIST reduces inconsistency under logical equivalence and improves generalization to unseen logical forms, suggesting that logical invariance is a useful target for building more robust and generalizable logical reasoning in LLMs.

    大型语言模型（LLM）在多种推理任务上已取得出色表现，但这些表现究竟体现了对底层逻辑结构的理解，还是依赖浅层语义线索，仍不清楚。此类理解的一个关键指标是模型能否一致地对待逻辑等价的输入，即便表达方式不同，仍产生相同的预测。通过对整理后的数据进行系统评估，我们表明，即使是强大的 LLM 也常常无法通过这一检验：它们不能始终在逻辑等价输入之间保持预测一致，并且对未见过的逻辑形式泛化较差。为解决这一局限，我们提出逻辑结构引导推理（LoGIST）框架，以显式逻辑结构引导 LLM 推理。LoGIST 将每个输入实例映射为决策图（一种捕捉底层逻辑结构的有向无环图），并将该图编码为逻辑嵌入，以此对 LLM 的推理过程进行条件化。在多种训练设置下，LoGIST 降低了逻辑等价输入之间的不一致性，并提升了对未见逻辑形式的泛化能力。这表明逻辑不变性是构建更稳健、更具泛化能力的 LLM 逻辑推理能力时一个有用的目标。

    Guannan Lai, Zi-Yang Bai, Jun-Peng Jiang, Han-Jia Ye

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TokenWorth learns which stored experiences are useful and uses that estimate for retrieval and memory management in resource-constrained lifelong agents. This substantially advances agent memory design; its decision-improvement objective relates to reasoning, but the abstract does not focus on reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    TokenWorth 学习判断存储的经验是否有用，并据此在资源受限的终身智能体中进行检索和记忆管理。这显著推进了智能体记忆设计；其改进决策的目标与推理有关，但摘要并未聚焦于推理机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Self-improving agents aim to continuously improve their behavior by learning from experience after deployment. However, accumulating and reusing more experience does not necessarily lead to better decisions, particularly when generation, interaction, and memory resources are jointly constrained. Under such stringent constraints, we find that several existing lifelong-memory methods provide limited benefits over simple retrieval or even no-memory agents. This reveals a fundamental challenge for resource-efficient self-improvement: agents must learn not only which past experiences are relevant, but which are actually worth reusing to improve future decisions. When memory capacity and opportunities for reasoning and recovery are limited, retrieving an ineffective experience can consume scarce resources and hinder downstream execution. To address this challenge, we propose TokenWorth, a lightweight feedback-driven memory adaptation framework that learns query-dependent memory worth from sparse execution feedback. Without updating the backbone model, TokenWorth uses the learned worth to guide both experience retrieval and bounded memory management, enabling the agent to continually adapt how it reuses accumulated experience. Across three LifelongAgentBench environments and both local and API-based deployments, TokenWorth achieves the highest task success rate while using the fewest output tokens among the evaluated methods under the specified resource budgets. These results suggest that effective self-improvement under resource constraints depends not on accumulating more experience, but on learning what is worth remembering. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/AIGNLAI/TokenWorth.

    自我改进型智能体旨在部署后从经验中学习，持续改善自身行为。然而，累积并复用更多经验并不一定能带来更好的决策，尤其是在生成、交互和记忆资源都受到联合限制时。在如此严格的资源约束下，我们发现，若干现有的终身记忆方法相比简单检索甚至无记忆智能体，收益有限。这揭示了资源高效自我改进面临的一项根本挑战：智能体不仅必须学会哪些过去的经验相关，还必须判断哪些经验确实值得复用以改善未来决策。当记忆容量以及推理和恢复机会都有限时，检索无效经验会消耗稀缺资源，并妨碍后续执行。为解决这一挑战，我们提出 TokenWorth，这是一种轻量级、由反馈驱动的记忆适应框架，利用稀疏的执行反馈学习依赖于查询的记忆价值。在不更新骨干模型的情况下，TokenWorth 使用学得的价值来指导经验检索和有界记忆管理，使智能体能够持续调整对累积经验的复用方式。在三个 LifelongAgentBench 环境以及本地和基于 API 的部署中，在指定资源预算下，TokenWorth 在所评估方法中取得最高任务成功率，同时使用的输出词元最少。这些结果表明，在资源受限条件下实现有效自我改进，关键不在于累积更多经验，而在于学会哪些经验值得记住。代码公开于 https://github.com/AIGNLAI/TokenWorth。

    Breaking Diffusion: Parallel Reasoning with Draft Refinement

    打破扩散：通过草稿精炼进行并行推理

    Jaesang Yu, Seoyeon Byun, Yun Wang, Yan Lu, Juho Kim

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DRLMs propose and selectively retain parallel draft revisions using a one-pass cavity-energy estimate, and the abstract reports gains on complex reasoning tasks. This directly advances reasoning methods, while parallel revision alone does not establish compositional generalization or a broader model-system contribution.

    DRLM 使用单次前向传播的空腔能量估计来提出并有选择地保留并行草稿修订，摘要报告了其在复杂推理任务上的性能提升。这项工作直接推进了推理方法；不过，仅凭并行修订并不能证明组合泛化能力或更广泛的模型系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Drafting an answer allows a reasoning model to reconsider each decision in the context of the others. Yet repeated diffusion denoising does not ensure that individually plausible token updates form a better answer together. We introduce Draft Refinement Language Models (DRLMs), which use a single denoiser to propose parallel revisions and evaluate a candidate draft. We train the denoiser to reconstruct every token from uniformly corrupted drafts, teaching both preservation and repair. Its predictions specify revisions directly, without a diffusion reverse transition. Evaluation requires a different use of these predictions: confidence in an existing token reflects both contextual support and evidence from observing the token itself. Using the known corruption process, we correct for this self-token evidence to estimate how well each token is supported by the prompt and the remaining draft. Aggregating these estimates yields a cavity energy computed in one forward pass, without an additional scoring model. Each round proposes a revision, reads the completed candidate in its revised context, and retains it only if its energy is lower. Across Countdown, Sudoku-Extreme, and Maze-Hard, our method outperforms autoregressive and discrete diffusion baselines. With 6M parameters, DRLM reaches 44.4% on Countdown-5 and 93.9% on Sudoku-Extreme. The results establish complete-draft parallel refinement as an effective alternative to reverse diffusion for complex reasoning.

    中文

    起草答案使推理模型能够结合其他决策的上下文重新审视每一项决策。然而，反复进行扩散去噪并不能保证各自看似合理的词元更新组合起来会形成更好的答案。我们提出草稿精炼语言模型（DRLM），它使用单个去噪器提出并行修订并评估候选草稿。我们训练去噪器从均匀加噪的草稿中重建每个词元，使其同时学会保留和修复。它的预测直接指定修订内容，无需扩散反向转移。评估这些预测则需要采用另一种方式：现有词元的置信度既反映上下文支持，也反映观察到该词元本身所提供的证据。利用已知的加噪过程，我们校正这种来自词元自身的证据，以估计提示和草稿其余部分对每个词元的支持程度。汇总这些估计后即可得到空腔能量，只需一次前向传播，无需额外的评分模型。每轮提出一次修订，在修订后的上下文中读取完整候选答案，并且仅在其能量更低时予以保留。在 Countdown、Sudoku-Extreme 和 Maze-Hard 上，我们的方法优于自回归和离散扩散基线。DRLM 只有 6M 个参数，在 Countdown-5 上达到 44.4%，在 Sudoku-Extreme 上达到 93.9%。这些结果表明，对于复杂推理，对完整草稿进行并行精炼是反向扩散的一种有效替代方案。

    Copying Under Repetition: From Prefix Matching to Position Hashing

    重复内容中的复制：从前缀匹配到位置哈希

    Anxin Guo, Tianlong Huang, Chenxiao Yang, Zhiyuan Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a transformer construction for copying through repeated strings and proves an impossibility result for certain positional schemes, with experiments showing length generalization. Its modular distance encoding offers substantive insight into structured generalization, but it does not study internal mechanisms of trained models; copying is not a reasoning capability, and systems design is incidental.

    本文提出一种能够复制重复字符串的 Transformer 构造，并证明某些位置编码方案存在不可能性结果，实验还显示了长度泛化。其模距离编码为结构化泛化提供了重要见解，但本文未研究训练后模型的内部机制；复制不属于推理能力，系统设计也只是附带内容。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Frontier LLMs can copy random text almost flawlessly, yet they often overrun or truncate long blocks of repeated characters. In repeated strings, matching local content no longer reliably identifies where copying should continue or when it should stop. Nevertheless, we show that a two-layer transformer with $O(\log\log N)$-bit precision and $O(\log N/\log\log N)$ width can copy every string up to a chosen design horizon $N$ and terminate correctly under arbitrary repetition. We use RoPE-style rotations of attention values and outputs (VO-rotations) with small prime periods to encode distances from delimiter anchors modulo those primes. By the Chinese Remainder Theorem, these periodic encodings jointly distinguish all required distances, allowing one retrieval rule to select either the next source token or the end marker. In contrast, we prove a width-independent impossibility result for copying under sequential finite-precision softmax accumulation. It applies to transformers whose only positional input is an additive attention bias that eventually becomes constant, including NoPE and a recursive implementation of ALiBi. Once an identical-token run exceeds the resulting saturation threshold, further repetitions leave the logits unchanged. If this threshold grows sublinearly with $N$, these models cannot both complete a long all-identical copy and stop correctly, a pattern resembling the termination errors of frontier LLMs. In synthetic copying experiments, baseline transformer models fail on long repeated strings even within the training range. Trained VO models, by contrast, generalize beyond the training lengths with near-perfect accuracy up to length $\approx5005$, the selected primes' period product.

    中文

    前沿 LLM 几乎可以完美复制随机文本，但在处理长串重复字符时却经常多复制或截断。在重复字符串中，匹配局部内容已无法可靠地确定应从哪里继续复制或何时停止。尽管如此，我们表明，具有$O(\log\log N)$位精度和$O(\log N/\log\log N)$宽度的两层 Transformer 能够复制所有长度不超过选定设计范围$N$的字符串，并在任意重复情形下正确终止。我们采用 RoPE 式的注意力值和输出旋转（VO 旋转），以较小的素数为周期，编码相对于分隔符锚点的距离模这些素数所得的余数。根据中国剩余定理，这些周期编码共同区分所有所需距离，使同一检索规则能够选择下一个源词元或结束标记。相比之下，我们证明了在顺序有限精度 softmax 累积条件下进行复制存在一个与宽度无关的不可能性结果。它适用于唯一的位置输入是加性注意力偏置且该偏置最终趋于常数的 Transformer，包括 NoPE 和 ALiBi 的递归实现。一旦相同词元的连续段超过由此产生的饱和阈值，进一步重复便不会改变 logits。如果该阈值相对于$N$呈次线性增长，这些模型就无法同时完成长串全同字符的复制并正确停止；这种模式与前沿 LLM 的终止错误相似。在合成复制实验中，基线 Transformer 模型即使在训练长度范围内，也无法处理长重复字符串。相比之下，经过训练的 VO 模型能够泛化到训练长度之外，直至长度$\approx5005$时仍有近乎完美的准确率；该长度等于所选素数的周期乘积。

    CA-MOPD adjusts reinforcement-learning teacher supervision using estimated capability gaps, improving results across math, code, and instruction-following benchmarks.     Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) integrates domain specialists into a shared student, but determining how strongly each teacher should supervise remains challenging. Existing discrepancy-based allocation can assign strong supervision even when the student already matches or exceeds the teacher's task performance, since behavioral mismatch does not necessarily imply a remaining capability deficit. We propose Capability-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (CA-MOPD), which combines specialist merging with capability-guided allocation to account for what the student has already learned. CA-MOPD first merges reinforcement-learning specialists into a strong student initialization, then uses verifier-estimated teacher--student capability gaps to adjust domain-level distillation strength. Supervision decreases as capability gaps close and increases when estimated student capability regresses, while dense token-level guidance remains provided by the teachers. Across six benchmarks spanning mathematics, code generation, and instruction following, CA-MOPD achieves an average score of 32.22, outperforming naive MOPD, Open-MOPD, and the merged initialization by 0.86, 0.83, and 0.74 points, respectively. Controlled comparisons further support the benefits of merged initialization and capability-gap guidance under matched training budgets.

    多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）将领域专家整合到一个共享学生模型中，但如何确定每位教师应提供多大程度的监督仍是一个挑战。基于差异分配监督强度的现有方法，即使学生在任务表现上已达到或超过教师，也可能分配较强监督，因为行为不匹配并不一定意味着能力仍有缺口。我们提出具备能力感知的多教师在线策略蒸馏（CA-MOPD），将专家模型融合与能力引导的分配相结合，以考虑学生已经学会的内容。CA-MOPD 首先将强化学习专家模型融合为强大的学生初始化模型，然后利用验证器估计的教师—学生能力差距来调整领域级蒸馏强度。随着能力差距缩小，监督强度降低；当估计的学生能力退步时，监督强度则提高，同时教师仍提供密集的词元级指导。在涵盖数学、代码生成和指令遵循的六个基准上，CA-MOPD 的平均得分为 32.22，分别比朴素 MOPD、Open-MOPD 和融合后的初始化模型高 0.86、0.83 和 0.74 分。在训练预算相同的受控比较中，结果进一步支持融合初始化和能力差距引导的益处。

    无需关系信息即可预测线性关系可解码性

    Jonas Rohweder, Adrian M\"ulthaler, Faridoun Mehri, Sebastian Gerstner, Hinrich Sch\"utze

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces an entity lens and shows that relation-agnostic readouts predict how faithfully language models linearly decode relations, suggesting a link between subject representations and decodability. This is a substantial representation-analysis contribution, though it does not identify internal mechanisms or circuits.

    本文提出实体 lens，并表明与关系无关的读出能够预测语言模型线性解码关系的忠实性，揭示了主语表征与可解码性之间的联系。这是对表征分析的重要贡献，但并未识别内部机制或回路。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Linear relational embeddings (LREs) approximate a language model's subject-to-object mapping with an affine function. Their faithfulness varies enormously across relations, from near zero for person_father to the ceiling for country_capital_city. We investigate the factors that contribute to this variation and demonstrate that it can be significantly predicted from a readout that is not aware of the underlying relation. To do so, we propose a novel form of the Jacobian lens, the entity lens. Whereas the Jacobian lens is estimated across all tokens and concepts, the entity lens EL_t is trained to predict what the model will output for an entity of type t under the neutral prompt "{} is known for"; e.g., we train ELs for countries and persons. After estimating an entity lens, we measure how highly it ranks the model's answer for a relation without using any relation-specific information in estimation and prediction. Across 28 relations of the LRE dataset on Olmo-3-7B this relation-agnostic score correlates with LRE faithfulness at $\rho = 0.7355$ (p < .01). This suggests that linear decodability is largely a property of what a subject's representation already carries, rather than of the relation being decoded. Moving the unit of analysis from the relation to the individual fact, we conclude that new relation datasets and analysis methods are needed to address several problems in existing datasets, most prominently semantically weak first tokens (e.g., most predicted universities' first token is "University") and reference competition (e.g., the LLM confuses obscure actor names with competing non-actor entities that have the same last name). Our full pipeline is available at https://github.com/jonasrohw/entity-lens

    中文

    线性关系嵌入（LRE）用仿射函数近似语言模型的主语到宾语映射。其忠实性在不同关系之间差异极大：对于 person_father 几乎为零，而对于 country_capital_city 则达到上限。我们研究造成这种差异的因素，并证明，无需获知底层关系的读出也能显著预测这种差异。为此，我们提出一种新型 Jacobian lens，即实体 lens。Jacobian lens 是在所有词元和概念上估计的，而实体 lens EL_t 则针对类型为 t 的实体进行训练，以预测模型在中性提示“{} is known for”下的输出；例如，我们会为国家和人物训练 EL。估计实体 lens 后，我们衡量它对模型某个关系答案的排序，而在估计和预测过程中均不使用任何关系特定信息。在 Olmo-3-7B 上的 LRE 数据集的 28 种关系中，这一与关系无关的分数与 LRE 忠实性之间的相关性为$\rho = 0.7355$（p < .01）。这表明，线性可解码性在很大程度上取决于主语的表征本身已经承载的内容，而非被解码的关系。将分析单位从关系转向单条事实后，我们得出结论：需要新的关系数据集和分析方法来解决现有数据集中的若干问题，其中最突出的是语义较弱的首词元（例如，模型预测的大多数大学名称都以“University”开头）和指代竞争（例如，LLM 会将不知名演员的名字与姓氏相同的其他非演员实体混淆）。完整流程见 https://github.com/jonasrohw/entity-lens。

    LaLa-World combines language-conditioned latent prediction across heterogeneous data to support planning with imagination and policy fine-tuning. Its main contributions advance planning and world-model agent systems; joint training across domains offers partial evidence about composition, but no explicit compositional generalization result or internal mechanism analysis.

    LaLa-World 将异构数据上的语言条件潜在预测结合起来，以支持通过想象进行规划和策略微调。其主要贡献推进了规划和世界模型智能体系统；跨领域联合训练为组合性提供了部分证据，但没有明确的组合泛化结果或内部机制分析。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    This paper shows that JEPA-style latent world models (LWMs) can learn across diverse domains and data sources by adopting the language-conditioned interface of video generation models. We establish this approach as an effective and efficient basis for planning with imagination and downstream policy fine-tuning. To this end, we introduce LaLa-World, a Language-conditioned Latent World model that learns from simulation and robot trajectories together with broader image and video data. Two designs make this work. First, we describe both numerical actions and visual changes in language, enabling joint training of a single future predictor across heterogeneous datasets. Second, we build the predictor on a language model, allowing it to interpret language conditions while predicting future latent states. The resulting predictor achieves higher average MPC planning performance than existing LWMs trained separately for each domain or task. Adding image and video data further improves average planning performance and robustness to action phrasing. In a matched comparison with an RAEv2-based video generation model baseline, LaLa-World reaches comparable planning performance with $6\times$ less training cost and $13.9\times$ faster planning. Beyond planning, the pretrained LaLa-World serves as an initialization for LaLa-Policy, which jointly predicts actions and future visual representations. LaLa-Policy performs competitively with Cosmos Policy on LIBERO and RoboCasa, with up to $5.5\times$ faster inference.

    本文表明，采用视频生成模型的语言条件接口后，JEPA 风格的潜在世界模型（LWM）能够在多种不同领域和数据来源上进行学习。我们确立了这种方法，将其作为通过想象进行规划以及对下游策略进行微调的有效且高效基础。为此，我们提出 LaLa-World，即一种语言条件潜在世界模型，它从仿真和机器人轨迹以及更广泛的图像和视频数据中学习。两项设计使这一方法得以实现。首先，我们用语言描述数值动作和视觉变化，从而能够在异构数据集上联合训练单个未来预测器。其次，我们基于语言模型构建该预测器，使其能够在预测未来潜在状态的同时解读语言条件。与现有针对每个领域或任务分别训练的 LWM 相比，由此得到的预测器实现了更高的平均 MPC 规划性能。加入图像和视频数据进一步提升了平均规划性能，以及对动作措辞的鲁棒性。在与基于 RAEv2 的视频生成模型基线进行匹配比较时，LaLa-World 达到了可比的规划性能，同时训练成本降低了$6\times$，规划速度提升了$13.9\times$。除规划之外，预训练的 LaLa-World 还可作为 LaLa-Policy 的初始化模型；LaLa-Policy 联合预测动作和未来视觉表征。LaLa-Policy 在 LIBERO 和 RoboCasa 上的表现可与 Cosmos Policy 相媲美，推理速度最高可提升$5.5\times$。

    Planning under Noise with Neural Operators

    使用神经算子进行噪声下的规划

    Michael Chen, Hong Chul Nam, Xi Deng, Anima Anandkumar

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a noise-aware planning method that learns value fields and uses them to guide search across unseen geometries, with strong results under control noise. This substantially advances planning, while its learned field composition and planner implementation do not establish contributions to compositional generalization or model and agent systems.

    本文开发了一种具有噪声感知能力的规划方法，它通过学习价值场来引导搜索，并在控制噪声下取得了强劲结果。该方法显著推动了规划领域的发展，但其学习到的场的组合方式和规划器实现并未证明其对组合泛化或模型与智能体系统有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Planning under uncertain control execution noise requires reliable feedback policies across diverse environments. We introduce Planning Under Noise (PUN), a neural operator that learns noise-aware value fields for planning in unseen geometries. Building on an established screened-Poisson formulation of stochastic optimal control, we address two challenges: specifying boundary conditions that support navigation across varying geometries and efficiently computing fields with reliable gradients. Zero-Dirichlet obstacle boundaries terminate sampled paths at walls, weakening the goal signal along long routes and making it harder to estimate reliably. We instead impose reflecting Neumann conditions on obstacles and a Dirichlet condition at the goal, allowing sampled paths to continue exploring free space until they reach the target. To solve the resulting PDE without a configuration-space mesh, we extend a Monte Carlo (MC) solver, Walk on Stars (WoSt), to higher dimensions. However, local MC fluctuations can reverse estimated gradient directions and cause planning failures, making direct planning require costly sampling. PUN amortizes this computation by learning geometry-to-field mappings from noisy, partially converged Monte Carlo labels, avoiding expensive convergence for every training example. At inference, test-time scaling uses bounded local search guided by the predicted global field. We evaluate PUN on planning tasks across dimensions. Across four noise levels, PUN matches or outperforms all compared planners, achieving 95-100% success on the 4D replanning benchmark while maintaining the lowest runtime. At the highest tested noise level in 4D, PUN achieves 10.7-60.6% relative gains in success rate over other methods while running 3.29-32.15 times faster.

    中文

    在控制执行存在不确定噪声时进行规划，需要能够适应多种环境的可靠反馈策略。我们提出 Planning Under Noise（PUN），这是一种神经算子，能够学习具有噪声感知能力的价值场，以便在未见过的几何环境中进行规划。基于随机最优控制中成熟的 screened-Poisson 公式，我们解决两个挑战：规定支持在不同几何环境中导航的边界条件，以及高效计算具有可靠梯度的场。零 Dirichlet 障碍边界会使采样路径在墙处终止，从而削弱长路线上的目标信号，使其更难可靠估计。我们改为在障碍物上施加反射 Neumann 条件，并在目标处施加 Dirichlet 条件，使采样路径能够持续探索自由空间，直至到达目标。为在没有配置空间网格的情况下求解由此得到的 PDE，我们将 Monte Carlo（MC）求解器 Walk on Stars（WoSt）扩展到更高维度。然而，局部 MC 波动可能使估计的梯度方向反转并导致规划失败，因此直接规划需要代价高昂的采样。PUN 通过从带噪且未完全收敛的 Monte Carlo 标签中学习从几何到场的映射，将这项计算摊销，从而避免每个训练样本都进行昂贵的收敛计算。在推理时，测试时扩展使用有界局部搜索，并由预测的全局场提供引导。我们在多个维度的规划任务上评估 PUN。在四种噪声水平下，PUN 的表现与所有对比规划器持平或更优；在 4D 重规划基准上取得 95–100% 的成功率，同时保持最低运行时间。在 4D 中测试的最高噪声水平下，PUN 的成功率相对其他方法提高 10.7–60.6%，运行速度则快 3.29–32.15 倍。

    To Keep or Not to Keep: Learning KV Cache Retention in Disaggregated LLM Serving Systems

    留还是不留：在解耦式 LLM 服务系统中学习 KV 缓存保留策略

    Dong Liu and Yanxuan Yu and Eric Jiang and Shu Wang and Ying Nian Wu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper’s main contribution is a learning-based KV-cache retention policy that balances reuse probability against transfer, recomputation, and storage costs in disaggregated LLM serving. This is a strong systems contribution on cache management and adaptive resource allocation; model internals and reasoning are incidental to the serving context, and it does not study compositional generalization.

    本文的主要贡献是一种基于学习的 KV 缓存保留策略，它在解耦式 LLM 服务中权衡复用概率与传输、重新计算和存储成本。这是对缓存管理和自适应资源分配的有力系统贡献；模型内部机制和推理与服务场景关系不大，本文也没有研究组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Disaggregated \textsc{LLM} serving separates prefill and decode across node pools, placing a network fabric between \textsc{KV}-cache computation and consumption. This breaks a key assumption of classical cache policies: a miss no longer incurs only local recomputation, but also network transfer to the decode node. Likewise, admitting a block to the global cache requires an additional transfer, so poor retention decisions waste both memory and bandwidth. We present \textbf{KVLearn}, a learning-based framework for cost-aware \textsc{KV}-cache retention in disaggregated serving. KVLearn includes: (i) a lightweight Prefix Reuse Predictor (\textsc{PRP}) that estimates reuse probability from structural and temporal prefix features without modifying model weights; (ii) a Cost-Aware Retention Score (\textsc{CARS}) that converts reuse probability into keep/admit decisions using recomputation, transfer, and storage costs; and (iii) an Adaptive Threshold Controller (\textsc{ATC}) that adjusts admission thresholds online from observed hit rates and memory pressure. We integrate KVLearn into a globally disaggregated serving topology and evaluate it on text and multimodal workloads, including large image/video-derived \textsc{KV} blocks with heterogeneous reuse patterns. KVLearn reduces end-to-end time-to-first-token by up to 56% versus No-Cache, 38% versus LRU-Pool, and 33% versus Mooncake-style baselines, while cutting inter-node \textsc{KV} transfer volume by up to 53% versus LRU-Pool. On MM-Session, throughput remains within ${\sim}5%$ of oracle. Code is available at https://github.com/FastLM/KVLearn.

    中文

    解耦式 \textsc{LLM} 服务将预填充和解码分置于不同节点池中，使网络连接位于 \textsc{KV} 缓存的计算与使用之间。这打破了经典缓存策略的一项关键假设：缓存未命中不再只带来本地重新计算，还会产生向解码节点传输数据的开销。同样，将一个块纳入全局缓存也需要额外传输，因此不佳的保留决策会同时浪费内存和带宽。我们提出 \textbf{KVLearn}，一种用于解耦式服务、注重成本的 \textsc{KV} 缓存保留学习框架。KVLearn 包含：(i) 轻量级前缀复用预测器（\textsc{PRP}），无需修改模型权重，即可根据前缀的结构和时间特征估计复用概率；(ii) 成本感知保留评分（\textsc{CARS}），利用重新计算、传输和存储成本，将复用概率转换为保留/准入决策；以及 (iii) 自适应阈值控制器（\textsc{ATC}），根据观测到的命中率和内存压力在线调整准入阈值。我们将 KVLearn 集成到全局解耦式服务拓扑中，并在文本和多模态工作负载上进行评估，其中包括具有异构复用模式、从大型图像/视频数据导出的 \textsc{KV} 块。与 No-Cache、LRU-Pool 和 Mooncake 风格基线相比，KVLearn 将端到端首 token 时间最多分别降低 56%、38% 和 33%；与 LRU-Pool 相比，节点间 \textsc{KV} 传输量最多减少 53%。在 MM-Session 上，吞吐量与 oracle 的差距保持在 ${\sim}5%$以内。代码见 https://github.com/FastLM/KVLearn。

    SpecEvo：利用大型语言模型进行推测式进化，实现高成本效益的科学发现

    Ha Minh Hieu, Tongyao Zhu, Do Xuan Long, Min-Yen Kan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SpecEvo coordinates lightweight and frontier models to explore and refine candidates while consolidating trial evidence for later search, with substantial contributions to model coordination and adaptive compute allocation. Its scientific-discovery applications do not establish a central advance in interpretability, compositional generalization, or reasoning mechanisms.

    SpecEvo 协调轻量级模型和前沿模型来探索和改进候选方案，同时整合试验证据以供后续搜索使用，在模型协调和自适应计算分配方面作出了重要贡献。其科学发现应用并未证明它在可解释性、组合泛化或推理机制方面取得了核心进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM-driven evolutionary search is a promising paradigm for scientific discovery, but existing methods remain costly and slow, often applying expensive reasoning uniformly while underusing evidence from failed, redundant, and saturated trials. We introduce Speculative Evolution (SpecEvo), a multi-LLM framework that coordinates lightweight and frontier models through continual consolidation of search evidence. Lightweight models power both parallel Speculators, which generate and refine candidate programs, and an Advisor, which distills accumulated successes, failures, and saturated directions into persistent guidance for subsequent exploration. At sparse checkpoints, a frontier-model Navigator inspects the evolving population and intervenes through synthesis, surgical refinement, or reframing according to search stagnation. This speculate-then-consolidate workflow delegates routine exploration and evidence consolidation to inexpensive models while reserving frontier reasoning for strategic interventions whose benefits extend across many subsequent low-cost evaluations. Across 176 tasks spanning four scientific and algorithmic discovery domains, SpecEvo matches or outperforms frontier-model baselines while reducing API cost by up to 80%, achieves up to 1.5x greater evaluation efficiency than cost-efficient baselines on equation discovery, and improves over the strongest CO-Bench baseline by 3.8%. These results support trajectory-conditioned model coordination as an effective approach to cost-efficient scientific discovery.

    中文

    由 LLM 驱动的进化搜索是科学发现的一种有前景的范式，但现有方法仍然成本高、速度慢，往往对所有情况一概使用昂贵的推理，同时未能充分利用失败、冗余和已饱和试验提供的证据。我们提出推测式进化（Speculative Evolution，SpecEvo），一种多 LLM 框架，通过持续整合搜索证据来协调轻量级模型和前沿模型。轻量级模型负责并行的 Speculator，它们生成并改进候选程序；同时也负责 Advisor，后者将累积的成功、失败和已饱和方向提炼为持久指导，以支持后续探索。在间隔较长的检查点上，前沿模型 Navigator 会检查不断演化的候选群体，并根据搜索停滞情况，通过综合、精准改进或重新构思来介入。这种先推测、后整合的工作流程将常规探索和证据整合交由成本较低的模型处理，同时将前沿推理留给战略性介入，其收益可延伸至此后许多次低成本评估。在涵盖四个科学与算法发现领域的 176 项任务中，SpecEvo 的表现与前沿模型基线持平或更优，同时 API 成本最多降低 80%；在方程发现任务上的评估效率比高成本效益基线最多提高 1.5 倍，并且比最强的 CO-Bench 基线高 3.8%。这些结果表明，基于搜索轨迹进行模型协调，是实现高成本效益科学发现的一种有效方法。

    面向以人为中心环境的离线学徒学习

    Md Mirajul Islam

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The dissertation develops offline apprenticeship learning methods for reward modeling and demonstration quality, including hierarchical policies and decision-level credit assignment. This substantially advances learning and organizing decision-making systems; its connection to reasoning is partial because the abstract focuses on policy learning rather than reasoning mechanisms or capabilities.

    该论文围绕奖励建模和示范质量开发离线学徒学习方法，包括分层策略和决策层面的信用分配。这显著推动了决策系统的学习与组织；它与推理的联系较为有限，因为摘要关注的是策略学习，而非推理机制或能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Effective decision-making in human-centric environments such as Intelligent Tutoring Systems (ITSs) and clinical healthcare requires policies that are adaptive, data-efficient, and ethically deployable. Apprenticeship Learning (AL) infers policies directly from expert demonstrations by recovering the underlying reward structure, enabling strictly offline learning without environment interaction. This dissertation develops a progression of offline AL frameworks organized around two challenges: reward modeling and demonstration quality. For reward modeling, EM-EDM clusters demonstrations by latent reward functions and induces cluster-specific policies, and THEMES partitions trajectories into temporally coherent sub-trajectories guided by a hierarchically learned reward regulator; across one educational and three clinical datasets, THEMES outperforms flat and hierarchical AL baselines. For demonstration quality, HALIDE integrates continuous quality signals into hierarchical policy induction, enabling principled reuse of mixed-quality data under distribution shift. CCHAL further attributes quality to individual decisions via Bayesian credit assignment, dual-arm criticality scoring that contrasts expert and non-expert behavior, and a Bradley-Terry contrastive IRL objective over failure trajectories, outperforming baselines including HALIDE on three clinical EHR datasets and an ITS dataset. Finally, a real-world classroom evaluation of StuEDM, an EDM-induced policy that preserves student agency and intervenes only on disagreement, shows significant learning gains over an Expert baseline and a higher pretest-adjusted posttest score than a CQL policy trained on a far larger corpus, while overriding students less than half as often. Together, this work establishes offline AL as a practical, data-efficient, and ethically viable paradigm for human-centric environments.

    中文

    在智能辅导系统（ITS）和临床医疗等以人为中心的环境中，有效决策需要具备适应性、数据效率高且可合乎伦理地部署的策略。学徒学习（AL）通过恢复底层奖励结构，直接从专家示范中推断策略，从而无需与环境交互即可进行严格的离线学习。本论文逐步发展了一系列离线 AL 框架，围绕两个挑战展开：奖励建模和示范质量。在奖励建模方面，EM-EDM 根据潜在奖励函数对示范进行聚类，并为各个簇构建专属策略；THEMES 则将轨迹划分为时间上连贯的子轨迹，并由分层学习得到的奖励调节器提供引导。在一个教育数据集和三个临床数据集上，THEMES 的表现优于扁平式和分层式 AL 基线。在示范质量方面，HALIDE 将连续质量信号整合到分层策略推导中，使混合质量数据能在分布偏移下得到有原则的复用。CCHAL 进一步通过贝叶斯信用分配、对比专家与非专家行为的双臂关键性评分，以及基于失败轨迹的 Bradley-Terry 对比式 IRL 目标，将质量归因到单个决策；在三个临床 EHR 数据集和一个 ITS 数据集上，其表现优于包括 HALIDE 在内的基线。最后，对 StuEDM 进行的真实课堂评估显示，这一由 EDM 诱导的策略保留了学生自主权，仅在意见不一致时进行干预；与 Expert 基线相比，它带来了显著的学习增益，且其前测调整后后测分数高于在大得多的数据集上训练的 CQL 策略，同时干预学生的次数不到后者的一半。总之，这项工作确立了离线 AL 是一种适用于以人为中心环境的实用、高数据效率且符合伦理的范式。

    自动化科学机器学习：前沿智能体能否在真实环境中攀登科学高峰？

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Agent4Sci evaluates long-horizon scientific coding agents and identifies limitations in their research trajectories; lightweight skills improve performance and diversify interventions. This substantially advances evaluation and organization of agent task execution, while reasoning insight is partial because gains are attributed mainly to engineering tricks rather than research-level problem-solving.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Frontier coding agents are increasingly framed as end-to-end automated researchers, and ML for science offers a demanding test of that promise: improving a scientific model often requires domain insight beyond routine ML engineering. We introduce Agent4Sci, a long-horizon testbed for measuring how far today's agents can improve the published best models on scientific ML benchmarks, spanning 20 benchmarks across 11 domains. Rather than ranking agents on a leaderboard, Agent4Sci asks what kinds of progress agents can make on these tasks under in-the-wild conditions, and where they fall short. Empirically, today's frontier agents advance the published best on every benchmark, with Claude Opus reaching 10.4% mean relative improvement and no run flagged for academic misconduct. These gains, however, come almost entirely from a bag of ML-engineering tricks rather than research-level insight. Trajectory analysis surfaces three recurring limitations in this setting: novelty miscalibration, resource under-utilization, and rapid collapse into local engineering sweeps. Lightweight plug-in skills for research ideation, experiment management, and scheduled checklists raise Claude Opus from 10.4% to 20.1% and Codex from 4.4% to 8.1%, while yielding more diverse, domain-relevant interventions. Agent4Sci gives the community a way to track and push frontier agents from ML engineering toward domain insight on real-world ML-for-science problems. Code and data are available on GitHub (https://github.com/maszhongming/agent4sci) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/datasets/MingZhong/agent4sci).

    中文

    前沿编程智能体越来越常被描述为端到端的自动化研究者，而科学机器学习为这一设想提供了严苛的检验：改进科学模型往往需要超出常规机器学习工程的领域洞见。我们提出 Agent4Sci，这是一个长时程测试平台，用于衡量当今智能体能够在多大程度上改进科学机器学习基准上已发表的最佳模型，涵盖 11 个领域的 20 个基准。Agent4Sci 不对智能体进行排行榜排名，而是考察它们在真实环境条件下能够取得何种进展，以及有哪些不足。实证结果显示，当今的前沿智能体在每个基准上都超越了已发表的最佳结果；Claude Opus 的平均相对提升达到 10.4%，且没有一次运行被标记为学术不端。然而，这些提升几乎完全来自一系列机器学习工程技巧，而非研究层面的洞见。对执行轨迹的分析揭示了这一场景中的三个反复出现的局限：对新颖性的校准失当、资源利用不足，以及迅速陷入局部工程调优。用于研究构思、实验管理和定期检查清单的轻量级插件技能，将 Claude Opus 的表现从 10.4% 提升至 20.1%，将 Codex 的表现从 4.4% 提升至 8.1%，同时带来了更多样且与领域相关的干预。Agent4Sci 为研究社区提供了一种方法，用于跟踪并推动前沿智能体从机器学习工程走向对现实世界科学机器学习问题的领域洞见。代码和数据见 GitHub（https://github.com/maszhongming/agent4sci）和 Hugging Face（https://huggingface.co/datasets/MingZhong/agent4sci）。

    Hieu Tran, Hong Yu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SDI uses imagined action sequences and a shared actor reference to guide exploration and gate planning in world-model agents, with comparative evaluations and ablations. This substantially advances planning and agent organization; composition is only incidental because the abstract does not study compositional representations or generalization.

    SDI 利用想象的动作序列和共享的 actor 参考，引导世界模型智能体进行探索并决定是否启用规划，同时开展了比较评估和消融研究。这显著推动了规划和智能体组织的发展；组合性仅间接相关，因为摘要没有研究组合表征或泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    World models let agents compare imagined outcomes before acting, but an agent must still decide which alternatives to explore and when a proposed plan should replace its learned policy. We introduce SDI (Sibling Disagreement in Imagination), which connects these decisions through a shared actor-based reference. SDI compares action sequences imagined from the same model state, using repeated rollouts of the actor's own sequence to measure variation under fixed behavior. This reference scales both the spread across candidate returns, which provides an exploration signal, and a proposed plan's predicted advantage, which governs action acceptance. The agent executes a planned action when its advantage exceeds the reference variability by a fixed factor; otherwise, it follows the actor. SDI reuses the base agent's world model, actor, and critic without requiring an additional disagreement ensemble. Exploration and planning guide training data collection, while evaluation uses the learned actor alone. Across Meta-World, Adroit, and DM-Control, SDI achieves a higher observed task-average score than every compared baseline in each suite and matches or exceeds the strongest baseline's performance on 15 of 18 tasks. Component ablations and robustness analyses further examine the roles of exploration, planning exposure, and action acceptance. Paired evaluations from identical simulator states show that the gate improves both recovery from actor failures and preservation of successful behavior relative to ungated planning, while substantially reducing return degradation. Together, these results support comparing imagined alternatives against a shared actor reference as a unified approach to exploring and planning with world models.

    中文

    世界模型让智能体可以在行动前比较想象中的结果，但智能体仍需决定探索哪些备选方案，以及何时用一个提议的计划取代已学习的策略。我们提出 SDI（想象中的同源分歧），通过一个共享的、基于 actor 的参考将这两个决策联系起来。SDI 比较从同一模型状态想象出的动作序列，并通过对 actor 自身序列进行重复 rollout，衡量固定行为下的变化程度。这个参考尺度同时作用于候选回报的离散程度（提供探索信号）以及提议计划的预测优势（决定是否接受该动作）。当计划动作的优势超过参考变化幅度的固定倍数时，智能体就执行该动作；否则，它遵循 actor。SDI 复用基础智能体的世界模型、actor 和 critic，无需额外的分歧集成模型。探索和规划用于引导训练数据收集，而评估时仅使用学习到的 actor。在 Meta-World、Adroit 和 DM-Control 上，SDI 在每个测试套件中的观测任务平均分都高于所有对比基线，并在 18 项任务中的 15 项达到或超过最强基线的表现。组件消融和鲁棒性分析进一步考察了探索、规划训练暴露和动作接受机制的作用。从相同模拟器状态开始的配对评估表明，与不设门控的规划相比，该门控既能改善 actor 失败后的恢复能力，也能保留成功行为，同时显著减少回报下降。总之，这些结果表明，将想象中的备选方案与共享的 actor 参考进行比较，是一种统一的世界模型探索与规划方法。

    The paper develops calibrated rollout allocation for tool-using agents, forecasting reward disagreement to spend training generation budget more effectively, and evaluates it in MCP environments. This is a substantial contribution to agent training and resource allocation; reasoning is incidental because the abstract addresses rollout efficiency, not reasoning mechanisms or capabilities.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Training tool-using language models requires costly interaction, yet identical rewards within a rollout group provide no group-relative learning signal. We use reward disagreement to guide harness evaluation and the allocation of rollouts for policy training in Model Context Protocol (MCP) environments. We first introduce Discord, which tests harness edits using exact paired inference and decision-preserving early stopping: only disagreeing paired outcomes favor one harness over another. This insight motivates prospective allocation in BRACE (Bank-calibrated Rollout Allocation under Correlated Episodes). BRACE combines historical task evidence, uncertainty in task success rates, and a correlated reward model to forecast mixed-reward groups before allocating generation budget. Controlled harness experiments favor Discord, while live MCP experiments expose a retention-cost trade-off. At three Qwen3-VL model scales, BRACE exceeds the strongest plotted baseline peaks with fewer new training rollouts; historical-bank collection is counted separately. It also leads the compared methods on BFCL and NESTFUL without further training. Ablations probe the bank, estimator, and allocation score; prospective evaluation checks forecast calibration. These results support forecasting reward contrast before generation.

    A Mechanistic Study of Automated Failure Attribution in LLM-based Agentic Systems

    LLM 智能体系统中自动化故障归因的机制研究

    Wendy Zheng, Liang Wu, Yinhan He, Mayank Darbari, Jundong Li, Liangjie Hong

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Using linear probes and grafting, the paper shows that models encode failure-attribution information they do not reliably verbalize, then uses that latent knowledge to improve attribution. This is a substantial contribution to studying internal representations, with a secondary connection to reasoning evaluation; multi-agent systems are the setting rather than the main advance.

    本文利用线性探针和嫁接方法表明，模型编码了故障归因信息，却无法可靠地将其表达出来；随后利用这一潜在知识改进归因。这对研究内部表征作出了重要贡献，同时也与推理评估有次要关联；多智能体系统是研究背景，而非主要进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agentic systems have demonstrated strong capabilities on complex tasks by enabling multiple interacting large language model (LLM)-based agents to collaborate and execute subtasks in parallel. However, this collaborative structure introduces new challenges for reliably evaluating and diagnosing system failures, particularly failure attribution: tracing a system's execution to identify the agent step responsible for an incorrect final outcome. Because manually performing this task is time- and labor-intensive, recent work has turned to LLMs as judges to automate the process, referred to as automated failure attribution (AFA). These approaches assume that a sufficiently capable model can infer the failing step directly from an interaction transcript. In practice, however, direct prompting often performs poorly, which motivates follow-up work that explores various ways to improve AFA performance, including alternative prompting strategies and inference-time interventions. In this paper, we examine a more fundamental question: whether this weak behavioral performance reflects a genuine capability limitation. Using linear probes applied to internal activations, we uncover a significant \emph{knows-but-won't-say gap:} models encode sufficient information to attribute a failure correctly but fail to explicitly output the responsible step. Building on this finding, we propose \emph{grafting}, a simple manual intervention that exploits knowledge already encoded in the model to improve AFA performance without requiring ground-truth labels at inference time. Extensive evaluations across multiple LLMs and benchmark settings demonstrate that grafting consistently outperforms direct-prompting approaches, underscoring the potential of leveraging latent model knowledge for more reliable failure attribution. Our code is available at https://github.com/wendyzheng22/mi4afa.

    中文

    智能体系统通过使多个相互交互的、基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体协作并并行执行子任务，在复杂任务上展现出强大能力。然而，这种协作结构也给系统故障的可靠评估和诊断带来了新的挑战，尤其是故障归因：追踪系统的执行过程，以找出导致最终结果错误的智能体步骤。由于人工执行这项任务耗时费力，近期研究转而使用 LLM 作为评判者来自动完成这一过程，称为自动化故障归因（AFA）。这些方法假设能力足够强的模型能够直接从交互记录中推断出发生故障的步骤。然而在实践中，直接提示往往表现不佳，因此后续研究探索了多种提升 AFA 性能的方法，包括替代提示策略和推理时干预。在本文中，我们考察一个更根本的问题：这种较弱的行为表现是否反映了真实的能力限制。我们对内部激活应用线性探针，发现了显著的\emph{知而不言差距：}模型编码了足以正确归因故障的信息，却未能明确输出相关步骤。基于这一发现，我们提出\emph{嫁接（grafting）}，一种简单的手动干预，它利用模型中已编码的知识来提升 AFA 性能，且无需在推理时使用真实标签。在多个 LLM 和基准测试设置上进行的大量评估表明，嫁接方法始终优于直接提示方法，凸显了利用模型潜在知识实现更可靠故障归因的潜力。我们的代码见 https://github.com/wendyzheng22/mi4afa。

    Agentic harness evolution optimizes an agent's instructions, tools, and control flow by using its task execution experiences as evolving evidence. While more evolution tasks should intuitively improve performance, our preliminary study reveals a paradoxical failure mode: the performance of existing methods degrades as the task pool expands. Our further analysis demonstrates that this degradation stems from suboptimal evidence selection during optimization, as different evidence combinations lead to substantially different evolution outcomes. To address this issue, we propose Successive Scale Racing (SSR), a framework that adaptively searches for optimal evidence combinations in each evolution round. SSR constructs diverse evidence combinations based on the corresponding task quality and coverage, and efficiently races the resulting candidate harnesses under a small compute budget. Empirically, across three distinct benchmarks, SSR achieves state-of-the-art results in all six configurations. Notably, as the task pool grows from 40 to 200, SSR steadily improves the pass rate from 64.3% to 68.3%, while the baselines' performances all drop. Furthermore, its racing mechanism identifies near-optimal candidates while reducing validation executions by 60%.
