    脆弱是设计使然吗？面向系统之系统稳健任务协调的多场景强化学习

    \.Ibrahim O\u{g}uz \c{C}etinkaya, Sajad Khodadadian, Taylan Topcu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper contributes an RL-based coordinator and evidence that training across mission scenarios improves transfer and robustness. This is a substantial agent-system contribution; scenario transfer is only an incidental connection to compositional generalization, and the abstract does not investigate reasoning mechanisms.

    本文提出一种基于 RL 的协调器，并证明跨任务情景训练能够提升迁移能力和稳健性。这对智能体系统作出了重要贡献；情景迁移仅与组合泛化有间接关联，摘要也没有研究推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As systems engineering (SE) shifts from monolithic systems to Systems of Systems, Mission Engineering (ME) has emerged as a new line of thinking in SE. Mission environments are uncertain and dynamic, and outcomes depend on how mission assets interact with them, rendering static architectures brittle and calling for flexible yet analytically rigorous ME approaches. We propose an intelligent mission coordination methodology integrating high-fidelity digital mission models with Reinforcement Learning (RL) for adaptive task allocation. Using a Digital Engineering (DE) infrastructure comprising a digital mission model and agent-based simulation, we formulate mission tactics management as a Markov Decision Process and train an RL coordinator with Proximal Policy Optimization to map mission states to tactical actions from realized outcomes. An aerial firefighting mission with three scenarios demonstrates the approach. First, all trained coordinators significantly outperform random and heuristic baselines. Second, single-scenario coordinators can be brittle: the coordinator trained on the more forgiving scenario degrades to random tactics performance in more demanding scenarios, whereas the demanding-scenario coordinator retains most of its advantage when transferred. Third, within the same training budget, a coordinator trained on both scenarios concurrently matches the scenario-specific coordinators in their own scenarios and significantly outperforms every other policy. Sensitivity analyses on ignition location, weather, scenario, and training curricula show that the variability represented during training shapes post-deployment performance. This proof of concept shows DE-enabled mission simulations combined with RL offer a reusable methodology for improving ME practice, which can be extended to fleet design and selection from a mission-first perspective.

    随着系统工程（SE）从单体系统转向系统之系统，任务工程（ME）已成为 SE 中一种新的思路。任务环境不确定且动态，结果取决于任务资产如何与环境交互，这使静态架构容易变得脆弱，也要求 ME 方法既灵活又具备严谨的分析基础。我们提出一种智能任务协调方法，将高保真数字任务模型与强化学习（RL）相结合，以实现自适应任务分配。我们使用由数字任务模型和基于智能体的仿真组成的数字工程（DE）基础设施，将任务战术管理建模为马尔可夫决策过程，并使用近端策略优化训练 RL 协调器，使其根据实际结果将任务状态映射为战术行动。我们以包含三种情景的空中消防任务展示该方法。首先，所有训练出的协调器都显著优于随机和启发式基线。其次，单一情景协调器可能很脆弱：在较宽松情景上训练的协调器，在要求更高的情景中会退化至随机战术的表现；而在高难度情景上训练的协调器迁移后仍保留了大部分优势。第三，在相同训练预算内，同时针对两种情景训练的协调器，在各自情景中的表现可与情景专用协调器相当，并显著优于其他所有策略。对起火位置、天气、情景和训练课程的敏感性分析表明，训练期间所涵盖的变化会影响部署后的表现。这一概念验证表明，将 DE 支持的任务仿真与 RL 相结合，能提供一种可复用的方法来改进 ME 实践，并可从任务优先的视角扩展到舰队设计与选择。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Inference-time scaling is often treated as a token-budget problem, but a failed coding agent can seek qualitatively different resources: computation, information, or feedback. We introduce Banzhaf Resource Attribution (BRA), a controlled factorial framework that measures each resource's marginal contribution to repair and its interactions while holding the failed state and revision protocol fixed. We evaluate six models on 194 function-level failures from MBPP+ and HumanEval+ and 126 repository-level failures from SWE-bench Verified. Task-relevant specifications consistently improve repair, whereas public-test feedback provides small gains and retrieved code little to none. The value of additional computation declines with model capability, while information remains useful; resource channels largely exhibit diminishing returns, although complementary information can reinforce itself. Yet three of four frontier models select feedback in 95-100% of cases and obtain lower gains than uniform random resource selection. BRA thus exposes a gap between the resources agents prefer and those that measurably improve repair.

    When Do Gaussian Priors Fail? A Latent Geometry Investigation of RL Fine-Tuning

    高斯先验何时失效？对强化学习微调的潜在几何研究

    Wang Ru

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies latent mode overlap as the geometric mediator of RL fine-tuning collapse and tests the causal chain through controlled interventions, offering substantial insight into learned-policy behavior. Its RL setting is relevant to training for problem-solving, but the abstract does not focus on reasoning capabilities; the VAE and prior are modeling tools rather than a model or agent systems contribution.

    本文识别出潜在模式重叠是 RL 微调崩溃的几何中介，并通过受控干预测试因果链，为理解习得策略的行为提供了重要洞见。其 RL 背景与问题求解训练相关，但摘要并不以推理能力为重点；VAE 和先验是建模工具，而不是模型或智能体系统方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Latent diffusion models almost universally place a Gaussian prior on the VAE latent space. For base generation this default is unproblematic; under reinforcement-learning fine-tuning, however, it carries a structural limitation. The standard VAE's KL term does not merely ignore mode structure - it actively taxes separation and tightness. When data are multimodal, the ELBO optimum compresses distinct modes into an overlapping latent. RL fine-tuning amplifies this overlap: the score network is under-resolved on the saddle region between modes, dynamic-to-variational amplification rises sharply, and the collapse boundary beta_c is pushed far above its variational scale. On the real alanine-dipeptide Boltzmann distribution, a Gaussian-prior VAE collapses at beta_c = 0.224 while a mode-tracked Gaussian-mixture prior collapses at 0.00316, a 71x gap from the same pipeline. We trace this gap to a single geometric mediator, d_min/(2 sigma_0), and verify the causal chain through controlled interventions: moving geometry at fixed prior, and switching prior at matched geometry (full mediation; prior-label coefficient 0.995x, 95% CI [0.79, 1.25]). A three-source decomposition localises the amplification to the learned policy (zero ODE-solver contribution, bounded anchor mismatch); the coverage plateau is an unconditional benefit of mode-separating priors that no amount of RL capacity recovers. The remedy is conditional: a non-Gaussian prior is necessary precisely when the latent geometry would fall into overlap and the task is coverage-sensitive. A machine-checked theory skeleton supports the KL pricing structure - a divergent compactness tax under a Gaussian prior versus a finite assignment fee under a mixture - and the position-versus-plateau distinction delimits what is finite-resource from what requires changing the prior.

    中文

    潜在扩散模型几乎一律在 VAE 潜在空间上采用高斯先验。对于基础生成而言，这种默认设置没有问题；然而在强化学习微调中，它存在结构性局限。标准 VAE 的 KL 项不只是忽略模式结构，而是会主动加重模式分离和紧致性的代价。当数据具有多模态时，ELBO 最优解会将不同模式压缩到相互重叠的潜在空间中。RL 微调会放大这种重叠：分数网络无法充分解析模式之间的鞍形区域，动态到变分的放大效应急剧上升，崩溃边界 beta_c 也远高于其变分尺度。在真实的丙氨酸二肽玻尔兹曼分布上，高斯先验 VAE 在 beta_c = 0.224 时崩溃，而模式跟踪高斯混合先验在 0.00316 时崩溃；使用同一流程，两者相差 71 倍。我们将这一差距追溯到单一几何中介量 d_min/(2 sigma_0)，并通过受控干预验证因果链：在先验固定时移动几何结构，以及在几何结构匹配时切换先验（完全中介；先验标签系数为 0.995 倍，95% 置信区间为 [0.79, 1.25]）。三来源分解将放大效应定位到习得策略（ODE 求解器贡献为零，锚点不匹配有界）；覆盖率平台是模式分离先验的一项无条件优势，无论 RL 容量多大都无法恢复。补救措施有其适用条件：只有当潜在几何结构会陷入重叠且任务对覆盖率敏感时，非高斯先验才是必要的。经机器检查的理论框架支撑了 KL 定价结构——高斯先验下紧致性的代价会发散，而混合先验下则是有限的分配费用——而位置与平台的区分界定了哪些问题可通过有限资源解决，哪些问题需要更换先验。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-horizon robotic operation requires memory that scales with essential information rather than execution time. We present a parameter-space memory framework where each episode is stored as a separable object. A neural implicit representation is fitted to episode video from a shared, meta-learned initialization; the resulting weight delta constitutes the memory. Crucially, this delta remains a fixed size regardless of whether the episode spans a hundred or a hundred thousand frames. A learned projector maps the weight delta into token embeddings, conditioning a language model for question answering and a decoder for joint command regression, without frame retrieval at query time. On RoboMME, the language model exceeds chance across all question types, and the decoder achieves a mean $R^2$ of 0.51. Replacing the delta with matched noise drops performance by 11.4 points, while random-origin weights are non-decodable, proving the meta-learned initialization is essential for embedding episode content. By representing individual experiences as fixed-size weight deltas in a common parameter space, this approach decouples memory cost from time horizon and provides a basis for scalable streaming memory.

    Shixuan Liu, Cheng Tang, Yuzheng Hu, Fan Wu, Han Zhao, Jiaqi W. Ma

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper formalizes non-local training-data influence in online RL and develops a theoretically analyzed estimator that informs experience filtering. This substantially advances understanding and improvement of RL training for decision-making, while policy interpretation is an application context rather than a study of internal representations, and the filtering method alone gives only an incidental systems connection.

    本文将在线 RL 中非局部训练数据影响形式化，并开发了经过理论分析、可用于经验过滤的估计器。这显著推动了对用于决策的 RL 训练的理解与改进；策略解释只是应用背景，并非对内部表征的研究，而过滤方法本身与系统研究只有间接关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Online reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved significant success in decision-making tasks, but modern online RL remains highly sensitive to the quality of training experience. Understanding the contribution of individual training instances is therefore central to data-centric RL, with applications ranging from experience selection to policy interpretation. Existing data attribution methods for online RL primarily focus on local influence within a single training round, overlooking the non-local data influence across multiple training rounds. In this work, we formalize data attribution in online RL through a trajectory-level leave-one-out quantity, RL-LOO, which measures how one training sample influences a downstream target after subsequent online updates have taken place. We then derive RL-IF, a first-order estimator that propagates data influence through both optimization effects and policy-induced sampling effects, and provide theoretical guarantees on its approximation accuracy under smoothness assumptions. Our analysis further disentangles these two effects and shows both theoretically and empirically that the full RL-IF estimator can often be well approximated using the optimization effect alone. Building on this observation, we develop RINSE, a practical data filtering method for online RL. Experiments on standard control benchmarks and an RLHF-style toxicity-mitigation setting show that RINSE improves training efficiency and final performance over standard PPO and local attribution baselines. These results suggest that RL-IF provides a practical and principled framework for understanding and improving online RL.

    在线强化学习（RL）在决策任务中取得了显著成功，但现代在线 RL 仍对训练经验的质量高度敏感。因此，理解单个训练样本的贡献是以数据为中心的 RL 的核心，应用范围从经验选择到策略解释。现有在线 RL 数据归因方法主要关注单个训练轮次内的局部影响，忽略了跨多个训练轮次的非局部数据影响。在这项工作中，我们通过轨迹级留一法量 RL-LOO，将在线 RL 中的数据归因形式化；该量衡量一个训练样本在后续在线更新发生后对下游目标的影响。随后，我们推导出 RL-IF，这是一种一阶估计器，能够通过优化效应和策略诱导的采样效应传播数据影响，并在光滑性假设下为其近似精度提供理论保证。我们的分析还进一步拆分了这两种效应，并从理论和实证两方面表明，完整的 RL-IF 估计器通常可以仅用优化效应很好地近似。基于这一观察，我们开发了 RINSE，一种实用的在线 RL 数据过滤方法。在标准控制基准和类 RLHF 的毒性缓解设置上的实验表明，与标准 PPO 和局部归因基线相比，RINSE 提高了训练效率和最终性能。这些结果表明，RL-IF 为理解和改进在线 RL 提供了实用且有原则的框架。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Autonomous agents can increasingly propose ideas, modify code, and run experiments, creating an opportunity to accelerate scientific discovery using teams of collaborative AI researchers. To escape local minima in the discovery, we propose to encourage orthogonal exploration by constructing the team using agents with varying expertise. However, realizing this design requires more than diverse backgrounds. When experiments are costly, a team can test only a limited number of ideas, thereby creating the need to balance exploration and exploitation when selecting a subset of researchers to propose and execute new experiments. Furthermore, each result should shape what the team tries next. We therefore ask how AI researchers with different scientific backgrounds can build on one another's findings and sustain progress under a limited experimental budget. To address these challenges, we build a team of persistent AI researchers, each grounded in a different discipline, who keep private research histories, share experimental evidence, and receive research opportunities through adaptive allocation. We demonstrate the effectiveness of this design by deploying the team to search for linear attention architectures, where it outperforms GDN2 at 1.3B scale on language modeling, common-sense reasoning, and synthetic and real-world retrieval tasks. In controlled comparisons, removing any single organizational component from our design yields markedly weaker discoveries: without disciplinary backgrounds, the search plateaus early; without private histories, researchers make less progress despite identical shared evidence; and uniform selection falls short of adaptive allocation within the same budget. These results suggest that sustained autonomous discovery depends not only on stronger agents, but also on who explores, what they remember, and how research effort is allocated.

    Zijie Liu, Zhen Tan, Charles Fleming, Tianlong Chen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SST recasts new-domain examples as reusable skill schemas and reports less forgetting and better generalization, offering a substantive contribution to procedural reuse and composition. It does not investigate internal representations or reasoning mechanisms, and post-training alone is only incidental to model systems.

    SST 将新领域示例重构为可复用的技能模式，并报告了更少的遗忘和更好的泛化，为流程复用与组合能力作出了实质贡献。它并未研究内部表征或推理机制，而后训练本身与模型系统研究仅有间接关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Adapting language models to new domains during post-training risks degrading previously acquired capabilities, a phenomenon commonly known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing mitigation methods largely treat forgetting as a consequence of excessive model drift. They therefore constrain updates by preserving old outputs, replaying old data, or regularizing changes to parameters and representations so that the updated model remains close to its previous state. We take a different view: Rather than pulling the updated model back toward its old state, we translate the new domain into the model's pre-existing knowledge space, making unfamiliar knowledge learnable through familiar procedures. Therefore, we propose Skill Schema Transport (SST), a post-training framework that transports new knowledge into the model's existing skill space. SST abstracts each example type into a skill schema, preserving its essential operations, dependencies, and verification steps while removing domain-specific surface forms. By recasting new examples as instances of reusable procedures, SST turns knowledge update from trajectory memorization into procedural reuse. In continual domain adaptation settings, SST consistently reduces forgetting while improving generalization to related tasks. Across two 3B instruction-tuned backbones, SST improves average final performance on streamed domains by 2.53 to 5.75 points over sequential post-training. It also lowers max-drop forgetting in all evaluated settings, with the largest reduction from 42.41 to 7.10 points on the Qwen-3B MATH stream, while substantially recovering the OOD degradation induced by sequential updates.

    在后训练期间将语言模型适配到新领域，可能导致其先前获得的能力下降，这种现象通常称为灾难性遗忘。现有缓解方法大多将遗忘视为模型漂移过度的结果。因此，它们通过保留旧输出、重放旧数据，或对参数和表征的变化进行正则化来约束更新，使更新后的模型接近原有状态。我们采取不同的观点：我们不将更新后的模型拉回旧状态，而是将新领域转换到模型已有的知识空间中，使模型能够通过熟悉的流程学习陌生知识。因此，我们提出技能模式迁移（Skill Schema Transport，SST），一种将新知识迁移到模型现有技能空间的后训练框架。SST 将每种示例类型抽象为技能模式，在去除领域特定表面形式的同时，保留其关键操作、依赖关系和验证步骤。通过将新示例重构为可复用流程的实例，SST 将知识更新从轨迹记忆转变为流程复用。在持续领域适应设置中，SST 始终能减少遗忘，同时提升对相关任务的泛化能力。在两个经过指令微调的 3B 主干模型上，与顺序后训练相比，SST 在流式领域上的最终平均性能提高了 2.53 至 5.75 分。它还在所有评估设置中降低了最大性能跌幅；在 Qwen-3B MATH 流上，降幅最大，从 42.41 分降至 7.10 分，同时显著恢复了顺序更新造成的 OOD 性能下降。

    ENGLISH

    Refusal directions have been shown to transfer cross-lingually with near-perfect effectiveness across safety-aligned languages (Wang et al., 2025), reportedly regardless of resource level. However, the only truly low-resourced language evaluated is Yoruba, which is strongly misaligned and shows limited transfer, leaving open how refusal directions behave for other low-resourced languages. We extend PolyRefuse to three additional low-resourced languages (Belarusian, Bashkir, and Tajik) and replicate the pipeline of (Wang et al., 2025) on Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct. We find that universality is graded rather than binary: directions from safety-aligned and partially-aligned languages transfer broadly, while those from strongly misaligned languages fail to reliably modulate refusal behavior on any target tested, including other misaligned languages, once ceiling effects are accounted for. Geometric alignment and behavioral transfer are further shown to be partially dissociated. These findings complicate the universality claim and suggest that users of the least-resourced, most strongly misaligned languages may face weaker safety guarantees.

(2025) 的流程。我们发现，普遍性是程度上的差异，而非非此即彼：来自经过安全对齐和部分对齐语言的方向能够广泛迁移；而来自严重失配语言的方向，在考虑天花板效应后，无法可靠地调节任何受测目标语言（包括其他失配语言）中的拒绝行为。研究还表明，几何对齐与行为迁移仅部分相关。这些发现使普遍性这一主张变得更为复杂，并表明，使用资源最匮乏且失配最严重语言的用户可能面临较弱的安全保障。

    Deep research systems iteratively plan, gather evidence, synthesize, and revise, making end-to-end latency a key bottleneck for interactive use. Almost all production systems are built on autoregressive (AR) language models and inherit left-to-right decoding in planning and long-form writing. We present DiffResearch, an open multi-agent deep research framework that places a diffusion language model (dLLM) at the core of every stage, and measure how a diffusion backbone changes latency and report quality. Holding the agentic scaffold, retrieval code, prompts, and evaluation fixed, we swap the backbone between an open diffusion model and a comparable AR model. Across 100 Deep Research Bench tasks, the diffusion backbone is roughly 6 times faster end-to-end, driven by order-of-magnitude reductions in planning and writing. We further introduce dFast, a decomposition mode that reads intermediate denoising states and extracts subqueries before generation finishes, providing a 1.99 times median speedup for decomposition in isolation with no loss of report quality. On the benchmark's RACE rubric, dFast obtains the best overall score among the three configurations. Finally, in a public system-level leaderboard snapshot, an instance built on a stronger diffusion model ranks above several commercial systems. We release DiffResearch under an Apache-2.0 license.

    D-Skill 将成对智能体执行轨迹中的行为经验蒸馏为自然语言技能，从而在推理时提升较小模型的表现，因此它对智能体能力迁移和系统设计作出了重要贡献。它通过任务表现提供了有限的推理洞见，但未研究内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Frontier language-model agents excel at complex tasks, but high inference costs make transferring their capabilities to smaller models essential. Traditional knowledge distillation achieves this through parameter updates, requiring access to the student's weights and additional training compute while encoding the transferred knowledge implicitly in the parameters. We introduce D-Skill, a framework that treats the teacher as a black box and distills its behavioral advantage into an interpretable natural-language skill by analyzing paired rollouts and identifying behavioral divergences and agreements. The resulting lessons are consolidated offline, with any compatible skill-update backend, into a skill document that is provided to the student at inference time. D-Skill constructs the skill entirely offline from fixed trajectories, without labels, further environment interaction, or weight updates after rollout collection. Across SpreadsheetBench-Verified, ALFWorld, and chess puzzles spanning multiple teacher-student pairs, D-Skill closes 75%-95% of the teacher-student gap without touching model weights. After a single offline pass over the paired traces, D-Skill outperforms one-epoch SFT baselines and remains competitive with multi-epoch SFT. Under the same model family, the resulting student also incurs 5.7x-8.3x lower inference cost per task than the teacher. Our results demonstrate that natural-language skill distillation offers a performant, interpretable, and efficient alternative to weight-based capability transfer.

    Xu Li, Simon Yu, Minzhou Pan, Yiyou Sun, Zhaorun Chen, Bo Li, and Weiyan Shi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a benchmark for coding-agent backup awareness and a tool-call backup layer that preserves and restores state. Its agent architecture and state management make a substantial systems contribution; backup awareness is related to planning, but the abstract does not show a reasoning-mechanism contribution.

    该论文提出了一个用于衡量编码智能体备份意识的基准，以及一个能够保存和恢复状态的工具调用备份层。其智能体架构和状态管理对系统作出了重要贡献；备份意识与规划有关，但摘要未展示推理机制方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Coding agents now complete tasks autonomously, modifying real-world state such as artifacts, software environments, and configurations along the way. Yet they show limited backup awareness: recognizing that an action will modify state that may later be needed, and preserving it beforehand. To evaluate backup awareness, we introduce RegretBench, a benchmark of 205 executable tasks grounded in regret moments reported on platforms such as X.com, GitHub, and Stack Overflow, where users explicitly regretted not preserving state they later needed. Across six frontier models, agents complete 86.1% of tasks on average yet back up before these moments in only 15.2%, showing that task completion ability does not imply backup awareness. Because it is hard to predict which changes will be regretted, we propose BackUpper, a harness plug-in backup layer that checks every tool call and preserves affected state before modification. It combines rule-based strategies for common operations with a lightweight subagent for complex cases, and its rule table can expand with subagent decisions over time. On RegretBench, BackUpper covers every regret moment action and restores states with 92.2% average similarity to the original. Achieving this costs only $0.014 per task, with 7x fewer tokens than the main-agent self-backup baseline. When users have preferences on what to back up, BackUpper can also narrow its scope accordingly, matching human annotations on whether an action is worth preserving with an 84.5% F1 score. These results suggest that agents can keep actions reversible at low cost while respecting users' preferences.

    中文

    编码智能体如今能够自主完成任务，并在过程中修改真实世界状态，例如制品、软件环境和配置。然而，它们的备份意识仍然有限：无法充分识别某项操作会修改日后可能需要的状态，也无法在操作前将其保存。为评估备份意识，我们推出 RegretBench，这是一个包含 205 项可执行任务的基准，任务取材于用户在 X.com、GitHub 和 Stack Overflow 等平台上报告的遗憾时刻；用户明确表示，他们后悔没有保存后来需要的状态。在六个前沿模型上，智能体平均完成了 86.1% 的任务，却仅在 15.2% 的这些时刻到来前进行了备份，这表明完成任务的能力并不意味着具备备份意识。由于很难预测哪些更改会令人后悔，我们提出 BackUpper 这一作为工具框架插件的备份层：它检查每次工具调用，并在状态被修改前保存受影响的状态。该系统将常见操作的基于规则的策略与处理复杂情况的轻量级子智能体相结合，其规则表还可随时间根据子智能体的决策扩充。在 RegretBench 上，BackUpper 覆盖了每个遗憾时刻对应的操作，并将状态恢复到与原始状态平均相似度为 92.2% 的程度。实现这一点的成本仅为每项任务 $0.014，所用 token 数比主智能体自行备份的基线少 7 倍。当用户对备份内容有偏好时，BackUpper 还可以据此缩小备份范围；在判断某项操作是否值得保存这一问题上，它与人工标注达到 84.5% 的 F1 分数。这些结果表明，智能体能够以较低成本保持操作的可逆性，同时尊重用户偏好。

    Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to interact with environments and improve their decisions during deployment. However, how anticipating future outcomes and drawing on accumulated interaction experience can jointly support decision-making remains underexplored. We propose a test-time framework, inspired by Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control, that combines multi-branch predictive analysis with experience-based adaptation. At each step, the agent proposes multiple candidate actions and imagines their outcomes with a world model, so that alternatives can be compared without being executed in the environment. Since language environments provide neither explicit dynamics nor costs, the predicted outcomes are evaluated for task progress and risk, and MPPI-style weights over the resulting costs guide the final decision. A dual-branch experience memory enables self-improvement: the planner branch refines candidate generation and action selection, while the world model branch improves next-observation prediction. Experiments on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld across three backbones demonstrate the strong overall performance of our method and the effectiveness of experience-guided predictive control. Our code will be made publicly available.

    NVIDIA tensor cores have supported 2:4 semi-structured sparsity since Ampere, and the pattern composes with quantization. When the two are combined, the practical question is which step to take next: from a given precision, add 2:4 sparsity or drop to the next lower precision? We compare the two at equal bits, with sparsity metadata counted, and at equal nominal tensor-core tiers, over all six GEMM operands of a transformer layer, with kernels measured on three GPU generations and online pruning and quantization included. Our results show that as long as a lower precision is available, adding 2:4 is the worse step, both less accurate and slower, because the energy that 2:4 discards from each group of four along the hardware-forced axis does not shrink with bits, while quantization error does. Once quantization reaches the lowest precision the hardware supports, 2:4 still speeds up linear layers by 1.3--1.7\x{}, and on an H100 a retrained 2:4 model served in FP8 by vLLM reaches 27\% higher prefill throughput than the dense FP8 model, with GSM8K accuracy on par. Its quality has to be won back by retraining, however, which restores perplexity long before reasoning; on Blackwell, whose sparse FP4 uses a pairwise 4:8 pattern, the loss is larger and our retraining budget did not recover it.

    Weizhe Xu, Jialiang Fan, Essien Taylor, Zijun Wang, Russell Joseph, and Fanxin Kong

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SLoSa develops and evaluates a compact robotic planner trained with verification-guided reinforcement learning to meet safety constraints under deployment limits. Planning and reasoning training are substantial contributions; resource-efficient deployment and the neuro-symbolic framework support Systems, while task composition is not a central contribution.

    SLoSa 开发并评估了一种紧凑型机器人规划器，通过验证引导的强化学习训练，使其能在部署限制下满足安全约束。规划与推理训练是重要贡献；高资源效率部署和神经符号框架则支持系统方面的贡献，而任务组合并非核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Safe robotic task planning requires planners that can reliably achieve task goals while satisfying safety constraints. Classical planners search over explicit symbolic task representations and can provide formal guarantees with respect to encoded safety constraints, but require rigid input formats. Their computational cost also increases rapidly with the search space. In contrast, large language models (LLMs) offer flexible task interfaces and strong generalization capabilities, but they are large, power-hungry, and pre-trained with little robot-specific safety data and knowledge. Thus, they can be difficult to deploy locally on robotic systems with limited resources. To address these limitations, we present SLoSa, a neuro-symbolic compression and fine-tuning framework for training foundation-model-based robotic task planners with Small size, Low power demand, and Safety awareness. The framework first constructs a safety-aware dataset using classical planners, an advanced teacher LLM, and formal verifiers, followed by two training stages: supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning guided by a verification-based reward machine to enforce safety alignment. We evaluate SLoSa across four Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) domains, two household simulation environments, local edge platforms, and a desktop robotic arm. Across the PDDL tasks, verifier-guided post-training raises the success rate of compact 4B-14B planners to 70.5-76.0%, while INT4 deployment on a Jetson Orin requires 17.85-26.41 W of average power. Results in household simulators and on the physical robot further demonstrate the applicability of SLoSa across diverse robotic task settings.

    Transformers as Generic Deep Neural Networks: Exact Compilation, the Cost of Removing Activation-Activation Products, and Multi-Agent Attention Clustering

    作为通用深度神经网络的 Transformer：精确编译、移除激活值间乘积的代价，以及多智能体注意力聚类

    Sergey Salishev, Zeev Volkovich, Oleg Granichin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper gives an exact generic-network compilation of Transformer blocks and analyzes attention approximation and clustering to reduce computation. This is a substantial systems contribution; discussing internal attention computations is incidental to deployment and does not investigate learned representations or mechanisms.

    该论文给出了 Transformer 块到通用网络的精确编译方案，并分析注意力近似与聚类方法以减少计算量。这是重要的系统贡献；对注意力内部计算的讨论服务于部署，并未研究习得的表征或机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Transformers are deployed as a special model class. Neural processing units (NPU) add dedicated operators for attention and normalization, and quantization relies on Transformer-specific algorithms. We show the computation does not force this. Every Transformer block, with attention, LayerNorm and a GELU MLP, compiles exactly into a generic deep neural network built from fixed affine maps, routing and the square, sigmoid and inverse square root, plus GELU or its sigmoid approximation. Without activation-activation products, every transform-wise compilation adds at least $N^2$ scalar nonlinear evaluations per head for dense scores. Keeping that one operation type removes this cost; its elementwise form, present on every surveyed NPU, suffices with the sigmoid and inverse square root. For top-$k$ attention with exchangeable tail scores, we prove that exact or conditional-mean tail mass gives an unbiased, minimum-mean-square-error estimate of the attention distribution, while tail drop is conditionally biased. When queries or agents cluster, centroids choose the keys first, reducing the number of computed scores from $N^2$ to $Nk$ per head. On DeiT-Tiny, MambaIRv2-Light and Pythia-70M the compiled models match their references with all keys, standard post-training quantization applies, and the exact tail-mass estimate beats tail dropping with half as many keys on DeiT-Tiny and, for $k\le8$, on Pythia-70M.

    中文

    Transformer 被作为一种特殊模型类别来部署。神经处理单元（NPU）为注意力和归一化添加了专用算子，而量化也依赖 Transformer 专用算法。我们证明，计算本身并不要求如此。每个 Transformer 块，包括注意力、LayerNorm 和 GELU MLP，都可以精确编译为通用深度神经网络，该网络由固定仿射映射、路由、平方、sigmoid 和逆平方根运算，以及 GELU 或其 sigmoid 近似构成。若不使用激活值间乘积，每种逐变换编译在稠密分数计算中都会使每个注意力头至少额外执行 $N^2$ 次标量非线性计算。保留这一种运算即可消除这项开销；其逐元素形式已存在于所有接受调查的 NPU 上，与 sigmoid 和逆平方根运算结合即可满足需求。对于 top-$k$ 注意力，若尾部得分具有可交换性，我们证明，精确尾部质量或条件均值尾部质量能对注意力分布给出无偏、均方误差最小的估计，而丢弃尾部则会产生条件偏差。当查询或智能体形成聚类时，质心会先选出键，从而将每个注意力头计算的分数数量由 $N^2$ 减少到 $Nk$。在 DeiT-Tiny、MambaIRv2-Light 和 Pythia-70M 上，编译后的模型在使用全部键时与参考模型相匹配，且适用标准后训练量化；精确尾部质量估计仅使用一半数量的键，就在 DeiT-Tiny 上胜过丢弃尾部，并且对于 $k\le8$，在 Pythia-70M 上也胜过丢弃尾部。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ReMAS uses reinforcement learning to generate black-box attacks that extract prompts from multi-agent systems, with experiments showing improved attack success and transferability. This is a substantial contribution to multi-agent system behavior and security, while the RL objective is prompt attack generation rather than reasoning capability development.

    ReMAS 利用强化学习生成黑盒攻击，以提取多智能体系统中的提示；实验表明，该方法提高了攻击成功率和可迁移性。这项工作对多智能体系统行为与安全作出了重要贡献，而其强化学习目标是生成提示攻击，而非发展推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems (MAS) to accomplish complex tasks. Prior black-box red-teaming attacks mainly focus on single agents, but we find that these methods are far less effective in MAS, where multiple sub-agents may not directly interact with the user. Therefore, we introduce ReMAS, the first reinforcement learning-based red-teaming framework tailored to MASs, which fine-tunes attacker LLMs to generate effective adversarial prompts for system prompt extraction. The framework follows a two-step process: first, a rewrite stage refines base attack prompts to increase extraction success, and second, a template generation stage constructs attack templates that improve the likelihood of invoking specific sub-agents and thus revealing their system prompts. Extensive experiments show that our method substantially improves attack success rates compared to existing black-box attacks, with transferability across different backend LLMs and MAS structures. These results underscore the vulnerabilities of multi-agent systems and the importance of developing stronger defenses against adaptive black-box adversaries.

    Weiqin Chen, Xinlong Du, Gesualdo Scutari, Harsha Honnappa

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper tests whether trained in-context RL models behave as Bayesian posterior samplers, proposing statistical tests and finding that two necessary conditions are violated. This gives substantial empirical insight into a reasoning and learning mechanism; the incidental use of language models and bandit settings does not establish internal-representation analysis or a systems contribution.

    本文检验经过训练的情境内 RL 模型是否表现为贝叶斯后验采样器，提出统计检验并发现两个必要条件均遭到违反。这为一种推理与学习机制提供了重要的实证洞见；文中对语言模型和老虎机设置的附带使用，并未构成对内部表征分析或系统设计的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) exploits the impressive in-context learning ability of large language models to zero-shot generalize to new, unseen tasks at inference time without any parameter updates. Among many approaches, the Decision-Pretrained Transformer (DPT) is particularly appealing for its theoretical grounding: under idealized assumptions such as a sufficiently expressive model and infinite pretraining data, DPT can perform Bayesian posterior sampling. Whether this characterization survives in practice remains open. Therefore, we ask: \textit{is ICRL, specifically DPT and our proposed DPT variants, a Bayesian posterior sampler in practice?} To approach this question, we establish two necessary conditions that a Bayesian posterior sampler must satisfy: \textit{sufficient-statistic invariance} and the \textit{martingale property}. We then construct statistical hypothesis tests to statistically assess if practically-trained ICRL models satisfy these conditions. Applying these tests in Gaussian, Bernoulli, and linear bandit settings, we find that both conditions are consistently violated, suggesting that ICRL may not behave as Bayesian posterior samplers in practice. Beyond this negative result, our tests provide a principled toolkit for testing the Bayesian behavior of ICRL.

    中文

    情境内强化学习（ICRL）利用大型语言模型强大的情境学习能力，在推理时无需更新任何参数，即可零样本泛化到新的、未见过的任务。在众多方法中，决策预训练 Transformer（DPT）尤具吸引力，因为它具有理论基础：在模型表达能力足够强、预训练数据无限等理想化假设下，DPT 可以执行贝叶斯后验采样。这一刻画在实践中是否成立，仍是一个未解问题。因此，我们提出如下问题：\textit{ICRL，具体而言是 DPT 及我们提出的 DPT 变体，在实践中是否是贝叶斯后验采样器？}为探讨这一问题，我们确定了贝叶斯后验采样器必须满足的两个必要条件：\textit{充分统计量不变性}和\textit{鞅性质}。随后，我们构造统计假设检验，以统计评估实际训练的 ICRL 模型是否满足这些条件。在高斯、伯努利和线性老虎机设置中应用这些检验后，我们发现这两个条件都持续遭到违反，表明 ICRL 在实践中可能并不像贝叶斯后验采样器那样运行。除了这一否定性结果之外，我们的检验还提供了一套有原则的方法工具，用于测试 ICRL 的贝叶斯行为。

    Ekagra Gupta, Raj Saha, Aniekan-Abasi Inyang, Adam Al Gharib

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper benchmarks refusal transfer from text to tool use and probes a refusal-associated residual-stream direction with activation patching and steering, finding that it partly influences agent actions. This is a substantial mechanistic contribution to model behavior and tool-using agents, while the safety benchmark alone does not address composition or general reasoning.

    本文构建基准，评估拒绝行为从文本迁移到工具使用的情况，并通过激活修补和引导探查与拒绝相关的残差流方向，发现该方向会部分影响智能体行为。这项工作对模型行为和工具使用智能体的机制研究作出了重要贡献，而单是安全基准并未涉及组合能力或一般推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    While large language models are increasingly deployed as tool-calling agents, their safety evaluations still focus primarily on their ability to refuse harmful requests in text. We investigate whether the refusal behavior in text transfers to tool use. We construct a benchmark of 2,304 prompts across four domains, consisting of matched triplets that present the same harmful or benign request in text-only, standard tool-enabled, and adversarially framed tool-enabled settings. We then assess tool-call safety using 20 predefined forbidden actions. Testing five models of varying sizes and families, we find that requests refused in text frequently result in unsafe tool calls. Under standard tool-enabled prompting, this divergence occurs for 10-52 percent of harmful requests refused in chat. To mechanistically investigate this gap, we identify a refusal-associated direction in the residual stream of each of the five models. We find that in tool-enabled contexts, the activations along this direction decrease in four of five models. Furthermore, lower activation predicts unsafe tool calls across all five models (AUC 0.76-0.86). However, restoring the signal to the respective text-only value through activation patching only prevents a subset of unsafe calls, primarily by suppressing tool use rather than by producing safer calls. Steering along the refusal direction nearly eliminates unsafe calls only at strengths that also suppress benign tool use or degrade the output quality. Our findings indicate that the identified refusal direction contributes to whether a model acts, but only partially explains the refusal divergence. Therefore, evaluating the safety of tool-calling agents requires directly examining their actions along with their textual responses.

    中文

    尽管大型语言模型日益被部署为工具调用智能体，其安全评估仍主要关注它们在文本中拒绝有害请求的能力。我们研究文本中的拒绝行为能否迁移到工具使用中。我们构建了一个包含四个领域、共 2,304 条提示的基准，其中每组三条提示相互匹配，分别以纯文本、标准启用工具和对抗性框定的启用工具设置呈现相同的有害或无害请求。随后，我们使用 20 种预先定义的禁用操作评估工具调用安全性。我们测试了五种规模和系列各异的模型，发现文本中遭拒绝的请求常会导致不安全的工具调用。在标准启用工具提示下，聊天中遭拒绝的有害请求有 10-52 percent 出现这种偏离。为从机制层面研究这一差距，我们在五种模型各自的残差流中识别出一个与拒绝相关的方向。我们发现，在启用工具的上下文中，五种模型里有四种沿该方向的激活有所降低。此外，在所有五种模型中，较低的激活都能预测不安全的工具调用（AUC 0.76-0.86）。然而，通过激活修补将信号恢复到各自的纯文本取值，只能阻止一部分不安全调用，且主要是通过抑制工具使用，而非促成更安全的调用。只有当沿拒绝方向引导的强度也会抑制无害工具使用或降低输出质量时，不安全调用才会几乎完全消失。我们的发现表明，所识别的拒绝方向会影响模型是否采取行动，但只能部分解释拒绝行为的偏离。因此，评估工具调用智能体的安全性，需要直接检查其行为，并同时考察其文本回复。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A central obstacle to self-improving agents is the absence of a reliable fitness signal for realistic stateful tasks. We introduce \textsc{VeriEvolve}, an evaluator-first evolution framework that constructs this missing evaluation layer before optimizing the agent. From task instruction, VeriEvolve synthesizes instruction-grounded challenge states and an executable evaluator that checks them. During each round of workflow evolution, the evaluator is frozen and serves as the fitness signal. Between rounds, VeriEvolve revises the evaluator by converting the end states of strong and weak runs into a pair of counterfactual test cases. Across all 30 MCPMark Filesystem tasks, VeriEvolve constructs 30 evaluators with 141 challenge states, achieving 141/141 agreement on the generated suites and 113/122 agreement on held-out states produced by executor agents. Evaluator-guided evolution increases externally verified success from 6/30 to 18/30 for GLM-5.2 and from 27/30 to 30/30 for Claude; refinement removes all three false positives that the weak executor exposes. Cross-environment studies on PostgreSQL, Playwright, Notion, and GitHub further expose complementary limits from observability, state representation, and search/execution capacity. These results show that executable evaluators can be synthesized and used to guide search when task success is observable and an external verifier is available for calibration.

Fiber Acquisition Theory (FAT) describes the formation and renewal of trainable structure, distinguishing neutral installation, access to a learning signal, and additional functional directions. The two operations also constrain one another. A repair obligation can force a change in a learning channel, while acquired features can make new protected repairs feasible or reduce the minimum coefficient cost of existing ones. We characterize joint admissibility and response reachability, and give a finite supervised-learning construction in which the two operations together produce a favorable response absent from either operation alone. We implement protected head repair and fixed-capacity LoRA renewal in Qwen2.5-32B with AdamW, under replay and output distillation. Across two training trajectories differing in seed and within-task example order, the coordinated policy achieves higher teacher-forced Exact than either separate policy in all four comparisons. It also has the lowest macro NLL under both learning rules on the second trajectory. The implementations realize structure-conditioned self-regulation within specified information and action constraints: accessible state readouts and arrived evidence guide repairs and structural renewals, and ordinary learning continues from the modified state.

    ENGLISH

    This paper proposes Role-Enhanced Zero-Shot Chain-of-Thought (RE-ZS-CoT), a prompting framework that systematically integrates domain-specific expert roles to enhance reasoning in large language models (LLMs) without task-specific examples. We assess two versions of our approach. In the first version, static role selection, we evaluate eight predefined expert roles across arithmetic, commonsense, and reading comprehension benchmarks to determine their impact on reasoning performance. In the second version, dynamic role selection, each model autonomously selects the single most suitable role for each benchmark, enabling adaptive task-role alignment without manual specification. Across 20 LLMs and seven benchmarks, RE-ZS-CoT frequently surpasses zero-shot and zero-shot-CoT baselines, achieving performance improvements of up to 44 percentage points. The results reveal a strong correspondence between static and dynamic versions; the benchmarks where static roles yielded improvements were almost always those where dynamic roles also outperformed baselines, though static selection achieved peak performance. Ablation studies further show that unconventional roles degrade performance, underscoring the necessity of task-role alignment. The framework's scalability is validated across model sizes (2b-14b parameters), with smaller models like Granite3.3-8b achieving remarkable proficiency in arithmetic reasoning. RE-ZS-CoT advances zero-shot prompting by unifying role specialization with chain-of-thought reasoning, offering a practical, resource-efficient solution for improving LLM capabilities across diverse domains.

    Reward hacking is a major problem in current production machine learning systems, resulting in costly and dangerous failures. Here we study how to monitor for and mitigate reward hacking in realistic settings, including tool calls and long contexts. We apply a dynamic intervention to steering directions obtained by three different methods: difference-in-means vectors from labeled rollouts, gradient optimization-based vectors, and vectors extracted when models reference an anti-reward-hacking model spec. This dynamic intervention perturbs model representations less than uniform steering vector addition to the residual stream, allowing for more precise edits. We find that we are able to cheaply and significantly reduce reward hacking without correspondingly significant costs to model coherence or capability, and that steering vectors originally extracted from coding environments also generalize to reducing reward hacking in other domains. Our results pave the way towards latent space monitoring and control over realistic production systems.

Specifically, when trained on S1K-1.1, integrating NormTune into rank-8 LoRA, Bone, and MoRA yields substantial average accuracy improvements of 24.24\%, 11.33\%, and 16.21\% , respectively, across AIME 2024, MATH 500, GPQA, and AIME 2025.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Frontier black-box Large Language Model (LLM) agents are proficient at long-horizon reasoning and precise action generation. However, when it comes to a specific agentic task, they have no internalized knowledge of how that particular environment unfolds. A world model offers a natural remedy, providing the agent with environment specific knowledge by foreseeing how the environment will respond to the action it is about to take. Prior world models for LLM agents mainly predict next observations at each step, which is costly and often uninformative because individual observations provide limited task-relevant guidance and not every step requires call for foresight. This raises a key question: what a world model should predict and when should it be invoked for agentic tasks? Our pilot study suggests that world model guidance is most useful when it anticipates pitfalls within a bounded multi-step future. Motivated by this, we introduce Pitfall Anticipation World Model (PAWM), which selectively intervenes when a potential pitfall arises and predicts the impending failure to steer the agent away from it. PAWM is trained in two stages: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on synthetic data labeled with agent pitfalls, followed by GRPO co-training with a black-box LLM to further optimize it in the target environment. PAWM improves Claude Sonnet 4.5 performance by 24.3% on ScienceWorld and 7.7% on WebArena-Lite, outperforming a range of baselines. These results demonstrate that PAWM provides an effective form of world model guidance for black-box LLM agents.

To make training on NPUs more efficient, we propose TrainBridge, an agentic approach for transferring GPU optimization guidance to NPU training. TrainBridge uses the highly optimized execution produced by mature GPU compilation stacks as a task-specific reference for NPU tuning. It extracts optimization intents from the GPU training execution to guide NPU program rewrites and further refines the rewritten program through iterative profiling. Our GPU-to-NPU migration experiments show that TrainBridge achieves an average 1.7x speedup across four workloads covering LLM pretraining, image classification, and vision-language training, and an average speedup of nearly 2.0x across 27 Modded-NanoGPT speedrun records with highly optimized GPU implementations.

    Before an AI agent takes a consequential action, such as paying, messaging or changing code, several monitors check it. Their verdicts are combined by aggregating scores or by counting approvals, whatever inputs the monitors share. Monitors that share a base model or a poisoned input, however, may fail together. We borrow the fail-prone systems of distributed computing: lists of monitor sets that may fail together. A rule is safe if it executes no bad action and live if it blocks no good one. We measured twelve small open-weights monitors on payment approval under two pre-registered protocols. Without pre-registration, we also measured three closed frontier models (Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Astra, Gemini 4 Argon) and the open DeepSeek-V3.2. Every reliable fooling of a monitor into approving a fraud came through an evidence source and reached only that source's readers. Fooling it into blocking a correct payment depended on injection resistance, a monitor's refusal to follow instructions planted in its data. Small models and DeepSeek obeyed such notes. The three closed models ignored them in all but one case, and Opus also resisted persuasion tailored to it. On new data, a rule that counts sources instead of votes blocked 0.9% of correct payments, against 7.4% for the best counting rule, at equal safety. The pre-registered worst-case test failed. One attack left the approvers on a single source, so no rule over the twelve language-model monitors survives every measured attack. Adding a rule engine, which cannot be persuaded, restored the condition for a safe and live rule on the measured attacks. Diversify the inputs, harden the monitors, count sources, not votes.

    在 AI 智能体执行付款、发送消息或修改代码等重大操作之前，会有多个监控器对其进行检查。无论监控器共享哪些输入，它们的判定都会通过汇总评分或统计批准票数的方式合并。然而，共享基础模型或中毒输入的监控器可能会同时失效。我们借鉴了分布式计算中易失效系统的概念：列出可能同时失效的监控器集合。若规则不会执行任何不良操作，则该规则是安全的；若规则不会阻止任何良好操作，则该规则是活性的。我们按照两种预注册方案测量了十二个小型开放权重监控器在付款审批任务中的表现。我们还测量了三个封闭的前沿模型（Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra、Gemini 4 Argon）以及开放模型 DeepSeek-V3.2，但这些测量未预注册。所有能够可靠诱使监控器批准欺诈的攻击都经由某个证据源发起，且只影响读取该来源的监控器。诱使监控器阻止正确付款，则取决于其抵御注入的能力，也就是拒绝遵循植入数据中的指令。小型模型和 DeepSeek 会遵从此类指令。三个封闭模型除了一个案例外都忽略了这类指令，Opus 还抵御了针对它量身定制的劝说。在新数据上，在安全性相同的情况下，按来源计数的规则阻止了 0.9% 的正确付款，而表现最佳的计数规则阻止了 7.4%。预注册的最坏情况测试未通过。一次攻击使审批者都依赖同一个来源，因此，在所有测得的攻击下，基于这十二个语言模型监控器的规则无一能够幸存。加入一个无法被劝服的规则引擎后，在这些已测攻击下，恢复了安全且具活性的规则所需条件。应当使输入多样化、加固监控器，并按来源而非票数计数。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    OrbitWeaver contributes phase-aware checkpointing and dependency-aware recovery to preserve VLM inference across satellite interruptions, with hardware and deployment results. This is a substantial inference-systems contribution, while the vision-language setting alone does not provide evidence about model mechanisms, composition, or reasoning.

    OrbitWeaver 提出了阶段感知检查点和依赖感知恢复机制，以便在卫星中断期间保留 VLM 推理进度，并提供了硬件实验与部署结果。这是一项重要的推理系统贡献，而视觉语言应用场景本身并不能证明其对模型机制、组合或推理能力有新的发现。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Executing vision-language models (VLMs) aboard low-Earth orbit satellites enables flexible processing of observation data without first downlinking it to the ground. On commercial off-the-shelf payloads, however, a request may span multiple execution windows: power and thermal constraints, fault-triggered reboots, and competing payload demands can interrupt inference before it completes. Each shutdown discards volatile activations and KV caches, forcing an unprotected request to repeat work after restart. We present OrbitWeaver, a framework that preserves VLM inference progress across onboard interruptions through coordinated checkpointing and recovery. Its phase-aware checkpointing selects recovery boundaries according to the state lifetimes and computational characteristics of vision encoding, language-model prefill, and decoding, balancing storage traffic against recomputation. Its dependency-aware dynamic recovery schedules restoration from partially completed states across the layer and token-chunk dimensions. By overlapping checkpoint and weight reads with recomputation, it reduces restart latency; the recovery planner computes an optimal execution order under its scheduling model within 100 ms. Experiments on satellite payload hardware using on-orbit telemetry traces show up to a 4.07-fold end-to-end speedup and a 3.56-fold reduction in SSD write volume over the evaluated baselines. A 72-hour deployment on two low-Earth orbit satellites demonstrates that OrbitWeaver retains inference progress and resumes execution across repeated bus-enforced shutdowns.

    Biswas Poudel, Nilson Chapagain, Amit Kumar, and Xianshun Jiang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    This review organizes interactive search systems that couple planning, retrieval, verification, and stopping with reasoning, and synthesizes controlled evidence and design choices. Reasoning and agent-system design are substantial topics, but the paper reviews existing work rather than proposing a new mechanism, so neither is core.

    这篇综述梳理了将规划、检索、验证和停止与推理相结合的交互式搜索系统，并综合受控证据与设计选择。推理和智能体系统设计都是重要主题，但本文回顾的是已有工作，而非提出新机制，因此二者都不是核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate impressive emergent reasoning capabilities, yet they remain constrained by fixed model parameters and finite context windows. Even when augmented with static retrieval, they can produce statements that are unsupported by, or even contradictory to, retrieved evidence. This leads to hallucinations, difficulty incorporating up-to-date information, and failures to correctly interpret or reconcile sources. Recent work addresses these limitations by tightly coupling step-by-step reasoning with interactive search, treating retrieval as an action within an iterative agentic loop rather than a one-shot preprocessing step. This study reviews frameworks that implement such reasoning-search loops by interleaving planning, querying, retrieval, integration, verification, and stopping. We analyze these systems through four architectural axes: retrieval coupling, controller design, knowledge source, and grounding strictness. We separately treat the learning signal as a cross-cutting dimension because prompting, supervision, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning can instantiate the same architecture while producing materially different search, stopping, and grounding behavior. We further distinguish benchmark difficulty from RSA-loop demand and synthesize controlled within-study ablations and quality-cost deltas, avoiding invalid pooling across heterogeneous model backbones, retrievers, corpora, and evaluation protocols. Our goal is to clarify the landscape of reasoning-search-augmented LLMs and outline a unified perspective on the design choices shaping future research.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper characterizes when target probabilities can be reused in speculative decoding and evaluates tree-selection rules that improve acceptance and speed, a substantial algorithmic contribution to efficient model computation.     本文刻画了推测解码中目标概率可复用的条件，并评估了能够提高接受率和速度的树选择规则，是对高效模型计算的一项重要算法贡献。树结构组合和 token 选择与组合泛化和推理只有偶然关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Speculative decoding uses a target model to verify a tree of draft tokens in parallel. We study whether the resulting next-token distributions can help select the next tree. For unrestricted target models, we show that guaranteed exact reuse requires a distribution computed at the next round's complete context. We characterize when retaining this distribution requires sacrificing accepted tokens and establish conditions under which this loss persists across decoding rounds. Across six targets, we find that reranking first-token branches with a separately computed distribution at the current context improves expected acceptance over draft ranking, especially with small tree budgets. Drawing the first token from this distribution before allocating the tree further improves expected acceptance over pruning a preselected tree, even at equal mean tree size. In our experiments, both selection rules also decode faster than draft ranking when the separate target pass overlaps standalone drafting. Our findings show that making target probabilities available before tree allocation can improve the efficiency of speculative decoding. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/TargetRows.

    Streaming video understanding (SVU) requires video-LLMs to process incoming video continuously while answering user queries with low latency. Recent methods reduce query-time cost by prefilling frames into KV caches during idle time and reusing the cached KVs at query time. To bound per-frame computation over unbounded video streams, these methods restrict the context available during prefill. This creates a fundamental context mismatch: the restricted context may omit information needed to properly contextualize video tokens, yet, still contain information irrelevant to the eventual query, which is unknown during prefill. We propose FrameBlend, a simple yet effective plug-and-play method to address this mismatch through selective KV recomputation, without requiring any additional training. At query time, FrameBlend re-prefills selected video tokens using query-relevant context and replaces their cached KVs with recomputed ones. Crucially, this recomputation enables shorter attention windows during idle-time prefill, substantially reducing prefill cost while improving accuracy. Experiments across three SVU frameworks and five streaming and offline benchmarks demonstrate accuracy gains of up to 3.9 pp. On RVS-Ego, FrameBlend reduces per-frame prefill FLOPs by over 20% and total processing time by 14-59% for retrieval-based frameworks, including the cost of query-time recomputation. These results demonstrate that a simple change in how contextualization is distributed between idle time and query time can improve the accuracy-efficiency trade-off for SVU.

    流式视频理解（SVU）要求视频 LLM 持续处理传入视频，并以低延迟回答用户查询。近期方法通过在空闲时段将帧预填充到 KV 缓存中，并在查询时复用缓存的 KV，来降低查询时的开销。为限制无界视频流中每帧的计算量，这些方法会限制预填充时可用的上下文。这造成了根本性的上下文不匹配：受限上下文可能遗漏正确确定视频 token 上下文所需的信息，却仍包含与最终查询无关的信息，而预填充时该查询尚未知晓。我们提出 FrameBlend，这是一种简单而有效的即插即用方法，无需额外训练，通过选择性 KV 重计算来解决这一不匹配问题。在查询时，FrameBlend 使用与查询相关的上下文重新预填充选定的视频 token，并用重计算得到的 KV 替换缓存 KV。关键在于，这种重计算使空闲时段的预填充能够采用更短的注意力窗口，从而显著降低预填充成本并提高准确率。在三个 SVU 框架和五个流式及离线基准上的实验表明，准确率最高提升了 3.9 个百分点。在 RVS-Ego 上，对于基于检索的框架，FrameBlend 将每帧预填充 FLOPs 减少了 20% 以上，并将总处理时间缩短了 14–59%，其中包括查询时重计算的成本。这些结果表明，只需简单调整空闲时段和查询时段之间上下文构建工作的分配方式，就能改善 SVU 的准确率—效率权衡。

    Omni-modal assistants must remember not only what users say, but also what they show and convey. Existing long-term memory benchmarks are mostly text-and-image or report a single end-to-end score, so they cannot locate whether evidence is lost when it is represented, retrieved, delivered, or read. We introduce MOSAIC, a benchmark of 923 questions over persona-grounded histories of 11-24 sessions spanning text, image, video, and audio. MOSAIC constructs targeted spatial, temporal, and prosodic signals rather than decorative media, with the strongest causal validation for spatial information and selector-level validation for annotated prosody, and pairs them with a matched diagnostic protocol that freezes the question, reader, prompt, and budget while intervening on representation, retrieval, and delivery. Matched decomposition shows that representation loss is modality-dependent, residual reading dominates even under gold evidence, and abstention remains weak on these controls: strong answerable scores coexist with failures to refuse.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    HMDLM assigns hierarchy levels and separate noise schedules to token positions so higher-priority content can guide later generation, with a mathematical formulation and improvements on language and Sudoku tasks. This gives substantial insight into structured generation and multi-step problem solving; parallel decoding is relevant to model computation, but the abstract does not make systems design its central contribution.

    HMDLM 为 token 位置分配层级和独立的噪声日程，使高优先级内容能够引导后续生成；该方法具有数学公式化描述，并在语言和数独任务上取得改进。这为结构化生成和多步问题求解提供了重要认识；并行解码与模型计算相关，但摘要并未将系统设计作为核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Masked diffusion language models have emerged as an alternative to autoregressive models, enabling parallel token generation. However, standard masked diffusion language models use a shared noise schedule across positions without explicitly encoding which positions should be resolved first. Many tasks exhibit a natural priority among positions: document titles and section headings can guide the generation of body text, while Sudoku cells determined directly from the initial clues can help resolve more difficult cells. To incorporate this notion of priority (or hierarchy) among token positions, we introduce the Hierarchical Masked Diffusion Language Model (HMDLM), which augments each token position with a hierarchy level available as part of the training data, and requires zero or minimal additional annotations. It factors generation into two passes: the first predicts a hierarchy distribution over masked positions, the second predicts token distributions conditioned on it. Giving each hierarchy level its own noise schedule induces a soft, controllable preference for revealing higher-priority positions earlier while keeping decoding fully parallel. Our formulation is mathematically grounded, and we re-derive the forward and reverse processes and the NELBO for this factorization. Our evaluation shows that for the task of language generation on LM1B, HMDLM reduces perplexity by more than 1.5 points over Anchored Diffusion Language Model (ADLM), a recently proposed strong diffusion baseline; on WikiHow, we see a drop in perplexity of up to 4.4 pts on ADLM and up to 7 pts against MDLM. An LLM judge on WikiHow prefers HMDLM generations (the two variants combined) more than $2\times$ as often as the baseline. On the task of solving Sudoku puzzles requiring multi-step reasoning, it improves solution accuracy by up to $8.6\%$ absolute points over existing diffusion baselines.

    Evolutionary coding agents such as AlphaEvolve are one of the notable successes in using Large Language Models (LLMs) to build AI Scientists. These agents tackle open-ended scientific problems by iteratively improving and evolving programs, leveraging the prior knowledge and reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Despite their success, mutations over programs are mostly low-level upon surface heuristics, without a persistent unit of control. In contrast, science compounds through ideas. In this work, we propose ExpEvolve, which injects idea-level extraction and control into evolution: it discovers and leverages the high-level factors from programs that explain scoring differences among different programs. We characterize theoretical conditions on when discovery with idea factors improves sample efficiency. We also build a practical framework to show that the extracted high-level idea factors are helpful for guiding exploitation from experience and exploration when discovery comes to a plateau. Across 11 open-ended mathematical tasks, ExpEvolve significantly improves the final performance and sample efficiency up to 5.0x. The improvements also transfer to 4 other LLMs and to 6 machine learning tasks from MLS-Bench. Analysis shows that ExpEvolve can discover idea-level factors to provide better exploration and exploitation for evolutionary discovery.

    Dynamic scheduling requires dispatching online arrivals while anticipating future jobs, as poor decisions can compound downstream costs under nonlinear tardiness objectives. We show that a pretrained large language model (LLM) can serve as the exogenous component of a structured world model, forecasting uncertain future job arrivals. Specifically, we exploit an afterstate decomposition, which separates known deterministic shop transitions from uncertain exogenous job arrivals, enabling the LLM to forecast only the latter through a compact belief representation. Building on this, we develop Afterstate World-Model Planning (AWMP), which combines an evolved, belief-conditioned dispatching strategy with short scenario-based rollouts. A surprise-triggered refresh mechanism queries the LLM only when newly observed arrivals deviate sufficiently from previous forecast, and online residual self-calibration further conditions the LLM on its recent forecast errors to handle nonstationary arrivals. Across diverse arrival distributions, AWMP reduces weighted tardiness by 6-21% on dynamic job-shop and 22-46% on flexible job-shop benchmarks, relative to the best of eight classical priority-dispatching rules.

    Spatial reasoning requires more than access to geometric tools: a reasoner must decide when direct observation is sufficient and when to reconstruct, measure, or change reference frames. We present SpatialBrain, a framework that retains experience about these decisions while keeping its vision-language backbone fixed. The key distinction is between evidence about a scene and experience about how to reason with that evidence. 3DFusionMemory fuses current-scene observations into queryable spatial relations. A Spatial Skill Library provides reusable tool procedures, and Spatial Cognition associates task conditions with experience about when and how to use memory and skills. Completed trajectories are abstracted into process records and consolidated between task blocks, allowing later decisions to draw on earlier execution without transferring scene coordinates or reference answers.     本文探测了内部共识表征及其与外部立场变化之间的关系，并发现当这些表征跨对话聚合时，其动态会呈现结构化规律。这是一项重要的可解释性贡献；但共识任务本身并未证明其揭示了组合性或通用推理机制。

    As LLM agents interact in the wild and shape each other's decisions, understanding how they converge toward agreement becomes important. We study this in multi-turn conversations where two LLMs discuss subjective matters, can agree or disagree, and may change their stances. Using a linear classifier on individual conversation activations, we identify an internal representation of agreement. We find that it varies substantially across turns and conversations and does not reliably track external agreement at the individual conversation level. We therefore move beyond the representation of agreement in individual conversations, by aggregating the agreement representation across conversations. Externally, this aggregate view reveals a simple structure: when pooled across conversations, agreement can be predicted well with a Markov process, with agreement at each turn being a direct function of agreement at the previous turn. Similarly, when internal agreement is aggregated, it couples with the external Markov agreement through a power-law mapping, exposing Markovian dynamics in internal representations. Additionally, we find that after a change of stance, models express agreement externally before their internal representations reflect the same shift. These results reveal a joint structure between internal and external agreement that emerges only when internal features are aggregated across conversations. Code available at https://github.com/technion-cs-nlp/SeeingTheForestForTheTrees.

    随着 LLM 智能体在真实环境中互动并影响彼此的决策，理解它们如何逐渐达成共识变得十分重要。我们研究了两种 LLM 就主观议题进行多轮对话的情形：它们可以达成一致或意见不合，也可能改变立场。通过在单段对话的激活值上训练线性分类器，我们识别出一种内部共识表征。我们发现，这种表征在不同轮次和对话之间变化很大，在单段对话层面无法可靠地反映外部共识。因此，我们不再局限于单段对话中的共识表征，而是对多个对话中的共识表征进行聚合。在外部层面，这种聚合视角揭示出一种简单结构：将多个对话合并后，可以用马尔可夫过程很好地预测共识，即每一轮的共识直接取决于上一轮的共识。同样，在聚合内部共识后，它会通过幂律映射与外部马尔可夫共识相耦合，从而揭示内部表征中的马尔可夫动态。此外，我们发现，模型改变立场后，会先在外部表达共识，内部表征随后才反映出相同的变化。这些结果揭示了内部与外部共识之间的联合结构，而该结构只有在跨对话聚合内部特征后才会显现。代码见 https://github.com/technion-cs-nlp/SeeingTheForestForTheTrees。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Knowledge graph question generation (KGQG) generates natural-language questions from structured graph evidence and a target answer. When the input graph is temporal, a valid question must also preserve the answer field, time condition, reference event, and temporal order that determine the answer set. Existing KGQG methods and prompting baselines can produce fluent questions that alter these conditions, causing temporal semantic drift. This paper studies temporal KGQG as a constraint-preserving graph-to-question problem and proposes ChronoSynth, a memory-augmented and constraint-aware generation framework. ChronoSynth first constructs a Temporal Intent State to make the intended question semantics explicit. It then retrieves compatible typed question patterns from an indexed pattern memory, adapts them to the input graph, and validates the generated question. Validation feedback guides revisions when a supported inconsistency is detected. Experiments on CRONQUESTIONS and MultiTQ demonstrate state-of-the-art generation performance, with ablations supporting the contributions of its components.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous Deep Search and Deep Research Agents capable of executing long-horizon, multi-step tasks, evaluating their reliability becomes increasingly critical. However, existing evaluation paradigms predominantly focus on final task outcomes, leaving a significant gap in understanding the intermediate execution traces, where agents are highly susceptible to various errors. To address this critical gap, we introduce a comprehensive methodology and analytical framework designed specifically to diagnose errors in intermediate workflows. Building upon this framework, we establish a structured taxonomy that categorizes these vulnerabilities into two primary dimensions: System-Level Errors and Task-Level Errors. Through a systematic examination of step-by-step execution traces and agent-environment interactions, we reveal how these underlying errors affect overall performance. Finally, through empirical experiments and systematic analysis of the identified error types, we provide actionable design guidelines, aiming to enhance the robustness, reasoning capabilities, and reliability of Deep Search and Deep Research agents.

    GaP-MoE：通过正交梯度累积与投影实现混合专家模型中的显式专家专门化

    Donghyun Jeong and Yoon-Yeong Kim

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    GaP-MoE projects expert gradients to reduce overlap and promote specialization, a substantial algorithmic contribution to sparse conditional computation. The gradient intervention has a limited connection to representation diversity, but the abstract does not analyze learned representations or compositional behavior.

    GaP-MoE 对专家梯度进行投影以减少重叠并促进专门化，这是对稀疏条件计算的一项重要算法贡献。梯度干预与表示多样性有一定关联，但摘要并未分析学得的表示或组合行为。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) models improve scalability by routing input tokens to only a subset of expert networks, but they often suffer from representation collapse, in which multiple experts converge toward similar functions and lose their intended diversity. Prior work has addressed this limitation either by improving router architectures or by introducing auxiliary loss terms that implicitly penalize similarity among experts. However, router-based approaches remain vulnerable to routing collapses, and loss-based approaches can conflict with the task's original objective during optimization. In this work, we propose GaP-MoE (Gradient Accumulation and Projection in MoE), which induces expert specialization by directly manipulating expert output gradients rather than modifying the loss function. At each training step, GaP-MoE stochastically selects one of the $TopK$ routed experts as a leader based on normalized routing scores, and projects the gradients of the remaining follower experts onto the orthogonal complement of the subspace spanned by the leader's recent gradients. This removes directional overlap between expert gradients without altering the task loss, allowing specialization to emerge as a direct consequence of the optimization dynamics rather than an externally imposed constraint. We evaluate GaP-MoE in both fine-tuning settings (BERT-based, on GLUE) and from-scratch pretraining settings (GPT-2-based, on WikiText-103, enwik8, and text8), and further confirm its compatibility as a drop-in module for existing SMoE architectures. Experimental results show that GaP-MoE achieves performance comparable to or better than standard SMoE.

    中文

    稀疏混合专家（SMoE）模型通过将输入 token 路由到仅一部分专家网络来提升可扩展性，但它们常常会遭遇表示坍塌，即多个专家趋于收敛到相似的函数，从而失去预期的多样性。以往工作通过改进路由器架构或引入辅助损失项来隐式惩罚专家之间的相似性，从而应对这一局限。然而，基于路由器的方法仍容易受到路由坍塌的影响，而基于损失的方法在优化过程中可能与任务原本的目标相冲突。在这项工作中，我们提出 GaP-MoE（MoE 中的梯度累积与投影），通过直接操控专家输出梯度而非修改损失函数来促使专家专门化。在每个训练步骤中，GaP-MoE 根据归一化后的路由分数，随机选择一个$TopK$被路由的专家作为领导者，并将其余跟随者专家的梯度投影到由领导者近期梯度张成子空间的正交补空间中。这消除了专家梯度之间的方向重叠，同时不改变任务损失，使专门化成为优化动态的直接结果，而非外部强加的约束。我们在微调设置（基于 BERT，在 GLUE 上）和从零开始的预训练设置（基于 GPT-2，在 WikiText-103、enwik8 和 text8 上）中评估 GaP-MoE，并进一步确认它可作为即插即用模块兼容现有 SMoE 架构。实验结果表明，GaP-MoE 达到了与标准 SMoE 相当或更好的性能。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    OnQ improves low-bit models’ long-horizon reasoning through student-generated trajectories and candidate-wise distillation, a substantial training contribution to reasoning capability. Quantization is a model-computation concern, but the abstract offers no substantive insight into internal mechanisms or system architecture, so those links remain limited.

    OnQ 通过学生模型生成的轨迹和逐候选蒸馏来提升低比特模型的长时程推理能力，是对推理能力训练的一项重要贡献。量化涉及模型计算，但摘要并未对内部机制或系统架构提供实质见解，因此与这些方面的关联有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Quantization-aware training (QAT) aims to recover reasoning capabilities in low-bit large language models (LLMs). Existing recipes typically supervise the quantized student with the original full-precision model on fixed response sequences. However, the resulting low-bit quantized models still struggle on long-horizon reasoning tasks and often fail to terminate within a token budget that suffices for the full-precision model. We identify two challenges in closing this gap. First, fixed-response supervision leaves a mismatch between training prefixes and those encountered during student generation, and this trajectory divergence grows as responses lengthen. Second, on its own prefixes, the student underpredicts some next-token candidates and overpredicts others, and this distributional misalignment becomes more frequent at high-entropy prefixes. We present OnQ, a low-bit recovery pipeline that combines on-policy distillation and candidate-wise Dynamic KL. Starting from block-wise calibration, the quantized student generates responses and receives full-precision teacher supervision on its own prefixes. Dynamic KL weights forward and reverse KL by each candidate's teacher-student probability ratio to balance correction of under- and overprediction. Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B at 2- and 3-bit precision, OnQ achieves the highest nine-benchmark average, with the largest gains on long-horizon reasoning benchmarks. At 2 bits, it outperforms every baseline on every benchmark at every model size, improving the Qwen3-8B average by 10.26 points over the strongest baseline. It also produces shorter responses with fewer truncations and repetitive errors.

    中文

    量化感知训练（QAT）旨在恢复低比特大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。现有方案通常使用原始全精度模型，在固定响应序列上监督量化学生模型。然而，所得低比特量化模型在长时程推理任务上仍表现吃力，而且经常无法在足以让全精度模型完成任务的 token 预算内结束生成。我们指出了弥合这一差距面临的两个挑战。第一，固定响应监督会造成训练前缀与学生模型生成时遇到的前缀不匹配，而且这种轨迹偏离会随着响应变长而加剧。第二，在学生模型自身生成的前缀上，它会低估某些下一 token 候选项的概率，同时高估另一些候选项；这种分布失配在高熵前缀处更为常见。我们提出 OnQ，这是一种结合了在策略蒸馏和逐候选动态 KL 的低比特恢复流程。从分块校准开始，量化学生模型生成响应，并在其自身前缀上接受全精度教师模型的监督。动态 KL 根据每个候选项的教师与学生概率比对前向 KL 和反向 KL 加权，以平衡对低估和高估的纠正。在 Qwen3-1.7B、4B 和 8B 模型以及 2 比特和 3 比特精度设置上，OnQ 的九项基准平均分最高，在长时程推理基准上的提升最大。在 2 比特设置下，它在所有模型规模的每项基准上都优于所有基线，使 Qwen3-8B 的平均分比最强基线提高 10.26 分。它还能生成更短的响应，并减少截断和重复错误。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CCG Diffusion uses syntactic composition to control attribute binding, spatial relations, counts, and ambiguity in image generation, with improvements across two model backbones.     CCG Diffusion 运用句法组合来控制图像生成中的属性绑定、空间关系、数量和歧义，并在两种主干模型上取得改进。这是对组合式生成的一项重要贡献；但仅凭注意力引导和生成性能，尚不足以证明其对模型内部机制、推理或系统方面有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Text-to-image generation models do not explicitly receive the syntactic structure of the prompt, i.e., which word modifies which and where each phrase attaches. Consequently, they often struggle to bind attributes to the correct objects, to depict spatial relations and counts correctly, and to render syntactically ambiguous prompts in the intended interpretation. Existing syntax-based control methods mainly address attribute binding and have limited ability to control spatial relations and counts or to specify the interpretation of syntactically ambiguous prompts. They rely on phrase-structure or dependency grammars and require additional rules or constraints on the tree structure to extract modification relations between words or to specify a syntactic interpretation. We propose CCG Diffusion, a training-free method that controls image generation using Combinatory Categorial Grammar (CCG). In CCG, the category of each word carries rich syntactic information: it specifies what the word combines with and what phrase it forms. Modification relations between words can therefore be read directly from a CCG parse. Moreover, prepositional phrase (PP) attachment ambiguity, a representative syntactic ambiguity, can be resolved simply by fixing the preposition's category. CCG Diffusion applies the same two CCG-based mechanisms, prompt rewriting and attention guidance, both to controlling attribute binding, spatial relations, and counts and to resolving PP ambiguity. On two architecturally different backbones, Stable Diffusion and Sana, CCG Diffusion achieves the highest scores among the compared methods in attribute binding and 2D spatial relations and significantly outperforms all of them in PP ambiguity resolution.

    中文

    文本到图像生成模型不会显式接收提示的句法结构，即哪个词修饰哪个词，以及每个短语附着在何处。因此，它们常常难以将属性绑定到正确对象、正确描绘空间关系和数量，也难以按照预期解释生成句法有歧义的提示。现有基于句法的控制方法主要处理属性绑定，在控制空间关系和数量，或指定句法歧义提示的解释方面能力有限。这些方法依赖短语结构语法或依存语法，并且需要在树结构上添加额外规则或约束，以提取词语间的修饰关系或指定句法解释。我们提出 CCG Diffusion，一种无需训练、使用组合范畴语法（CCG）控制图像生成的方法。在 CCG 中，每个词的范畴都携带丰富的句法信息：它指明该词与什么组合以及会形成什么短语。因此，可以直接从 CCG 解析结果中读出词语间的修饰关系。此外，介词短语（PP）附着歧义是一种典型的句法歧义，只需固定介词的范畴即可消解。CCG Diffusion 将同一套基于 CCG 的机制——提示重写和注意力引导——同时用于控制属性绑定、空间关系和数量，以及消解 PP 歧义。在架构各异的两种主干模型 Stable Diffusion 和 Sana 上，CCG Diffusion 在属性绑定和二维空间关系方面取得了对比方法中的最高分，并在 PP 歧义消解方面显著优于所有对比方法。

    ENGLISH

    While agentic reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for training small language models (SLMs), existing frameworks are predominantly tool-centric and struggle with data-centric environments. Specifically, applying tool-centric frameworks to stateful tasks like SQL debugging introduces severe spatial inefficiencies since proper environment isolation typically requires a separate database container per rollout. Naively reusing databases without tracking evolving states across multi-turn interactions causes trajectory contamination and cross-trajectory interference, which severely destabilizes policy updates. To overcome these bottlenecks, we introduce BIRD-RL, a novel four-stage agentic RL curriculum that alternately enhances foundational agent reasoning and trajectory-adaptive on-policy exploration to circumvent the instability inherently associated with direct end-to-end learning. Crucially, to support this curriculum, BIRD-RL is driven by a Trajectory-scoped Persistent Execution Infrastructure, which enables safe database replica reuse while preserving trajectory isolation. This design improves spatial RL efficiency by 12.8x, successfully enabling scalable agentic RL for complex data-centric tasks without needs of Kubernettes. Empirical evaluations on the BIRD-CRITIC-SQLite benchmark demonstrate that our 7B and 14B models achieve Success Rates of 44.40% and 48.00%, respectively, showing competitive performance against strong proprietary model-based agents such as Claude-Opus-4.6 Agent (48.20%). Furthermore, BIRD-RL successfully trains unified SLMs capable of both advanced SQL debugging and generation, highlighting its broader potential for multi-objective optimization across heterogeneous, real-world data-centric tasks.

    尽管智能体强化学习（RL）已成为训练小型语言模型（SLM）的一种有前景范式，但现有框架主要以工具为中心，在以数据为中心的环境中表现不佳。具体而言，将以工具为中心的框架应用于 SQL 调试等有状态任务会造成严重的空间效率低下，因为适当的环境隔离通常要求每次 rollout 使用一个独立的数据库容器。在多轮交互中，若不跟踪不断演变的状态而直接重复使用数据库，就会导致轨迹污染和跨轨迹干扰，严重破坏策略更新的稳定性。为克服这些瓶颈，我们提出 BIRD-RL，这是一种新颖的四阶段智能体 RL 课程，通过交替增强智能体的基础推理能力和适应轨迹的 on-policy 探索，规避直接端到端学习固有的不稳定性。关键的是，为支持这一课程，BIRD-RL 由轨迹作用域持久执行基础设施驱动，可在保持轨迹隔离的同时安全地复用数据库副本。这一设计将 RL 的空间效率提高了 12.8 倍，使复杂的以数据为中心任务能够实现可扩展的智能体 RL，而无需 Kubernettes。在 BIRD-CRITIC-SQLite 基准上的实证评估表明，我们的 7B 和 14B 模型分别达到 44.40% 和 48.00% 的成功率，与 Claude-Opus-4.6 Agent（48.20%）等强大的专有模型智能体相比表现具有竞争力。此外，BIRD-RL 成功训练出能够同时进行高级 SQL 调试和生成的统一 SLM，凸显了其在异构、真实世界的以数据为中心任务上进行多目标优化的更广泛潜力。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    EMPO aligns policy updates across text responses with equivalent executable effects, improving credit assignment and learning efficiency on long-horizon agent tasks.
