    EMPO 对具有等价可执行效果的不同文本响应对齐策略更新，从而改善长时程智能体任务中的信用分配和学习效率。这是对 RL 优化的重大贡献，有助于智能体推理；而执行等价性与组合性的联系有限，对智能体系统的相关性则居次要地位。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent advances in multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) have substantially improved the performance of LLM agents on complex, long-horizon interactive tasks. However, despite progress in fine-grained credit assignment, policy optimization still applies these learning signals through response-specific probability ratios. Different textual responses can induce the same executable effect, yet credit differences arising from subsequent outcomes remain tied to their individual textual realizations. We identify this mismatch as credit-update misalignment. Our analysis reveals that credit-text pairing directly shapes policy-update directions, even when the policy context and executable effect are held fixed. Motivated by this finding, we propose Effect-Marginal Policy Optimization (EMPO), which aligns policy optimization with execution-level equivalence through an effect-level surrogate that couples updates across alternative textual realizations. EMPO preserves the original credit signals, integrates with both trajectory-level and step-level credit estimators, and requires no additional critics or rollouts. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Sokoban show that EMPO outperforms strong baselines in both task performance and learning efficiency.

    多轮强化学习（RL）的最新进展显著提升了 LLM 智能体在复杂长时程交互任务中的表现。然而，尽管细粒度信用分配已有进展，策略优化仍通过针对特定响应的概率比来应用这些学习信号。不同的文本响应可能产生相同的可执行效果，但由后续结果带来的信用差异仍与各自的文本表述绑定。我们将这种不匹配称为信用更新错位。我们的分析揭示，即使策略上下文和可执行效果保持不变，信用与文本的配对也会直接塑造策略更新方向。受这一发现启发，我们提出效果边际策略优化（EMPO），通过一种效果层面的替代目标，将不同文本表述之间的更新耦合起来，使策略优化与执行层面的等价性相一致。EMPO 保留原有信用信号，可结合轨迹级和步骤级信用估计器使用，并且不需要额外的评论器或 rollout。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 Sokoban 上的实验表明，EMPO 在任务表现和学习效率方面均优于强基线。

    Events, Not Pixels: Where World Models Get the Return Wrong

    事件，而非像素：世界模型在哪里误判回报

    Haoyue Liu, Xiaoying Tang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a transition-level diagnostic showing that rare reward and termination events account for much of world models’ return error, and uses this insight to guide repair and improve plan ranking. This strongly advances model-based planning evaluation, while its focus on event transitions does not establish compositional generalization or internal representation mechanisms.

    本文提出一种转移级诊断方法，表明稀有奖励和终止事件造成了世界模型的大部分回报误差，并利用这一发现指导修复、改善规划排序。这显著推进了基于模型的规划评估；但其对事件转移的关注并未确立组合泛化或内部表征机制方面的结论。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    World models are increasingly used for planning, where a planner ranks candidate actions by returns imagined by the model. However, these models are judged mainly by how well they render frames, even though a visually faithful rollout can still assign the wrong return. To identify where this mismatch arises, we introduce a transition-level diagnostic that replaces imagined transitions with real ones and measures the reduction in return error against a budget-matched random control. Our analysis yields two findings. (1) Event transitions, the few steps where a reward is earned or an episode ends, are rendered as well as other steps (median pixel-error ratio 0.85), yet restoring them removes a median of 70% of the return error. In contrast, restoring transitions with the largest MSE, SSIM or LPIPS error removes less than a random choice. Across the 44 Atari-100k model--collection pairs that pass our reliability checks, including three released families, event patches outperform random patches in 39 (sign test p=1.4 x 10^{-7}), with a median gain of +44 percentage points. (2) The remaining error is structured: a complementary patch separates errors at true events from those elsewhere, while an eight-step timing tolerance recovers few events missed by our deterministic models. This structure also guides repair: a rule recorded before four repair outcomes were known predicts when a diffusion model repairs these failures. Event patches improve plan ranking, and the same concentration appears on control tasks with rare reward events.

    中文

    世界模型越来越多地用于规划，规划器会根据模型想象出的回报对候选动作排序。然而，对这些模型的评判主要看它们渲染帧的效果，尽管视觉上忠实的 rollout 仍可能给出错误的回报。为找出这种不匹配出现的原因，我们提出一种转移级诊断方法：用真实转移替换想象转移，并相对于预算匹配的随机对照测量回报误差的减少。我们的分析得出两项发现。（1）事件转移，即获得奖励或回合结束时发生的少数步骤，其渲染效果与其他步骤一样好（像素误差比中位数为 0.85），但恢复这些转移可消除中位数为 70% 的回报误差。相比之下，恢复 MSE、SSIM 或 LPIPS 误差最大的转移，消除的误差还不如随机选择。通过可靠性检查的 44 个 Atari-100k 模型—数据集组合（包括三个已发布系列）中，事件修补在 39 个组合上优于随机修补（符号检验 p=1.4 x 10^{-7}），中位增益为 +44 个百分点。（2）剩余误差具有结构性：一种互补修补方法将真实事件处的误差与其他位置的误差区分开来，而八步时间容差只能找回确定性模型漏掉的少数事件。这种结构也有助于修复：在获知四种修复结果之前记录的一条规则，可以预测扩散模型何时能修复这些失败。事件修补改善了规划排序，在具有稀有奖励事件的控制任务中也出现了同样的集中现象。

    DynaWeave synthesizes dynamic, dependency-structured scenarios for tool-using agents and uses the resulting trajectories to improve adaptation when external events disrupt plans.     DynaWeave 为使用工具的智能体合成具有依赖结构的动态场景，并利用生成的轨迹提升智能体在外部事件打乱计划时的适应能力。DAG 任务结构与组合性存在部分联系，而其主要贡献是一个实用的智能体训练框架，显著提升了智能体在变化环境中的适应能力和任务执行表现。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use tools to complete tasks in stateful environments. However, many training environments remain largely static apart from changes caused by the agent's own actions, whereas external events introduced by other users, services, or sudden contingencies in real environments can invalidate ongoing plans. To address this gap, we introduce DynaWeave, an automated synthesis framework that transforms existing static tasks into verifiable dynamic scenarios. The framework generates exogenous events relevant to each task, covering changes in task requirements, environment state, and external information. It uses directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) to represent dependencies between events and an execution engine to activate them during agent interaction. A dynamic verifier revises only the evaluation checks affected by events that actually occur and retains all other checks. Using DynaWeave, we collect 2,095 verified interaction trajectories across 36 environments and use them for supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.5 models. Experiments on Gaia2, CostBench, and ToolMaze show that DynaWeave achieves consistent improvements in overall performance across all three evaluated model sizes, increasing the task completion rate on CostBench by 67.34 percentage points and even exceeding the performance of Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview on ToolMaze. These results support dynamic scenario synthesis as a practical approach to training agents to adapt to changing environments. Our code is available at https://github.com/Miaow-Lab/DynaWeave.

    大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地使用工具，在有状态环境中完成任务。然而，许多训练环境基本保持静态，只有智能体自身行动会引起变化；而真实环境中由其他用户、服务或突发情况引入的外部事件，则可能使正在执行的计划失效。为弥补这一差距，我们提出 DynaWeave，这是一种自动合成框架，可将现有静态任务转化为可验证的动态场景。该框架会生成与各任务相关的外生事件，涵盖任务要求、环境状态和外部信息的变化。它使用有向无环图（DAG）表示事件之间的依赖关系，并通过执行引擎在智能体交互过程中激活事件。动态验证器只会修订受实际发生事件影响的评估检查，并保留其他所有检查。借助 DynaWeave，我们在 36 个环境中收集了 2,095 条经过验证的交互轨迹，并将其用于 Qwen3.5 模型的监督微调。在 Gaia2、CostBench 和 ToolMaze 上的实验表明，DynaWeave 在所有三个受测模型规模上都持续提升整体表现，使 CostBench 上的任务完成率提高 67.34 个百分点，甚至在 ToolMaze 上超过 Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview。这些结果支持将动态场景合成作为一种实用方法，用于训练智能体适应不断变化的环境。我们的代码见 https://github.com/Miaow-Lab/DynaWeave。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper trains agents across structured harness variations and shows improved transfer to unseen configurations, making organized variation a substantial contribution to compositional generalization and agentic RL. Harness configuration and tool interaction also advance agent systems, while the abstract does not describe internal model mechanisms.

    本文通过结构化的 harness 变化训练智能体，并表明这能提升向未见配置的迁移能力，因此有组织的变化是对组合泛化和智能体 RL 的重大贡献。Harness 配置和工具交互也推进了智能体系统，但摘要没有描述模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agent harnesses have become a central component of modern agentic systems, shaping how models use tools, manage context, and coordinate long-horizon interaction. Realizing the benefits of these harnesses depends on how effectively the underlying model can make use of them, motivating reinforcement learning directly through the harness. However, existing approaches typically train through a single fixed harness, which can lead to specialization and limited transfer across harness configurations. To address this, we introduce \textbf{Harness Scaling}, a new scaling dimension for agentic RL that extends training from a single harness to diverse execution configurations. Concretely, we construct a factorized harness space, select a compact training subset with balanced factorial coverage, and organize cross-harness training to combine global coverage with controlled variation for the same task. Across multiple benchmarks, model scales, and RL algorithms, Harness Scaling consistently improves generalization to unseen white-box configurations. Moreover, models trained through structured white-box variation transfer effectively to unseen external black-box harnesses, outperforming models trained through a single complex black-box harness. These results establish harness diversity as a meaningful scaling dimension for agentic RL and highlight the importance of how this diversity is organized for cross-harness generalization.

    PreCoMem: Predictive Cognitive Memory for Self-Evolving Long-Term Dialogue Agents

    PreCoMem：面向自我演进长期对话智能体的预测性认知记忆

    Jian Zhong, Zeyu Liu, Pingchuan Cao, Rongduo Han, Shunye Tang, Guohuan Xie, Mingyuan Qin, Ran Ji, Xiao Liang, Wei Wang, Haining Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PreCoMem proposes confidence-weighted belief updates and a gating mechanism for long-term dialogue memory, with evaluations of adaptation to belief drift. This is a substantial memory-system contribution; its predictive-coding inspiration alone does not establish insight into internal model mechanisms or reasoning.

    PreCoMem 为长期对话记忆提出置信度加权的信念更新和门控机制，并评估其对信念漂移的适应能力。这是对记忆系统的重大贡献；仅凭预测编码这一灵感，并不能证明其对模型内部机制或推理提供了洞见。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-horizon dialogue agents need to keep user memories stable enough for personalization while adapting when the user genuinely changes. Existing memory systems often append every observation or overwrite old entries by heuristic rules, which makes transient noise hard to distinguish from real belief drift. We introduce PreCoMem, a memory consolidation framework inspired by predictive coding that represents memory as confidence-weighted beliefs about the user's state. Its core signal, Effective Surprisal, combines semantic deviation and contradiction evidence, then downweights this signal when retrieval is diffuse and unreliable. According to effective surprisal, a two-threshold gate maps each turn to one of three deterministic updates: MAINTAIN reinforces supported beliefs, PROFILE stores ambiguous cues as low-confidence hypotheses, and CORRECT softly decays reliably contradicted facts. The PROFILE stage acts as an explicit waiting room, preventing premature commitment to noisy evidence. Experiments on LoCoMo, LongMemEval-S, and PersonaMem-v2 show consistent state-of-the-art accuracy; our new DiMoBench confirms that PreCoMem adapts to non-stationary belief drift without over-reacting to noise. The code is available at https://github.com/ZhongWishing/PreCoMem.

    中文

    长时程对话智能体需要让用户记忆保持足够稳定，以便实现个性化，同时在用户确实发生变化时进行调整。现有记忆系统通常会追加每条观察，或按启发式规则覆盖旧条目，因此难以区分短暂噪声与真实的信念漂移。我们提出 PreCoMem，这是一种受预测编码启发的记忆整合框架，它将记忆表示为关于用户状态的置信度加权信念。其核心信号“有效惊异度”结合语义偏差和矛盾证据，并在检索结果分散且不可靠时降低这一信号的权重。依据有效惊异度，一个双阈值门控机制会将每轮交互映射为三种确定性更新之一：MAINTAIN 强化有支持的信念，PROFILE 将模糊线索存为低置信度假设，而 CORRECT 则缓慢衰减与可靠证据相矛盾的事实。PROFILE 阶段充当明确的等待区，防止过早采信噪声证据。在 LoCoMo、LongMemEval-S 和 PersonaMem-v2 上的实验显示，其准确率持续达到最先进水平；我们新建的 DiMoBench 证实，PreCoMem 能适应非平稳的信念漂移，而不会对噪声反应过度。代码见 https://github.com/ZhongWishing/PreCoMem。

    Large language models (LLMs) have shown great potential as general-purpose user simulators for interactive systems. Prior studies have demonstrated that training on high-quality data can substantially improve model reasoning and downstream task performance. However, the upper bound of user simulation is still constrained by the model's reasoning paradigm: native chain-of-thought often degenerates into shallow pattern matching and fails to adequately model the behavioral factors underlying real user decisions. In this paper, we propose OmniSimulator, a novel training framework designed to improve the predictive ability of small LLMs for realistic user simulation on short-video platform environments. Specifically, OmniSimulator organizes behavior-oriented reasoning through a structured schema with five dimensions, carefully selects data from real user-behavior scenarios, and introduces a teacher model to generate high-quality reasoning traces under the proposed schema, helping small models learn behavior-relevant reasoning patterns rather than relying on superficial behavioral correlations. Based on this process, we construct 9,881 high-quality training instances from three months of historical interaction trajectories of 200 real users, averaging about 50 distilled examples per user. Experimental results show that OmniSimulator improves the average score of Qwen3-8B by 34.33%, achieves performance competitive with Claude-Sonnet-4.5, and supports smaller-scale, self-hosted deployment. These results suggest that learning structured behavior-oriented reasoning patterns is a promising direction towards scalable and high-fidelity LLM-based user simulation.

    The paper uses MoE routing statistics to score reasoning steps, selectively regenerate low-confidence trajectories, and train transferable process reward models.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Process reward models (PRMs) provide fine-grained supervision for multi-step reasoning, yet obtaining reliable process labels remains a central bottleneck. Existing approaches typically rely on human annotation, rollout-based estimation, or auxiliary verification. In this work, we explore a different source of process supervision natively exposed by Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models: expert routing. We show that simple routing statistics provide an intrinsic process-confidence signal that is competitive with conventional output-logit confidence. Building on this observation, we construct routing confidence by combining overall routing mass, head routing mass, and within-step routing variation, and introduce RoCo-Rethink, which identifies the least confident reasoning step and selectively regenerates the subsequent trajectory. We further introduce RoCo-PRM, which uses a strong MoE to automatically annotate reasoning trajectories with routing-derived step scores and distills them into a standalone PRM. Across multiple MoE architectures and diverse reasoning tasks, both RoCo-Rethink and RoCo-PRM consistently outperform strong baselines, while RoCo-PRM transfers effectively across both model architectures and tasks. Our findings suggest that expert routing is more than a computational dispatch mechanism: it provides an architecture-native source of process supervision for reasoning.

    The paper tests whether temporal benchmark categories reflect transferable capabilities and finds performance depends more on remembered temporal knowledge than arithmetic or logical reasoning. This is a strong contribution to reasoning evaluation, but it does not study reasoning mechanisms or capability development directly.

    本文检验了时间基准类别是否反映可迁移能力，并发现表现更多依赖记忆中的时间知识，而非算术或逻辑推理。这是对推理评估的重要贡献，但没有直接研究推理机制或能力发展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Temporal reasoning is widely assumed to decompose into two modes: temporal arithmetic (date and time calculations), and temporal semantics (understanding temporal and causal relations). This dichotomy shapes how benchmarks are designed, how models are trained, and how progress is measured, yet its empirical validity has never been directly tested. We provide two lines of evidence that challenge it. First, we test whether tasks labelled as arithmetic or semantic by the benchmarks support transferable gains within their purported mode. Finetuning on these subsets yields predominantly dataset-specific gains ($+6.8$ to $+23.1$ percentage points), while transfer to a different dataset in the same mode ranges from $-3.2$ to $+1.1$ percentage points. Across the two benchmark families used in the transfer analysis, this pattern provides little evidence of coherent, transferable temporal abilities. Second, using cognitive-demand-based model evaluation, we examine which capabilities actually drive performance on these benchmarks. We find that quantitative and logical reasoning, the assumed proxies for temporal arithmetic and temporal semantics, are not the primary drivers; knowledge is. Together, these findings show that current temporal reasoning benchmarks do not cleanly realise the arithmetic-semantics distinction and instead largely reward models for remembering how time typically works.

    人们普遍认为，时间推理可分解为两种模式：时间算术（日期和时间计算）以及时间语义（理解时间关系和因果关系）。这种二分法影响了基准的设计、模型的训练和进展的衡量方式，但其经验有效性从未得到直接检验。我们提供了两方面的证据来质疑这一划分。首先，我们检验基准中被标为算术或语义的任务，是否能在各自声称的模式内带来可迁移的收益。对这些子集进行微调，主要带来特定于数据集的收益（$+6.8$ 至 $+23.1$ 个百分点）；而迁移到同一模式下不同数据集的收益范围为 $-3.2$ 至 $+1.1$ 个百分点。在迁移分析所使用的两个基准系列中，这种模式几乎没有提供连贯且可迁移的时间能力证据。其次，我们基于认知需求对模型进行评估，考察哪些能力实际上驱动了这些基准上的表现。我们发现，定量推理和逻辑推理——被假定分别是时间算术和时间语义的替代指标——并非主要驱动因素；知识才是。总的来说，这些发现表明，当前的时间推理基准并未清晰体现算术与语义的区分，反而在很大程度上奖励模型记住时间通常如何运作。

    Rationale Contrastive Decoding contrasts answer-token distributions with and without the rationale, and experiments show greater answer dependence on rationale content and improved benchmark accuracy.     推理过程对比解码对比有无推理过程时的答案词元分布，实验显示答案对推理过程内容的依赖增强，基准准确率也有所提高。这项工作直接推进了 CoT 推理，但其行为干预并未证实内部机制或组合泛化能力，而单独的解码方法不构成系统方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting improves the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs), recent studies have shown that final answers do not always depend on the generated rationales. In particular, LLMs may rely on query-specific shortcuts rather than the information provided by their reasoning steps. In this paper, we investigate whether context-aware decoding (CAD), an existing contrastive decoding method, can mitigate such shortcut behavior when applied to CoT reasoning. We study this application as Rationale Contrastive Decoding (RCD), which contrasts the next-token distributions conditioned on the query with and without its rationale, amplifying tokens whose likelihood increases due to the rationale. We provide a theoretical interpretation of this decoding rule via a KL-regularized reward-maximization objective. Experiments across five reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that RCD improves answer accuracy over standard CoT. Furthermore, intervention analyses using ground-truth and random rationales reveal that RCD increases the behavioral dependence of final answers on the rationale content. Our findings suggest that contrastive decoding offers a simple, training-free approach to mitigating query shortcuts.

    RCSD trains draft models from accepted and rejected speculative sequences to improve acceptance length and inference speed. Its system-level decoding optimization is a substantial systems contribution; reinforcement learning is incidental to general reasoning capability, and the abstract offers no interpretability or compositional insight.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by employing a compact draft model to propose candidate tokens that are verified in parallel by a target model. Conventional training relies on soft-label distillation, which forces the draft model to mimic the target's full output distribution, including high-entropy regions that degrade acceptance rates and increase early rejection risk. We propose RCSD (Reinforcement and Continual Learning for Speculative Decoding), a training framework that aligns draft model optimization with the system-level objective of maximizing acceptance length. RCSD leverages naturally occurring accepted and rejected sequences during speculative inference to construct implicit preference pairs, with masked loss to avoid penalizing target-aligned tokens. Evaluated across multiple benchmarks, RCSD improves average acceptance length by 35% over HASS and achieves 1.35x faster end-to-end inference than HASS on practical workloads, without compromising generation quality.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PACE introduces post-hoc recurrent-state quantization with less frequent rounding, column-shared scales, and mixed-precision heads to reduce memory while preserving decoding performance. Its focus on state storage and inference efficiency strongly advances model systems; the observed state structure supports the quantizer but does not investigate internal mechanisms or representation geometry.

    PACE 提出了一种事后循环状态量化方法，通过降低舍入频率、在列内共享尺度并采用混合精度注意力头，在减少内存用量的同时保持解码性能。其对状态存储和推理效率的关注有力推动了模型系统的发展；观察到的状态结构为量化器提供了依据，但该工作并未研究内部机制或表征几何。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Linear-attention language models keep their context in a recurrent state of fixed size, where an inference system stores one copy of this state for every sequence it decodes at the same time. Storing the state at lower precision therefore lets more sequences share an accelerator. Existing state quantizers round the state after every generated token and report that four bits lose accuracy unless the bit width is raised or the model is fine-tuned.\par We introduce PACE, a post-hoc four-bit state quantizer. PACE rounds the state only once every few generated tokens, as chunked kernels already do once per chunk during prefill, and keeps the tokens generated in between in a small buffer. Rounding less often reduces the error that accumulates in the state. Additionally, we find that the large entries of the gated-delta state gather in columns, because some channels of the update written at each token remain large across many tokens. PACE therefore shares each quantization scale within one column. It also keeps the heads that retain rounding error longest at eight bits. On four hybrid models from 4B to 35B parameters, PACE with mixed four- and eight-bit heads is competitive with eight-bit DAMP on the three larger models at about two thirds of its memory, PACE with four-bit heads throughout scores higher than Q-Mamba at equal memory, and rounding every few tokens preserves the decoding speedup of the buffer.

    WRDO learns to combine prompt-specific refusal directions to strengthen or restore refusal interventions, directly studying how refusal is represented and manipulated in language-model activations. This is a substantial mechanistic contribution, while the optimization does not address compositionality or reasoning, and intervention on a model alone provides only an incidental systems connection.

    WRDO 学习组合针对特定提示的拒绝方向，以增强或恢复拒绝干预，直接研究了拒绝行为如何在语言模型激活中表征和操纵。这构成了实质性的机制研究贡献，但该优化未涉及组合性或推理；对模型进行干预与系统研究的联系也只是间接的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Aligned large language models are trained to comply with benign requests while refusing harmful ones. However, recent work shows that this refusal behavior is fragile and can often be disrupted by simple activation- or weight-space interventions. In particular, refusal has been shown to be largely mediated by a single residual-stream direction, typically computed as a difference-of-means vector between harmful and harmless prompts. However, this standard construction aggregates heterogeneous harmful prompts into one uniform average, potentially conflating distinct refusal-related phenomena. In this work, we study whether refusal interventions can be strengthened by learning how to combine prompt-specific refusal directions. We propose Weighted Refusal Direction Optimization (WRDO), a procedure that constructs a composite refusal direction from a bank of per-prompt directions using learned aggregation weights. This approach allows different harmful prompts to contribute unequally to the final intervention direction. We evaluate WRDO against prior single-direction methods on three open-weight language models using three guard judges and HarmBench as an external evaluator. We further measure the effect of the intervention on general model capability through standard utility benchmarks. Finally, we investigate a defense-oriented setting in which the same optimization machinery is used in reverse to restore refusal behavior in an abliterated model checkpoint. Our results show that weighted aggregation provides a more effective and flexible mechanism for manipulating refusal representations.

    ENGLISH

    Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale model capacity efficiently, yet their substantial memory footprint poses a major barrier to deployment. Expert pruning reduces this footprint, but most methods focus on which experts to remove and prune every layer equally. We propose SPARE (Sparsity Allocation via Routing Entropy), a training-free, selector-agnostic method that decides how many experts to remove from each layer using routing entropy, the entropy of tokens' normalized Top-K gate weights on calibration data. When a token's gate weight is spread evenly, removing one active expert discards little of it, so SPARE prunes layers with more diffuse routing more aggressively. A perturbation bound under random pruning formalizes this intuition, and controlled interventions with a fixed selector link concentrated routing to larger output changes. With the same selector and budget, SPARE improves average accuracy over uniform allocation on Mixtral, Qwen3, and DeepSeek models, especially at high pruning ratios. At 50% expert pruning, it raises the eight-task average of Qwen3-30B-A3B from 57.2% to 63.8%, and the math, code, and science average of DeepSeek-R1 from 80.1 to 82.8.

    Toward Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI

    迈向物理 AI 中的递归自我改进

    Meng Luo, Zechen Bai, Shanqing Xu, Yanlin Li, Kaixin Li, Mengchen Qian, Weifeng Lu, Ran Zhang, Yingtian Zou, Ziyang Luo, Wei Chen, Hongzhan Lin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    This review synthesizes how robots might improve both their behavior and the processes that produce improvement, and proposes evaluation principles for safe recursive self-improvement. It offers substantial transferable insight into agent learning and self-improvement systems, with some connection to learning and capability development, but does not investigate internal representations or compositional generalization.

    本文综述了机器人如何同时改进行为及产生改进的过程，并提出安全递归自我改进的评估原则。它为智能体学习和自我改进系统提供了大量可迁移的见解，并与学习和能力发展有一定联系，但未研究内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recursive self-improvement (RSI) describes a system that improves not only its behavior but also the process by which it improves. Recent digital agents test this idea by rewriting their own code and checking each version with executable tests. Bringing these mechanisms into the physical world requires learning from partial observations through costly trials, while accounting for changing operating conditions and potentially irreversible consequences. We position RSI within robot learning and trace pathways from improving robot capabilities to improving the processes that generate them. We examine how physical experience can strengthen these improvement mechanisms and when the resulting gains can support further self-improvement of the mechanisms themselves. Gains carry forward only when feedback addresses remaining learning needs, the receiving component can use the change, its value survives changes in tasks or hardware, and continued practice remains safe and affordable. Existing studies, concentrated in manipulation, support behavioral improvement, benefits to later learning, and procedure improvement. Some systems also change the improver's knowledge or tools, but the physical studies reviewed here have yet to isolate gains attributable to recursion. We synthesize these findings into evaluation principles and research directions for machines that, trial by trial, safely improve the way they improve.

    中文

    递归自我改进（RSI）指的是一个系统不仅改进自身行为，也改进促成这种改进的过程。近期的数字智能体通过重写自身代码并使用可执行测试检查每个版本来探索这一理念。要将这些机制带入物理世界，就需要通过代价高昂的试验从不完整观测中学习，同时考虑不断变化的运行条件和可能不可逆的后果。我们将 RSI 置于机器人学习的背景下，梳理从提升机器人能力到改进生成这些能力的过程的路径。我们考察物理经验如何增强这些改进机制，以及由此产生的收益在何种情况下能够进一步支持这些机制自身的自我改进。只有当反馈回应了尚未满足的学习需求、接收变更的组件能够使用该变更、变更的价值在任务或硬件变化后仍然存在，并且持续练习仍然安全且成本可承受时，收益才能延续。现有研究主要集中于操作任务，支持行为改进、对后续学习的益处以及流程改进。一些系统还会改变改进者自身的知识或工具，但本文评述的物理领域研究尚未分离出可归因于递归的收益。我们综合这些发现，提出评估原则和研究方向，推动机器在一次次试验中安全地改进其改进方式。

    Divyaansh Mertia, Chirag Bhutra, Himanshu Shekhar, Shubham Bagwari, Pratik Mazumder

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes frozen embedding geometry to identify spurious-attribute structure and uses that pattern for post-hoc debiasing with a learned linear map. This provides a substantial, transferable finding about representation geometry; the classifier application does not address the other directions.

    本文分析冻结嵌入的几何结构以识别伪属性模式，并利用该模式通过学习的线性映射进行事后去偏。这为表征几何提供了实质性且可迁移的发现；分类器应用并未涉及其他研究方向。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large pretrained models such as CLIP are widely used as frozen feature extractors. However, their embeddings inherit spurious correlations from training data, introducing bias into the features. A growing body of research has sought to address this issue through post hoc debiasing, leaving the backbone untouched. We discover that despite differing mechanisms, these methods require the bias feature to be identified and expressed in text. This dependency is not innocuous. In this work, we experimentally demonstrate that this requirement incurs an unforeseen penalty in certain scenarios. For example, on the UrbanCars benchmark, having two co-occurring bias attributes, the recent methods underperform a vanilla classifier on biased frozenbackbone features, and even providing ground-truth bias identities does not close the gap. We show that the pattern that such methods seek is readily observable in the frozen geometry. Specifically, cross-class training pairs placed closest together by the frozen encoder almost always share a spurious attribute, regardless of the bias type, without requiring access to the bias labels. Based on this, we propose a novel approach to identify such pairs and learn a single linear map that transforms the features to perform post-hoc debiasing. The proposed approach achieves competitive performance across all datasets without access to bias attribute annotations or any LLMs.

    中文

    CLIP 等大型预训练模型被广泛用作冻结特征提取器。然而，它们的嵌入会继承训练数据中的伪相关性，从而使特征带有偏见。越来越多的研究尝试通过事后去偏来解决这一问题，同时保持主干网络不变。我们发现，尽管机制各不相同，这些方法都要求识别偏见特征并用文本表达出来。这种依赖并非无关紧要。在本文中，我们通过实验表明，在某些场景下，这一要求会带来意料之外的性能损失。例如，在具有两个共现偏见属性的 UrbanCars 基准上，近期方法的表现不如基于带偏见冻结主干特征的普通分类器；即使提供真实偏见类别标签，也无法弥合差距。我们表明，这些方法试图捕捉的模式可以直接从冻结特征的几何结构中观察到。具体而言，无论偏见类型如何，经冻结编码器置于最近邻位置的跨类别训练样本对几乎总是共享某种伪属性，无需访问偏见标签。基于此，我们提出一种新方法来识别此类样本对，并学习一个单一线性映射，以变换特征并实现事后去偏。所提方法在所有数据集上都取得了有竞争力的表现，且无需访问偏见属性标注或任何 LLM。

    仿生听觉处理：将并行共振-发放动力学与三值循环网络耦合用于语音识别

    Pavlos Poulos, Katelyn Sadorf, Themos Stafylakis, Costas A. Anastassiou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a spiking recurrent architecture that couples ternary temporal filtering with resonate-and-fire neurons, reporting speech recognition performance and modeled efficiency. Its learned layer hierarchy and latent manifolds provide some representational evidence, while the main contribution advances sparse event-driven computation.

    本文提出一种脉冲循环架构，将三值时间滤波与共振-发放神经元相结合，并报告了语音识别性能及建模效率。其学习得到的层级结构和潜在流形提供了一些表征方面的证据，而主要贡献在于推进稀疏的事件驱动计算。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) promise energy-efficient inference through sparse, event-driven computation, yet remain constrained on continuous, context-dependent tasks such as automatic speech recognition (ASR). A key bottleneck is the Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neuron, whose membrane decay erases information across pauses and phonetic boundaries while it must both extract features and retain long-range context. Inspired by cortical separation of nonlinear filtering and somatic integration, we introduce the Spiking Ternary GRU (stGRU): a ternary-weight gated recurrent unit performs temporal filtering, while downstream Resonate-and-Fire (RF) neurons generate the binary spike stream driving the next block's event pathway. This makes binary event transmission a native training constraint rather than a separate deployment-time activation quantization step; together with ternary weights, learned projections avoid dense floating-point matrix MACs. Trained end-to-end on LibriSpeech-960, Small, Medium, and Large stGRUs reach 8.09%, 7.04%, and $6.44 \pm 0.17\%$ WER on test-clean without an external language model. To our knowledge, these are the first matrix-MAC-free spiking networks without a learned ANN sequence decoder to achieve single-digit WER on LibriSpeech. The architecture also achieves 10.88% test CER on Aishell-1 (9.28% on dev) when trained from scratch. Internally, trained networks develop a depth-graded hierarchy: shallow layers act as fast acoustic filters, while deep layers form slower semantic integrators whose latent representations segregate into part-of-speech manifolds and word-level spike events. Deep-layer firing rates follow lognormal distributions with a sparsity gradient, mirroring hierarchical processing observed in human cortex in vivo. Our biologically grounded architecture combines competitive ASR with favorable modeled compute and memory cost.

    中文

    脉冲神经网络（SNN）有望通过稀疏、事件驱动的计算实现高能效推理，但在自动语音识别（ASR）等连续且依赖上下文的任务上仍受到限制。一个关键瓶颈是漏积分-发放（LIF）神经元：其膜电位衰减会在停顿和语音边界处抹去信息，而它还必须同时提取特征并保留长程上下文。受皮层将非线性滤波与胞体整合分离这一机制的启发，我们提出脉冲三值 GRU（stGRU）：三值权重门控循环单元执行时间滤波，下游的共振-发放（RF）神经元则生成二进制脉冲流，以驱动下一模块的事件通路。这使二进制事件传输成为原生的训练约束，而不是独立的部署时激活量化步骤；结合三值权重，学习得到的投影避免了密集浮点矩阵乘加运算。在 LibriSpeech-960 上进行端到端训练后，Small、Medium 和 Large stGRU 在 test-clean 上的词错误率（WER）分别达到 8.09%、7.04% 和 $6.44 \pm 0.17\%$ WER，且未使用外部语言模型。据我们所知，这是首批在 LibriSpeech 上实现个位数 WER、无需学习型 ANN 序列解码器且不执行矩阵乘加的脉冲网络。该架构从头训练后，在 Aishell-1 上的 test CER 也达到 10.88%（dev 上为 9.28%）。在内部，训练后的网络形成了按深度分级的层次结构：浅层充当快速声学滤波器，而深层则构成较慢的语义整合器，其潜在表示分化为词性流形和词级脉冲事件。深层的放电率呈对数正态分布，并具有稀疏度梯度，这与体内人类皮层中观察到的层级处理相呼应。我们的生物学启发架构兼具竞争力的 ASR 性能以及有利的建模计算和内存成本。

    检索增强生成的组合性

    Ido Levy, Segev Shlomov, Leshem Choshen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper systematically tests whether RAG pipeline components compose and how their effects change with corpus scale, providing transferable empirical evidence about composition in retrieval systems. Its focus is pipeline design and evaluation rather than model-internal mechanisms or reasoning capability.

    本文系统地检验了 RAG 流水线组件能否组合，以及它们的效果如何随语料库规模变化，为检索系统中的组合性提供了可迁移的实证证据。该工作关注的是流水线设计与评估，而非模型内部机制或推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds large language models in external knowledge. Modern pipelines combine embedding, chunking, retrieval, reranking, query augmentation, context compression, and agentic verification, yet these techniques are typically evaluated one at a time. It remains unclear whether their isolated gains survive composition, whether retrieval quality and answer faithfulness favor the same design choices, and whether conclusions from small corpora hold at large scale. We pre-declare three hypotheses and introduce LASAGNA, an open-source framework for controlled RAG evaluation. We test 450 configurations across eight benchmarks and corpora ranging from 5K to 200K documents. Three findings emerge. First, individually strong techniques from different phases of a RAG pipeline do not necessarily compose: three retrieval techniques predict a +47% combined improvement but deliver only +17% when used together. Second, component gains stack differently for retrieval and faithfulness, and optimizing one can hurt the other. Third, the best composition changes as the corpus grows: the combination that wins on a small corpus may not remain best at large scale. These findings show that gains measured in isolation are not reliable predictors of realistic performance, and that new RAG techniques should be tested with the full surrounding stack. We call on researchers to do so and supply LASAGNA to simplify these experiments.

    中文

    检索增强生成（RAG）将大型语言模型建立在外部知识之上。现代流水线结合了嵌入、分块、检索、重排序、查询扩充、上下文压缩和智能体式验证，但这些技术通常各自单独评估。人们尚不清楚各技术单独取得的收益组合后是否仍然存在，检索质量与答案忠实度是否偏好相同的设计选择，以及从小型语料库得出的结论能否适用于大规模场景。我们预先声明了三项假设，并引入开源框架 LASAGNA，用于受控的 RAG 评估。我们在八个基准上测试了 450 种配置，语料库规模从 5K 到 200K 份文档不等。我们得出三项发现。第一，RAG 流水线不同阶段中单独表现出色的技术不一定能够组合：三种检索技术预计组合后可提升 +47%，但实际合用时只提升 +17%。第二，各组件对检索和答案忠实度的增益以不同方式叠加，优化其中一项可能损害另一项。第三，最佳组合会随语料库增长而变化：在小型语料库上胜出的组合，在大规模场景下未必仍是最佳选择。这些发现表明，单独测得的增益无法可靠预测真实场景中的表现，新的 RAG 技术应结合完整的周边技术栈进行测试。我们呼吁研究人员这样做，并提供 LASAGNA 以简化此类实验。

    The paper develops post-hoc uncertainty heads and evaluates their use for adaptive robot learning, including detecting unfamiliar combinations of familiar inputs. That offers partial evidence about compositional generalization, while the policy embeddings and assistance use are incidental to mechanistic interpretability and reasoning; the main contribution is a transferable method for uncertainty estimation in model systems.

    本文开发了事后不确定性头，并评估其在自适应机器人学习中的用途，包括检测熟悉输入的陌生组合。这为组合泛化提供了部分证据；策略嵌入和协助用途则与机制可解释性和推理关系较弱；其主要贡献是为模型系统提供一种可迁移的不确定性估计方法。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Vision-language-action (VLA) policies need to recognize gaps in their training knowledge to request useful demonstrations or assistance in new situations, especially when failures are costly. Disagreement within an ensemble of independently trained policies can guide these decisions, but requires training and running multiple policies. We propose post-hoc kernel-variance heads that estimate epistemic uncertainty from the embeddings of a single policy. Each head computes the conditional variance of a Gaussian process conditioned on embeddings from the training demonstrations. Fitting requires no regression targets or gradient updates and leaves the policy unchanged. In experiments with SmolVLA on LIBERO-10, the kernel variance heads perform competitively with two-policy ensemble scores in task-level correlation with task success, in demonstration acquisition during active learning, and in referral to a stronger supervisor policy as a proxy for human assistance. For SmolVLA, the head on the vision-language backbone reduces uncertainty-scoring time by up to approximately a factor of 50 compared with ensemble scores, while also substantially reducing setup costs. We also show that the established evaluation protocol on LIBERO-10 primarily rewards recognition of coverage differences between tasks, while execution variability weakens assessment of within-task rankings. Thus, controlled perturbations provide a complementary evaluation: modality-specific heads identify unfamiliar camera, instruction, or state inputs, while fused heads can detect unfamiliar combinations of individually familiar inputs. With a supervisor proxy trained on the evaluated perturbation families, the decoder head improves within-task referral over ensemble disagreement. These findings show that useful uncertainty estimates for adaptive robot learning can be obtained from a single policy.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion transformers are widely used in image-editing services. To preserve both efficiency and privacy, existing systems commonly rely on cloud-device collaboration. Keeping request-specific inference on the device avoids sending personal images and prompts to the cloud. These workloads often use common templates, such as in face swapping and virtual try-on, enabling KV state to be precomputed and reused across requests. However, this reusable state is large and scales with the number of templates, making it impractical to store all of them on mobile devices. Storing them in the cloud addresses this capacity issue, but cache transfer is placed onto the inference path and can even be slower than on-device computation, especially under fluctuating mobile networks. We introduce SAKURA, a cloud-edge architecture that delivers reusable attention state to mobile devices under a bandwidth budget. It first uses a fine-grained token-importance-aware compression method to preserve image quality under limited transfer budgets. At runtime, SAKURA adaptively selects the cache representation for each upcoming shard based on network bandwidth. To enable efficient execution, we develop a pipelined runtime that overlaps cache transfer and reconstruction with on-device execution. We evaluate SAKURA using three editing tasks and two diffusion models, using a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 phone. SAKURA reduces latency by 1.82x and 3.27x over CacheGen adapted to DiT and on-device generation, respectively. It also reduces cache storage by 3.06x over uncompressed cache, while preserving image quality.

    扩散 Transformer 广泛应用于图像编辑服务。为兼顾效率与隐私，现有系统通常依赖云端与设备协同。将特定请求的推理保留在设备上，可以避免将个人图像和提示词发送到云端。这类工作负载通常使用常见模板，例如换脸和虚拟试穿，因此可以预先计算 KV 状态并在多个请求间复用。然而，这些可复用状态规模庞大，且会随模板数量增长，因此在移动设备上存储所有状态并不现实。将它们存储在云端可以解决容量问题，但缓存传输会被纳入推理路径，尤其在移动网络波动时，甚至可能比设备端计算更慢。我们提出 SAKURA，这是一种云边架构，可在带宽预算下向移动设备提供可复用的注意力状态。它首先采用细粒度、感知 token 重要性的压缩方法，以便在传输预算有限时保持图像质量。运行时，SAKURA 根据网络带宽，自适应地为每个即将处理的分片选择缓存表示。为实现高效执行，我们开发了一种流水线运行时，使缓存传输和重建与设备端执行重叠。我们使用一部搭载 Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 的手机，通过三种编辑任务和两种扩散模型对 SAKURA 进行评估。与适配于 DiT 的 CacheGen 和设备端生成相比，SAKURA 分别将延迟降低至原来的 1.82 倍和 3.27 倍。与未压缩缓存相比，它还将缓存存储量减少了 3.06 倍，同时保持了图像质量。

    本文提出基于互信息的后训练方法，以保持并增强思维链与模型输出之间的联系，并在可监控性和不安全行为预测方面取得了实证提升。这项工作显著推进了推理监督，并为推理行为提供了部分机制证据，但没有直接分析内部机制或构建模型系统组织方式。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is one of the few practical tools available for overseeing capable AI systems, but it is fragile: a model's reasoning is only useful to a monitor if it remains coupled to what the model actually does. This coupling can be degraded during training through, for example, CoT compression, optimization against a monitor, and out-of-context generalization from synthetic documents. In this work, we propose an unsupervised post-training objective based on maximizing mutual information between CoT and the output for improving CoT monitorability. Across three model organisms with degraded CoT, it recovers most or all of the lost monitorability. Applied to undegraded policies, it further improves judged monitorability, improves prediction of unsafe behavior by CoT monitors and activation probes, and increases the prevalence of consequential reasoning. These results suggest that monitorability should be treated as a trainable attribute of the policy. A dedicated monitorability post-training stage can extend current practices that protect CoT from direct optimization pressure.

    MAPS：用于调节检索增强生成中搜索动量的宏观自适应并行推理

    Xinze Li, Dingwen Zhang, Zhenghao Liu, Yukun Yan, Shuo Wang, Yu Gu, Ge Yu, Maosong Sun

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MAPS analyzes how reasoning trajectories shape retrieval queries and proposes parallel, momentum-regulated reasoning, with gains across QA benchmarks. This substantially advances a retrieval-augmented reasoning method, while its parallel query composition and system organization are supporting design elements rather than central contributions.

    MAPS 分析推理轨迹如何塑造检索查询，并提出受动量调节的并行推理方法，在多个问答基准上取得提升。这项工作显著推进了一种检索增强推理方法，而并行查询组合和系统组织则是辅助性设计要素，并非核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves the performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) by retrieving external knowledge. Recently, some RAG methods interleave reasoning and retrieval, enabling LLMs to progressively generate sub-queries and retrieve external knowledge. However, these methods may suffer from redundant or ineffective sub-queries and insufficiently diverse query exploration. Moreover, due to the tightly interleaved nature of reasoning and retrieval, it remains unclear how the evolving reasoning process influences query intent. To characterize the evolution of query intent during reasoning, we introduce search momentum, which captures the accumulated retrieval tendency induced by historical changes in generated sub-queries along the reasoning trajectory. Through momentum-based analysis, we find that the query generation process tends to continuously evolve along existing retrieval trajectories. Based on this observation, we propose MAPS, a Macro-Adaptive Parallel Reasoning framework for regulating search momentum and mitigating query-intent drift. MAPS first retains the retrieved knowledge and a refined reasoning state, thereby reducing the influence of historical reasoning trajectories on subsequent sub-query generation. Subsequently, MAPS extends the conventional sequential reasoning process into a parallel reasoning paradigm. At each iteration, MAPS identifies complementary retrieval directions, generates corresponding sub-queries for parallel retrieval, and consolidates the retrieved evidence to update the knowledge and reasoning states. Experiments on six question-answering benchmarks demonstrate that MAPS consistently outperforms representative RAG methods across different backbone models. All code and resources are available at https://github.com/NEUIR/MAPS.

    中文

    检索增强生成（RAG）通过检索外部知识来提升大型语言模型（LLM）的性能。近期一些 RAG 方法将推理与检索交替进行，使 LLM 能够逐步生成子查询并检索外部知识。然而，这些方法可能产生冗余或无效的子查询，且查询探索的多样性不足。此外，由于推理与检索紧密交替进行，推理过程的演变如何影响查询意图仍不清楚。为刻画推理过程中查询意图的演变，我们引入了搜索动量，它反映了推理轨迹上生成的子查询随历史变化而形成的累积检索倾向。通过基于动量的分析，我们发现查询生成过程倾向于沿着既有的检索轨迹持续演变。基于这一观察，我们提出 MAPS，即一种用于调节搜索动量并缓解查询意图漂移的宏观自适应并行推理框架。MAPS 首先保留检索到的知识和经过精炼的推理状态，从而降低历史推理轨迹对后续子查询生成的影响。随后，MAPS 将传统的顺序推理过程扩展为并行推理范式。在每次迭代中，MAPS 都会识别互补的检索方向，生成相应的子查询以并行检索，并整合检索到的证据来更新知识状态和推理状态。在六个问答基准上的实验表明，对于不同的骨干模型，MAPS 的表现始终优于具有代表性的 RAG 方法。所有代码和资源均可在 https://github.com/NEUIR/MAPS 获取。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes and tests a component-level account of DiT denoising, assigning functional roles to attention and MLPs and supporting them with theoretical analysis, interventions, and experiments. It offers strong mechanistic insight and partial insight into reusable patch prediction and generalization, while reasoning and broader systems design are not central.

    本文提出并检验了 DiT 去噪的组件级解释，为注意力和 MLP 指定功能角色，并通过理论分析、干预和实验提供支持。这项工作带来了很强的机制洞见，并对可复用图块预测和泛化提供了部分洞见；推理和更广义的系统设计并非其重点。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    How do diffusion transformers (DiTs) represent image content and learn rules for reusing it to generalize? We develop an aggregator--predictor view of DiTs as input-adaptive local denoisers, in which context aggregation and patch prediction provide functional roles for interpreting attention and MLPs. We first establish that, for Gaussian Markov random field (GMRF) priors, the global Bayes denoiser can be approximated using only a subset of context patches, with error decaying exponentially in context radius. We further show that patchwise linear denoisers, often invoked to explain diffusion generalization, recover the empirical local denoiser with sufficiently informative aggregation. Within this view, AdaLN-modulated attention naturally parameterizes an input- and noise-dependent aggregator, while the MLP admits a learned key--value representation for tokenwise patch prediction. Our experiments support this view. DiTs trained on real images exhibit noise-dependent denoising contexts resembling those in the analytic GMRF setting, while attention mass exhibits a qualitatively corresponding broadening pattern. In a controlled CelebA64 study, shared-memory patch predictors used in place of DiT MLPs achieve competitive denoising and generative performance. Finally, cross-dataset component transplantation reveals compatibility patterns consistent with the proposed roles of QK in spatial weighting, VO in feature transport, and MLPs in patch prediction. Together, these results provide a component-level account of DiT denoising and motivate architecture-specific fine-tuning and controlled intervention.

    扩散 Transformer（DiT）如何表征图像内容，并学习复用这些内容以实现泛化的规则？我们提出一种将 DiT 视为输入自适应局部去噪器的聚合器—预测器视角，其中上下文聚合和图块预测为理解注意力与 MLP 的功能作用提供了框架。我们首先证明，对于高斯马尔可夫随机场（GMRF）先验，全局贝叶斯去噪器可以仅使用一部分上下文图块来近似，且误差会随上下文半径增大而指数级衰减。我们进一步表明，常用于解释扩散模型泛化的逐图块线性去噪器，在聚合信息足够充分时，可以复现经验局部去噪器。在这一视角下，AdaLN 调制的注意力自然地参数化了一个依赖输入和噪声的聚合器，而 MLP 则可采用学习得到的键值表示来逐 token 预测图块。我们的实验支持这一观点。在真实图像上训练的 DiT 展现出依赖噪声的去噪上下文，与解析的 GMRF 情形相似；注意力权重也呈现出定性上相符的扩展模式。在一项受控的 CelebA64 研究中，用共享记忆图块预测器替代 DiT MLP，可获得有竞争力的去噪和生成性能。最后，跨数据集组件移植揭示了与所提出功能角色相符的兼容性模式：QK 用于空间加权，VO 用于特征传输，MLP 用于图块预测。总之，这些结果从组件层面解释了 DiT 的去噪机制，并为针对特定架构的微调和受控干预提供了依据。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PAUSE adds a single planning intervention before a coding agent’s first edit and evaluates its effect on task success and token use. Agent steering is a substantial systems contribution; planning relates to reasoning, but the abstract does not investigate reasoning mechanisms, and its use of a separate planner does not substantively address compositional generalization.

    PAUSE 在代码智能体首次编辑前加入一次规划干预，并评估其对任务成功率和 token 用量的影响。智能体引导是一项重要的系统贡献；规划与推理有关，但摘要没有研究推理机制，且使用独立规划器并未实质性涉及组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Coding agents can invest substantial effort in repository exploration and testing yet still produce unsuccessful patches. Existing online steering methods review trajectories periodically or invoke an advisor when a monitor detects behavioral problems; frequent reviews are costly, and the absence of anomalous behavior does not mean that an agent is on the right track. We propose PAUSE, a framework for steering coding agents with a single planning intervention. Agents reach their first source-code edit at a median of 60% of trajectory progress, after exploration, bug reproduction, and testing. PAUSE intercepts this edit request before it executes, which requires no learned monitor, no search over checkpoints, and no extra model call (search-free). A separate Planner reads the task and the pre-edit transcript and writes one repair plan; the same agent, the Executor, resumes with this plan, keeping its context and workspace. PAUSE applies online, during a live run, and offline, from a recorded trajectory prefix. We evaluate PAUSE on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Multilingual with two Executors and three agent harnesses. With Qwen3-coder as Executor and GPT-5.6 Sol as Planner, online steering improves resolution by 16.8% on Verified in OpenHands and by 14.7% on Multilingual in SWE-agent. In SWE-agent, PAUSE outperforms LivePlan, a rule-triggered advisor, by 3.2% on Verified and 3.7% on Multilingual at similar Planner cost, and is comparable to SICA's periodic overseer at about 11-15% of its Planner cost. Offline, PAUSE recovers 35.4% of eligible failed Verified tasks, and resuming from the recorded prefix uses 33-41% fewer Executor tokens than restarting.

    中文

    代码智能体可能投入大量精力探索代码库和运行测试，却仍然生成无效补丁。现有在线引导方法会定期审查轨迹，或在监控器检测到行为问题时调用顾问；频繁审查成本高昂，而且没有异常行为并不意味着智能体方向正确。我们提出 PAUSE，这是一种通过单次规划干预来引导代码智能体的框架。智能体通常在轨迹进度中位数达到 60% 时才进行首次源代码编辑，此前会进行探索、复现错误和测试。PAUSE 会在编辑请求执行前拦截它，无需训练监控器、搜索检查点，也无需额外模型调用（即免搜索）。一个独立的 Planner 读取任务和编辑前的对话记录，并撰写一份修复计划；同一个智能体 Executor 随后在保留其上下文和工作区的情况下，依据该计划继续执行。PAUSE 既可在线应用于正在运行的任务，也可离线应用于记录下来的轨迹前缀。我们使用两个 Executor 和三个智能体框架，在 SWE-bench Verified 和 SWE-bench Multilingual 上评估 PAUSE。以 Qwen3-coder 为 Executor、GPT-5.6 Sol 为 Planner 时，在线引导使 OpenHands 在 Verified 上的解决率提升 16.8%，使 SWE-agent 在 Multilingual 上的解决率提升 14.7%。在 SWE-agent 中，以类似的 Planner 成本计算，PAUSE 在 Verified 上比基于规则触发的顾问 LivePlan 高 3.2%，在 Multilingual 上高 3.7%；其表现可与定期监督器 SICA 相当，而 Planner 成本约为 SICA 的 11–15%。离线情况下，PAUSE 挽回了 35.4% 符合条件的 Verified 失败任务；从记录的前缀继续执行，比重新开始少用 33–41% 的 Executor token。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

This substantially advances latent reasoning and multi-agent systems; evidence about token contents offers partial insight into representations, while compositional generalization is not a main contribution.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Forming an accurate theory-of-mind (ToM) is key to successful multi-agent collaboration and requires reasoning under uncertainty to capture multiple possible partner states. This is hard to do in the text representation space native to large language model (LLM) agents, which more easily describe a single partner state. To address this challenge, we introduce ToM2Vec, which learns to form abstract theories-of-mind in a rich latent space via a fixed budget of continuous reasoning tokens. During training, supervision for these tokens comes from the partner's actual thoughts, which the ToM tokens are trained to abstract and match. At test-time, ToM tokens are generated by each agent and act as conditioners for that agent's thoughts and actions. Across several environments covering collaborative, competitive, and mixed-motive settings (Overcooked-AI, multiparty negotiation, Decrypto, Hanabi, and Collab Escape/Capture), we evaluate ToM2Vec's ability to support multi-agent interactions and collaboration, finding consistent improvements over the base model and a variety of competitive trained and prompted baselines. We show that latent reasoning is critical, with performance dropping when reasoning is expressed in text. Moreover, we show that ToM2Vec training generalizes to partner model families not seen at train-time, including a proprietary model (GPT-5.4). In our analysis, we provide evidence that the latent tokens encode a ToM, rather than task-specific information: ToM2Vec's tokens improve the agent's ability to directly answer questions about partner beliefs, desires, and next actions.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Text skills can extend the capabilities of tool-using agents, but long skill descriptions increase computational costs. Soft prompts provide a compact alternative, yet learning from entire successful trajectories may also introduce unnecessary behavioral changes. We find that the useful effect of a text skill is highly concentrated in a small subset of trajectory positions. Based on this observation, we propose Behavioral Localization, which compares the frozen agent with and without the text skill to identify positions where the skill both increases the likelihood of successful tokens and meaningfully changes the next token distribution. We use these localized positions to supervise a short soft prompt. Experiments on SpreadsheetBench with a frozen Qwen3.6-35B-A3B agent show that the top 10\% of trajectory positions capture 96.12\% of the total positive skill gain. In the shared prompt setting, selective supervision improves success from 30.36\% with full trajectory to 36.79\%. Under task-specific conditions, using the top 10\% localized positions achieves 57.38\%, outperforming both the full text skill and the on-policy OPCD baseline. These results show that a small set of behaviorally relevant trajectory positions can provide effective supervision of soft skills.

    LAW makes self-conditioning the basis of a continuous diffusion language model and reports gains on Sudoku, mazes, and GSM8K, including after fine-tuning a pretrained model. The iterative method supports reasoning and structured problem solving, while its generative architecture has a systems connection; the abstract does not establish interpretability or a focused study of compositional generalization.

    LAW 将自条件化作为连续扩散语言模型的基础，并报告了在数独、迷宫和 GSM8K 上的性能提升，包括微调预训练模型后的提升。该迭代方法有助于推理和结构化问题求解，其生成架构也与系统领域相关；摘要并未证明其具备可解释性，也未聚焦于组合泛化研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) use Self-Conditioning (SC), or Loopholing, to improve their performance. While SC is traditionally seen as an auxiliary heuristic, its empirical success raises the question: can a continuous generative model be based purely on Self-Conditioning? We answer affirmatively with LAW (``Loopholing All the Way''), which propagates the Expected Embedding under the denoiser's prediction across steps, decoding the tokens once, at the end. On Sudoku, LAW outperforms previous Discrete and Continuous Diffusion Models, including Loopholing Discrete Diffusion. On Maze, LAW is the most accurate from 2 to 64 NFE. After training on TinyGSM and sampling at temperature 1 with 1024 NFE, LAW solves 42.2% of GSM8K problems against 34.5% for uniform Loopholing Discrete Diffusion. Additionally, fine-tuning a pre-trained Uniform Diffusion Model (Duo) with LAW increases its accuracy from 17.2% to 48.1%. Finally, on OpenWebText, LAW pushes the Pareto frontier and approaches Autoregressive Models (ARMs) with 64 NFE. Find our code at https://github.com/ilievanadezhda/law.

    近期的扩散语言模型（DLMs）使用自条件化（SC），也称 Loopholing，来提升性能。尽管 SC 传统上被视为一种辅助启发式方法，其经验上的成功引出了一个问题：连续生成模型能否完全建立在自条件化之上？我们的答案是肯定的，并提出 LAW（“Loopholing All the Way”）：在多个步骤中传播去噪器预测下的期望嵌入，只在最后解码一次 token。在数独任务上，LAW 优于以往的离散和连续扩散模型，包括 Loopholing Discrete Diffusion。在迷宫任务上，LAW 在 2 到 64 NFE 范围内准确率最高。在 TinyGSM 上训练并以 temperature 1、1024 NFE 采样后，LAW 解出了 GSM8K 问题的 42.2%，而均匀 Loopholing Discrete Diffusion 为 34.5%。此外，使用 LAW 微调预训练的 Uniform Diffusion Model（Duo），可将其准确率从 17.2% 提升至 48.1%。最后，在 OpenWebText 上，LAW 推进了帕累托前沿，并在 64 NFE 下接近自回归模型（ARMs）。代码见 https://github.com/ilievanadezhda/law。

    Xinzhe Wang, Xudong Weng, Zang Li, Shaolei Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies whether charts act as epistemic actions in agent reasoning and contributes controlled evidence plus an experience-distillation method that teaches agents when to use visual or textual evidence. Its agent-loop design also advances agent systems; it does not investigate internal model representations.

    本文研究图表是否能在智能体推理中充当认知行动，并通过受控证据和经验蒸馏方法，教会智能体何时使用视觉或文本证据。其智能体循环设计也推动了智能体系统的发展；本文不研究模型内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Data agents built on ReAct-style loops now execute complex analytical workflows over structured data, yet their intermediate reasoning still runs almost entirely through text. Human analysts instead move between numbers, tables, and charts, reading visual evidence to expose trends and anomalies that text summaries drop. We ask whether charts can serve as internal epistemic actions inside a data agent's reasoning loop, and how to teach an agent to use them. We first build \probe{}, a suite of 200 controlled tasks under four matched interface conditions, and find a persistent gap between what agents can read and what they choose to use. Agents score as well from self-generated charts as from numeric output, yet plotting access alone does not translate into consistent use. Task slices show that charts lead on temporal, pattern, and anomaly reasoning, while text leads on precise reading and conditional verification. We then propose \method{}, which distils two families of experience from conditioned trajectory rollouts. One family records how to select and verify analytical operations, and the other records when to invoke text, charts, or both. A trajectory judge scores outcomes and labels intermediate steps, and a validation gate admits only experience that improves held-out performance. On three held-out benchmarks with four LLM backbones, \method{} raises analytical accuracy and visual evidence quality over matched baselines, and backbones that never drew charts begin using them, all without touching model parameters.

    中文

    基于 ReAct 风格循环构建的数据智能体如今能够在结构化数据上执行复杂的分析工作流，但其中间推理几乎完全依赖文本。人类分析师则会在数字、表格和图表之间切换，通过阅读可视证据发现文本摘要遗漏的趋势和异常。我们探讨图表能否作为认知行动融入数据智能体的推理循环，以及如何教会智能体使用图表。首先，我们构建了 \probe{}，包含 200 个受控任务，并设有四种匹配的接口条件；我们发现，智能体能够读取的内容与其选择使用的内容之间存在持续差距。智能体从自生成图表中获得的分数与从数值输出中获得的分数相当，但仅提供绘图能力并不会带来稳定使用。任务分类结果显示，图表在时间、模式和异常推理方面表现更好，而文本在精确读取和条件验证方面表现更好。随后，我们提出 \method{}，从带条件的轨迹 rollout 中提炼两类经验。一类记录如何选择和验证分析操作，另一类记录何时使用文本、图表或两者。轨迹评判器对结果评分并标注中间步骤，验证门控机制则只接纳能提升留出集性能的经验。在三个留出基准和四种 LLM 主干模型上，\method{} 相较于匹配基线提高了分析准确率和视觉证据质量；即使从未绘制过图表的主干模型也开始使用图表，而且整个过程中无需改动模型参数。

    Hadi Khalaf, Sajani Vithana, Kunal Talreja, Haewon Jeong, Viveck R. Cadambe, Flavio Calmon

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops and characterizes adaptive query circuits that optimize LLM classification accuracy under a query-cost constraint. This offers a substantial systems contribution through routing and query organization; reasoning is secondary, since the tasks include reasoning but the method does not study reasoning mechanisms or capability development.

    本文开发并刻画了自适应查询电路，以在查询成本约束下优化 LLM 分类准确率。这通过路由和查询组织带来了重要的系统贡献；推理属于次要内容，因为尽管任务中包含推理，方法本身并未研究推理机制或能力发展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Language models make it easy to build classifiers by simply prompting a model with the sample to classify. However, their predictions are neither deterministic nor uniformly reliable across samples. How can we combine predictions from different models to improve reliability? We view LLM classifiers as noisy measurement instruments of an underlying target label. Our goal is to maximize average classification accuracy at a given average query cost. To this end, we introduce circuits that organize LLM classifiers into an adaptive sequence of queries and decisions. We then characterize the optimal circuit, obtain the fundamental limits of achievable accuracy, and provide practical insights on realizing the optimal circuit. Across seven classification tasks spanning safety, health, political science, human preference, agent evaluation, decision-making and reasoning, our method improves the cost-accuracy frontier over routing and cascading baselines.

    中文

    语言模型让构建分类器变得容易，只需向模型提供待分类样本并提示它即可。然而，它们的预测既不确定，在不同样本上的可靠性也不一致。我们如何结合不同模型的预测来提高可靠性？我们将 LLM 分类器视为对潜在目标标签进行测量的噪声仪器。我们的目标是在给定平均查询成本下最大化平均分类准确率。为此，我们引入电路，将 LLM 分类器组织成自适应的查询与决策序列。随后，我们刻画最优电路，得到可实现准确率的基本上限，并给出实现最优电路的实用见解。在涵盖安全、健康、政治学、人类偏好、智能体评估、决策和推理的七项分类任务中，我们的方法比路由和级联基线改善了成本—准确率前沿。

    Did the Problem Actually Get Harder? Testing LLMs on Paired P and NP-Complete Problems Hardened by Adversarial Multi-Agent Rewriting

    问题真的变难了吗？测试 LLM 在经对抗式多智能体改写强化的成对 P 类与 NP 完全问题上的表现

    Nurul Labib Sayeedi, Md. Faiyaz Abdullah Sayeedi, Zabir Al Nazi, Mahbub E Sobhani, Shubhashis Roy Dipta

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    P2NPCBench tests whether language models distinguish paired polynomial-time and NP-complete problems, while AgentGAN hardens benchmark statements through adversarial rewriting. This provides substantial evaluation evidence about reasoning, but the benchmark’s paired task structure is not itself a contribution to compositional learning, and the multi-agent framework serves benchmark construction rather than advancing agent systems.

    P2NPCBench 测试语言模型能否区分成对的多项式时间问题和 NP 完全问题；AgentGAN 则通过对抗式改写强化基准陈述。本文为推理能力提供了重要评估证据，但基准的成对任务结构本身并非对组合学习的贡献，而多智能体框架用于构建基准，并未推动智能体系统的发展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Many NP-complete (NPC) problems have a polynomial-time (P) twin that differs in a single structural detail, such as 3- versus 2-colouring a graph. A model that reasons rather than recalls should notice which side of this boundary a problem falls on, yet existing benchmarks either fix the wording of each task or ignore its complexity class, so they cannot separate the two. We introduce P2NPCBench, a benchmark of 12 problem families in which every NPC problem is paired with a P twin posed over the same surface. To remove the textbook cues that enable recall, we build it with AgentGAN, an adversarial multi-agent framework in which a generator rewrites each statement until a panel of frozen code models fails, while an executable validity gate keeps every rewrite answer- and class-preserving. The result is 2,114 hardened statements with hand-verified reference human solvers. Evaluating 12 proprietary and open-source models, we find that every model scores lower on NPC statements than on their P twins (35.4% vs. 63.8% pass@1), and that 95.1% of model-family pairs fail more often on the NPC side. A tenfold time limit raises NPC accuracy only from 28.5% to 31.9%, so failures stem from wrong or crashing programs rather than slow ones. Hardening also narrows the class gap from 24.8 to 14.6 points, showing that part of the apparent gap reflects familiarity with textbook phrasing rather than complexity class.

    中文

    许多 NP 完全（NPC）问题都有一个多项式时间（P）对应问题，两者只在一个结构细节上不同，例如图的 3-着色与 2-着色。能够推理而非回忆的模型理应能识别问题落在这一边界的哪一侧；然而，现有基准要么固定每个任务的措辞，要么忽略其复杂性类别，因此无法区分两者。我们提出 P2NPCBench，这是一个包含 12 个问题族的基准，其中每个 NPC 问题都配有一个基于相同表层形式的问题 P 对应项。为消除有利于回忆的教科书式线索，我们使用 AgentGAN 构建该基准。AgentGAN 是一个对抗式多智能体框架，其中生成器会不断改写每个问题陈述，直到一组冻结的代码模型无法解答；同时，可执行的有效性门控确保每次改写都保持答案和类别不变。最终得到 2,114 条强化后的陈述，并附有经人工核验的参考解题过程。我们评估了 12 个专有和开源模型，发现所有模型在 NPC 陈述上的得分都低于其 P 对应项（pass@1 为 35.4% 对 63.8%），且 95.1% 的模型系列配对在 NPC 一侧失败更多。将时间限制延长十倍后，NPC 准确率仅从 28.5% 升至 31.9%，因此失败源于程序错误或崩溃，而不是运行缓慢。强化处理还将类别差距从 24.8 个百分点缩小到 14.6 个百分点，表明表面上的部分差距反映的是模型对教科书式措辞的熟悉程度，而非复杂性类别本身。

    Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation Learns In-Context Exploration

    非对称 On-Policy 蒸馏学会上下文内探索

    Sriyash Poddar, Yanda Bao, Jacob Krantz, Matthew Chang, Xavier Puig, Roozbeh Mottaghi, Natasha Jaques, Abhishek Gupta

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ASTEROID trains history-conditioned students to explore under partial observability by distilling expert actions on the students’ own on-policy contexts, with strong results across simulated and robotic tasks. This substantially advances exploration and agent behavior, but the abstract does not claim mechanistic interpretability or a core contribution to compositional generalization.

    ASTEROID 通过在学生自身的 on-policy 上下文中蒸馏专家行动，训练基于历史条件的学生在部分可观测条件下进行探索，并在仿真和机器人任务中取得了出色结果。这显著推动了探索和智能体行为的发展，但摘要并未声称具有机制可解释性，也没有将组合泛化作为核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Sequential decision-making under partial observability is difficult because agents must explore to infer hidden, task-relevant information before acting effectively. Learning such information-gathering behaviors tabula rasa via online reinforcement learning is sample-inefficient, whereas offline imitation averages expert actions across hidden states and fails to learn exploration. In this work, we propose ASTEROID, a simple and effective student--teacher supervised learning framework that can learn test-time exploration. Although a privileged expert never needs to explore, we demonstrate that a history-conditioned student can learn to do so when trained with on-policy contexts: the student first collects on-policy context under partial observability, and the privileged expert provides action labels conditioned on that context. By distilling expert actions directly conditioned on the student's on-policy history, the student learns to systematically resolve partial observability, i.e., search while uncertain and exploit once the hidden state is revealed. This enables efficient test-time exploration (similar to Bayesian posterior sampling) without incurring the impractical training-data costs of reinforcement learning. Across a diverse range of eleven different environments, including discrete exploration benchmarks, robotic manipulation, navigation, and Procgen environments, ASTEROID achieves ~2x higher returns under fixed exploration budgets, uses ~100x fewer interactions than RL baselines, and outperforms frontier models at exploration. Finally, our method transfers policies trained in simulation to vision-denied real-world robot manipulation, exhibiting efficient exploration and increasing success by +40% over standard distillation. Overall, it provides a simple yet surprisingly effective framework to learn efficient test-time exploration.

    中文

    部分可观测条件下的序贯决策颇具挑战，因为智能体必须先探索以推断与任务相关的隐藏信息，才能有效行动。通过在线强化学习从零开始学习此类信息搜集行为会造成样本效率低下；而离线模仿会对不同隐藏状态下的专家行动取平均，因而无法学会探索。在本研究中，我们提出 ASTEROID，这是一种简单有效的师生监督学习框架，能够学会测试时探索。尽管拥有特权信息的专家无需探索，我们证明，基于历史条件的学生在使用 on-policy 上下文进行训练时可以学会探索：学生首先在部分可观测条件下收集 on-policy 上下文，特权专家再根据该上下文提供行动标签。通过直接蒸馏以学生自身 on-policy 历史为条件的专家行动，学生学会系统地解决部分可观测问题，即在不确定时搜索，并在隐藏状态显现后加以利用。这使高效的测试时探索成为可能（类似贝叶斯后验采样），同时避免了强化学习所需训练数据的高昂成本。在涵盖离散探索基准、机器人操作、导航和 Procgen 环境的 11 种不同环境中，ASTEROID 在固定探索预算下的回报约高出 2x，与 RL 基线相比交互次数约少 100x，并且探索表现优于前沿模型。最后，我们的方法将仿真中训练的策略迁移到视觉受限的真实世界机器人操作任务中，展现出高效探索能力，并将成功率较标准蒸馏提高了 +40%。总之，它提供了一个简单但出乎意料地有效的框架，用于学习高效的测试时探索。

    The paper proposes PAPAV, a framework for comparing embodied-agent capabilities and benchmarks, with emphasis on physical constraints and gaps in evaluating anticipation and verification. Its planning and reasoning connection is partial, while the main contribution is a transferable agent evaluation framework; it does not study internal representations or compositional generalization.

    本文提出 PAPAV，用于比较具身智能体的能力和基准测试，并着重讨论物理约束以及预判与验证评估方面的不足。它与规划和推理有一定关联，但主要贡献是一个可迁移的智能体评估框架；本文并未研究内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.

    中文

    多模态智能体（MMA）通过推理、记忆、工具和反馈维持交互，最常见的形式是计算机使用智能体；而机器人系统（RS）则在物理动力学约束下耦合感知与执行。我们将多模态具身智能体（MMEA）定义为以目标为导向的系统，它将多模态任务推理与物理动作相结合，并根据由此产生的反馈修正决策。这引出了一个核心问题：当多模态智能体从使用计算机转向使用机器人时，会发生什么变化？我们提出 PAPAV，这是一种以能力为核心的统一框架，包含五项反复出现的功能：感知当前状态、预判动作效果、规划可行方案、通过接口或身体执行，以及验证结果。这些能力按功能而非架构定义，使 PAPAV 能够识别三者的共同点，并进一步比较 MMEA 与 MMA 以及 RS。五种物理约束——从部分可观测性到结果无法验证——使得更少的选择能够预先固定，也减少了纠正错误的空间。在 64 个基准测试中，明确的评估集中于执行；只有 5 个评估预判，只有 3 个评估验证，因此这两项能力大多被任务成功这一指标掩盖。这些约束也构成了我们所指出的开放挑战的背景。因此，PAPAV 为设计可靠的物理智能体，以及围绕全部五项能力而非仅依据任务成功来衡量进展，提供了共同基础。

    Environment Duels: A Microcosm of LLM Co-Evolution

    环境对决：LLM 协同演化的缩影

    Shibo Jin, Zhiqiu Xu, Yiling Zou, Shangyu Gong, Mayur Naik

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Environment Duels evaluates models as environment authors and solvers, and reports that training on these environments improves held-out reasoning and agentic benchmarks. This provides substantive evidence about reasoning capability development and interactive agents, while composition is not a central contribution and the benchmark does not study model internals.

    Environment Duels 将模型作为环境编写者和解题者进行评估，并报告了在这些环境上训练能够提升模型在留出推理和智能体基准测试上的表现。这为推理能力发展和交互式智能体提供了实质性证据；组合并非其核心贡献，且该基准不研究模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Through a tangle of real-world interactions, from synthetic training pipelines to data shared on the open web, frontier LLMs absorb what their predecessors and competitors create. How well does each model play its role in this ecosystem, as a creator and as a solver? We introduce Environment Duels, a dynamic agentic benchmark that evaluates both capabilities on interactive environments. Each model writes environments, each with a privileged hint, aiming for tasks that capable solvers fail without the hint and pass with it. Across nine frontier LLMs, solving and authoring prove to be distinct skills: the strongest solvers are not the strongest authors, while smaller models learn more from how others played and write the hardest environments and the most useful hints. Beyond the scores, the pairwise interactions form a microcosm of how models affect one another. Head-to-head outcomes are transitive and so yield a stable ranking; independent authors converge on the same designs; and in a reinforcement-learning study with Qwen3.8-27B, the learner's hint lift on an author's environments tracks how much training on those environments improves it on held-out reasoning and agentic benchmarks, whether the environments are its own or another model's. Each of these patterns has a counterpart in how models shape one another outside the duel. By staging these interactions under controlled conditions, Environment Duels offers a window onto how LLMs teach, challenge and learn from one another. Code is available at https://github.com/LLM-Duels/EnvDuels.

    中文

    在错综复杂的现实交互中，从合成训练流程到开放网络上共享的数据，前沿 LLM 会吸收其前代模型和竞争对手所创造的内容。每个模型在这个生态系统中扮演创造者和解题者的角色时，表现如何？我们提出 Environment Duels，这是一个动态的智能体基准，用于评估模型在交互式环境中的这两种能力。每个模型都会编写环境，并为每个环境提供一条特权提示，目标是设计出这样的任务：有能力的解题者在没有提示时无法通过，在得到提示后则能通过。在九个前沿 LLM 上的评测表明，解题和编写是两种不同的技能：最强的解题者并非最强的编写者；而较小的模型从他人的表现中学得更多，并能编写出难度最高的环境和最有用的提示。除分数之外，模型之间的成对交互还构成了彼此影响方式的缩影。模型之间的直接对决结果具有传递性，因此能够形成稳定的排名；独立的编写者会收敛到相同的设计；在一项使用 Qwen3.8-27B 的强化学习研究中，学习者在某位编写者所创建环境中因提示获得的性能提升，与在这些环境上训练后其在留出推理和智能体基准测试中的提升幅度相吻合，无论这些环境是学习者自己还是其他模型创建的。这些模式在模型于对决之外相互影响的过程中也有相应表现。通过在受控条件下安排这些交互，Environment Duels 为观察 LLM 如何相互教学、挑战和学习提供了窗口。代码见 https://github.com/LLM-Duels/EnvDuels。

    Think Harder Where It Matters: Item-Level Adaptive Recursion for Sequential Recommendation

    在关键之处深入思考：面向序列推荐的项目级自适应递归

    Zhanshuo Cao, Jiakai Tang, Yuqi Zhou, Sunhao Dai, Jun Xu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LoopRec gives each history item an adaptive recursion depth through a learned exit-or-continue gate, with allocation patterns linked to item properties. It advances conditional computation substantially, while its recommendation setting and the term “reasoning” alone do not establish a core contribution to compositional generalization or general reasoning mechanisms.

    LoopRec 通过学习得到的退出或继续门控，为历史中的每个项目分配自适应递归深度，其分配模式与项目属性相关。它显著推进了条件计算；但其推荐任务场景以及单独使用“推理”一词，都不足以证明它对组合泛化或通用推理机制作出了核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Existing sequential recommenders usually allocate a fixed computational budget to every item in a user's interaction history, regardless of the item's contribution to the final prediction. We challenge this de facto design with two diagnostic findings. (1) Non-uniform computational need: items within the same sequence vary drastically in how much computation they require. Most converge after shallow processing while a critical minority only stabilizes at full depth. (2) Suboptimality of fixed allocation: given oracle access to the target item, a non-uniform depth assignment consistently outranks the fixed one, indicating that existing uniform computation both wastes capacity on already-converged items and sacrifices overall recommendation quality. These observations motivate a shift from fixed-depth computation to item-level adaptive reasoning. To this end, we propose LoopRec. LoopRec recursively applies a single weight-shared block and introduces a lightweight gate at each recursion boundary that makes a binary exit-or-continue decision for every item independently. Items whose representations have sufficiently matured exit early, while those requiring deeper reasoning continue to subsequent recursions. This design converts the fixed global depth into a learned, per-item property without auxiliary depth labels, and is readily adaptable to diverse backbone architectures. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks with four backbone families demonstrate that LoopRec consistently outperforms matched fixed-depth counterparts. Further analysis reveals that LoopRec's learned allocation exhibits interpretable patterns aligned with our post-hoc oracle analysis: lower-frequency items and more recent interactions naturally receive deeper computation. Our code is available at https://github.com/Elpmis117/LoopRec.

    中文

    现有序列推荐模型通常会为用户交互历史中的每个项目分配固定的计算预算，不考虑该项目对最终预测的贡献。我们通过两项诊断性发现，对这一事实上普遍采用的设计提出质疑。（1）计算需求不均：同一序列中的项目所需计算量差异显著。大多数项目经过浅层处理后便趋于稳定，而少数关键项目只有在达到完整深度后才稳定。（2）固定分配并非最优：在能够预先获知目标项目的情况下，非均匀深度分配始终优于固定分配。这表明，现有的均匀计算既浪费了已收敛项目的计算能力，也牺牲了整体推荐质量。这些观察促使我们从固定深度计算转向项目级自适应推理。为此，我们提出 LoopRec。LoopRec 递归地应用一个权重共享模块，并在每个递归边界引入一个轻量门控，为每个项目独立地做出二元的退出或继续决策。表征已充分成熟的项目会提前退出，而需要更深入推理的项目则继续进入后续递归。该设计将固定的全局深度转化为学习得到的项目级属性，无需辅助深度标签，并且易于适配多种骨干架构。在采用四类骨干架构的公开基准上进行的大量实验表明，LoopRec 始终优于匹配的固定深度模型。进一步分析发现，LoopRec 学到的分配呈现出可解释的模式，与我们的事后 oracle 分析一致：频率较低的项目和较新的交互会自然地获得更深的计算。代码见 https://github.com/Elpmis117/LoopRec。
